This extra thermal energy can reduce temperature gradients, thicken the thermal boundary layer, and reduce the efficiency of heat transmission in general. Therefore, it is advised to employ fluids with the least Ohmic dissipation in order to ensure optimal heat transfer and enhanced thermal system performance. For a favorable Buoyancy force, fluid velocity increases, and temperature decreases. Temperature increases when the values of the Soret number and Dufour number are increased.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究数值分析磁流体三维Cross非牛顿流在拉伸表面诱导下的热质输运，重点考虑Soret效应、Dufour效应、热辐射、Hall电流和离子滑移等机制。作者比较Al₂O₃、TiO₂和Cu等单元、二元及三元混合纳米颗粒分散于乙二醇时对热性能的影响，并通过相似变换将控制方程化为强非线性常微分方程组，使用bvp4c求解。研究报告了相关参数对速度、温度、浓度边界层以及局部Nusselt数、Sherwood数和壁面摩擦系数的影响。

articles.title: Emergent compositional control of martensitic transformation in NiTi-like shape memory alloys revealed by manifold learning
articles.title_zh: 流形学习揭示NiTi类形状记忆合金马氏体转变的涌现成分控制变量
articles.abstract: Predicting martensitic transformation temperatures in NiTi-based shape memory alloys remains challenging due to the complex interplay between composition, electronic structure, and chemical disorder. A curated dataset of NiTi-like alloys spanning binary to multi-component compositions was analyzed using physically motivated compositional descriptors and manifold learning with target-informed coordinate selection. Analysis ofthe intrinsic geometry of the descriptor space revealed that the fifth nontrivial diffusioncoordinate (ψ5) exhibits the strongest correlation with martensitic start temperature(Ms). This coordinate was reconstructed as an interpretable emergent variable derived from compositional descriptors, revealing a consistent monotonic trend in transformation temperature across diverse alloy families. The emergent variable exhibits a significant statistical association with Ms across the compositional manifold and shows preliminary transferability across chemically distinct subsystems, providing a compact framework forunder standing and designing NiTi-based shape memory alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向NiTi基形状记忆合金马氏体起始温度预测难题，构建覆盖二元至多元合金的整理数据集，并使用物理启发的成分描述符与目标信息引导的流形学习。分析表明，第五个非平凡扩散坐标ψ5与马氏体起始温度Ms相关性最强，并可重构为可解释的涌现成分变量。该变量在不同合金族中呈现与转变温度一致的单调趋势，并显示出跨化学子体系的初步可迁移性，为NiTi基合金设计提供了紧凑表征框架。

articles.title: Quantum technologies and Surveillance Evolutions: Enablement, disruption, and emergent futures
articles.title_zh: 量子技术与监视演化：赋能、扰动与未来形态
articles.abstract: Quantum technologies have profoundly shaped surveillance practices, embedding themselves into the critical infrastructure of the information age. This article explores the historical trajectory of quantum technologies, emphasizing their omnipresence and influence on surveillance technologies and surveillance practices and arguing for communicating the distinctions as being from two eras. This is based on more foundational Quantum 1.0 era technologies which has implications for the transformative potential of Quantum 2.0. By examining quantum-enabled advancements in computing, sensing, and communication, we highlight how developments in quantum will lead to a deepening and disruption of surveillance capabilities, as well as the ethical and societal challenges these technologies pose. We argue for a non-deterministic approach to understanding quantum developments, advocating for early engagement and value-sensitive design to mitigate harms and foster socially responsible futures. Furthermore, interdisciplinary collaboration is necessary to address potential quantum divides and rethink surveillance concepts. Ultimately, this work contributes to a broader understanding of emerging quantum technologies in fields of humanities and social sciences and comments on their potential to shape our surveillance (technology) futures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文章从历史脉络讨论量子技术如何嵌入信息时代关键基础设施并塑造监视技术与实践，区分以基础量子器件为核心的“量子1.0”与更具变革潜力的“量子2.0”。作者围绕量子计算、量子传感和量子通信分析其对监视能力的增强与扰动，以及由此带来的伦理和社会挑战。文章主张以非决定论视角看待量子发展，通过早期公众参与、价值敏感设计和跨学科协作降低潜在伤害并避免新的量子鸿沟。

articles.title: A Distinct Second Spectral Peak in White Matter BOLD Signals: Mathematical Modeling, Spatial Distribution and Age-Related Evolution
articles.title_zh: 白质BOLD信号中的独立第二谱峰：数学建模、空间分布与年龄相关演化
articles.abstract: White matter blood-oxygenation-level-dependent (BOLD) signals in resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) are increasingly recognized for their physiological significance, yet their intrinsic spectral architecture remains largely uncharted. In this work, using high quality data from the Human Connectome Project (HCP), we mathematically model and quantitatively characterize a robustly detectable “second peak” superimposed on the canonical exponentially decaying white matter BOLD spectrum. The spectral signature, with a peak frequency around ~ 0.06 Hz, emerges as a stable individual-level phenotype with broad spatial penetrance across white matter. Cross-tissue analyses reveal that while BOLD signals in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) exhibit similar low frequency dynamics, white matter provides the most prominent and organized manifestation of this spectral feature. Spatially, the peak follows distinct gradients that mirror macroscopic white matter anatomy. Exploratory analyses in the HCP-Aging cohort further suggest that this band-specific spectral signature undergoes systematic evolution with age. Synthesizing the frequency profile, spatial distribution, and aging trajectory, we propose that the white matter second peak may serve as an organized, tissue-modulated readout of ubiquitous low-frequency physiological dynamics, potentially linked to glymphatic or perivascular clearance mechanisms in the brain. Together, these findings point to a robust spectral phenotype that may open a new noninvasive dimension for investigating white matter functional integrity, brain aging, and relevant physiological mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用Human Connectome Project高质量静息态fMRI数据，对白质BOLD频谱中叠加在典型指数衰减背景上的稳定“第二峰”进行数学建模和定量表征。该谱特征峰值频率约为0.06 Hz，在个体层面稳定存在，并广泛分布于白质区域；与脑脊液等组织相比，白质中的表现更突出且更有组织性。空间上该峰呈现与宏观白质解剖相对应的梯度，HCP-Aging探索性分析还提示其可能随年龄发生系统变化。

articles.title: An immunological synapse network for recognition of persistent weak anomalies
articles.title_zh: 用于识别持续性弱异常的免疫突触网络
articles.abstract: Many time-series anomalies of practical consequence are not sharp spikes but weak deviations sustained across many consecutive samples. Standard deep-learning encoders, such as convolutional, recurrent and Transformer architectures, were not designed to distinguish whether faint evidence is transient or persistent. We introduce the Immunological Synapse Network (ISN), a differentiable architecture that maps four T-cell recognition mechanisms onto anomaly detection: a learned receptor scores local signal tokens by binding affinity; a kinetic proofreading cascade suppresses short-lived matches by requiring evidence to survive multiple sequential states; ITAM-like gates impose a learned threshold on each receptor; and a synapse-inspired spatial lattice concentrates surviving activations before classification. On a controlled synthetic benchmark whose label is recoverable only through temporal persistence, ISN is the only model that does not collapse to chance when its proofreading cascade is disabled, and it outperforms all baselines in full-model comparison. These results establish a clear operating boundary: immune-inspired persistence filtering earns its computational cost when anomalies are defined by temporal continuity, not by instantaneous magnitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对时间序列中幅度弱但持续时间长的异常提出免疫突触网络ISN，以弥补卷积、循环和Transformer编码器难以区分短暂噪声与持续证据的不足。模型将T细胞识别机制映射到异常检测中，包括学习型受体亲和评分、动力学校验级联、ITAM式门控阈值和突触式空间格点聚集。受控合成基准表明，在标签依赖时间持续性的任务上，ISN优于基线模型，并展示了持久性过滤机制适用的计算边界。

articles.title: Tri-Modal Contrastive Binary Analysis via Opcode Transformers, Control Flow Graph Isomorphism Networks, and System Call Embeddings: A Systematic Review of Zero-Day Malware Detection Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 基于操作码Transformer、控制流图同构网络和系统调用嵌入的三模态对比二进制分析：零日恶意软件检测框架系统综述
articles.abstract: Identifying zero-day malware variants and reverse-engineering compiled binaries requires robust code similarity analysis. Legacy inspection pipelines evaluate software through isolated feature streams---such as disassembly byte flows, control-flow graphs, or dynamic execution logs. Unimodal analysis fails when attackers apply UPX packing, instruction substitution, control-flow flattening, or sandbox-stalling logic. To overcome single-perspective blind spots, recent security systems adopt Multi-Modal Binary Similarity Analysis (MMBSA), embedding static syntax, structural graphs, and runtime behavior into unified neural latent spaces. Guided by the PRISMA 2020 framework, this systematic review synthesizes 15 primary benchmark frameworks and over 50 core papers published from 2020 through 2026. We construct a three-axis taxonomy organizing existing systems by feature ingestion streams, neural fusion strategies, and downstream tasks. In addition, we detail the mathematical mechanics of Tri-Modal Contrastive Representation Alignment. This framework aligns NLP Transformers (assembly opcodes), Graph Isomorphism Networks (topological control-flow graphs), and Bidirectional LSTMs (runtime syscall sequences) using pairwise InfoNCE loss and Volumetric Gramian Representation Alignment Measures (GRAM). Empirical evidence shows that attention-gated fusion maintains high detection accuracy (>98.5%) even under severe single-channel obfuscation. We conclude by identifying practical deployment bottlenecks---such as cross-ISA instruction drift and GPU memory limits on large graphs---and outlining targeted paths for production-grade threat intelligence systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述围绕零日恶意软件变体识别和编译二进制相似性分析，指出仅依赖字节流、控制流图或动态日志的单模态方法易受加壳、指令替换、控制流扁平化和沙箱规避影响。作者按PRISMA 2020框架综合2020–2026年15个主要基准框架和50余篇核心文献，建立按特征输入、神经融合策略和下游任务划分的三轴分类。文章重点梳理三模态对比表示对齐框架，将汇编操作码Transformer、控制流图同构网络和运行时系统调用序列嵌入统一到神经潜空间中。

articles.title: Large language models as uncertainty-calibrated optimizers for experimental discovery
articles.title_zh: 作为不确定性校准优化器的大语言模型用于实验发现
articles.abstract: Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 28 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01283-z Although language models can be helpful in molecular design, they are not typically calibrated for uncertainty. Rankovic and colleagues present a method to train language models while taking into account the uncertainty of the data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕将大语言模型用于分子设计和实验发现中的优化问题展开，重点解决语言模型通常缺乏可靠不确定性校准的局限。作者提出一种在训练语言模型时纳入数据不确定性的方法，使模型不仅生成候选方案，还能更好反映预测置信度。具体方法细节和实验结果需结合原文进一步查阅。

articles.title_zh: 塞曼场下t−t′−J模型中的d波FFLO态与电荷-2e超固态

The exotic Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state, in particular, remains in need of definitive study within fundamental electr… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094518] Published Fri Aug 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论强塞曼场下非常规超导，特别是超过Pauli顺磁极限时可能出现的Fulde–Ferrell–Larkin–Ovchinnikov态。基于t−t′−J模型，作者研究d波配对背景中的空间调制超导及其与电荷序的关系，并报道与电荷-2e超固态相关的量子态特征。摘要信息较简略，具体数值方法、相图和判据需查阅原文。
authors: Xing-Zhou Qu, Dai-Wei Qu, Qiaoyi Li, Wei Li, and Gang Su

articles.title_zh: 退火诱导的超导 NbRe 薄膜晶粒粗化与电压拐点

While bulk and thin-film polycrystalline NbRe are well studied, how supercond… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094209] Published Fri Aug 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究非中心对称超导体 NbRe 薄膜中退火对微结构与超导输运的影响。NbRe 具有较强反对称自旋—轨道耦合且适用于单光子探测，作者关注退火诱导的晶粒粗化如何改变薄膜超导特性，并报告输运曲线中的电压拐点现象。具体机制与定量结果需结合原文进一步查阅。

articles.title_zh: 二维 XY 模型中的有限温度自旋扩散

On the theory side, we leverage a recently developed dynamical high-temperature expansion method to faithfully capture the long spatiotemporal scales of t… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094303] Published Fri Aug 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合理论与实验，定量刻画平方晶格量子自旋 1/2 XY 模型在有限温度下的自旋扩散。理论上采用动力学高温展开方法，以捕捉长时空尺度的自旋输运行为，并与实验观测进行对照。工作旨在为二维量子磁体中的扩散动力学提供可检验的定量描述。

articles.title: Proof of the absence of local conserved quantities in general spin-frac12 chains with symmetric nearest-neighbor interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有对称最近邻相互作用的一般自旋 1/2 链中不存在局域守恒量的证明
articles.abstract: Author(s): Mizuki Sanatani, Yuuya Chiba, and Naoto Shiraishi Integrable quantum spin chains are distinguished by infinitely many nontrivial local conserved charges, whereas generic systems are expected to have none. Here, the authors prove this expectation for spin-½ chains with symmetric nearest-neighbor interactions. Outside the known integrable families, no model has even one such charge. Thus, within this class, there is no intermediate possibility: a chain is either in a known integrable family, with infinitely many such charges, or has none. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094437] Published Fri Aug 28, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文证明了在具有对称最近邻相互作用的一类自旋 1/2 链中，除已知可积族外不存在非平凡局域守恒量。结果表明，在该模型类内不存在“部分可积”的中间情形：系统要么属于已知可积族并拥有无穷多个局域守恒荷，要么一个也没有。该结论为区分量子自旋链的可积与非可积行为提供了严格判据。
authors: Mizuki Sanatani, Yuuya Chiba, and Naoto Shiraishi

Focusing on the flux-free sector of the Kitaev honeycomb model in a quasi-1D geometry, we uncover its topological nature and show that it hosts Majoran… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 105141] Published Fri Aug 28, 2026

authors: Yuki Yamazaki, Shingo Kobayashi, and Akira Furusaki

articles.title: Synthesis and Application in Cell Imaging of a Fluorescent Probe for Detection of Zn2+/S2- and Viscosity
articles.title_zh: 用于 Zn2+/S2− 与黏度检测的荧光探针合成及其细胞成像应用
articles.abstract: A fluorescent probe DBH with Schiff base structure was synthesized using 3,4-dimethoxybenzohydrazide and 3,5-di-tert-butyl-2-hydroxybenzaldehyde as starting materials. Spectroscopic studies showed that probe DBH can specifically recognize Zn2+ and S2− (DMF/H₂O = 5:5), exhibiting significant fluorescence enhancement effects for both. The detection limits (LOD) were determined to be 4.19 × 10− 7 mol/L for Zn2+ and 1.45 × 10− 7 mol/L for S2−. The binding mechanism of DBH with Zn2+/S2− was investigated through Job’s plot, NMR titration, mass spectrometry, and DFT calculations. Furthermore, probe’s low cytotoxicity and good biocompatibility enable the detection of exogenous Zn2+/S2− in living cells. In addition, the probe exhibits a distinct viscosity-responsive behavior, showing linear relationship between fluorescence intensity and system viscosity. Probe DBH has potential for real-time monitoring of styrene polymerization progress.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者以 3,4-二甲氧基苯甲酰肼和 3,5-二叔丁基-2-羟基苯甲醛为原料，合成了含 Schiff 碱结构的荧光探针 DBH。该探针在 DMF/H2O 体系中可特异识别 Zn2+ 和 S2−，分别给出显著荧光增强，检出限为 4.19×10−7 mol/L 和 1.45×10−7 mol/L，并通过 Job 曲线、核磁滴定、质谱和 DFT 计算分析结合机制。DBH 具有低细胞毒性和良好生物相容性，可用于活细胞外源 Zn2+/S2− 成像，同时对体系黏度呈线性荧光响应，有望用于实时监测苯乙烯聚合过程。

articles.title: Sea Level Change Assessment along the Egyptian Mediterranean Coast Using Multi-Source Data and Machine Learning Models
articles.title_zh: 基于多源数据与机器学习模型的埃及地中海沿岸海平面变化评估
articles.abstract: Changes in sea level are considered one of the most prominent indicators of climate change, as they result from the thermal expansion of seawater and the exchange of mass between oceans and land. In recent years, a slight rise in sea level has been observed, posing risks to coastal areas near the sea. The Egyptian coasts on the Mediterranean Sea are among the areas most exposed to these risks, due to the low elevation of coastal lands. In this study, more than one source was used, including combining GPS data with tide gauge data, only tide gauge data, and GRACE and Satellite Altimetry data. After that, these data were processed and analyzed using Python, employing the SARIMA method alongside machine learning methods (XGBOOST, CNN, LSTM). After analyzing these data, it was found that the best method was XGBOOST, with an R-squared of 0.97. The results of sea level changes were 1.45 from GRACE, 3.97 from Altimetry, 6.5 from GPS with tide gauge, and 3.6 from tide gauge. The satellite data showed the highest performance using the four models when analyzed, indicating their superior ability to calculate rates of sea level change After that, the prediction for this data was studied completely for the period from 2025 to 2050, where the data analysis showed that the rate of change ranges between 2.8 mm/year and 4.09 mm/year from GRACE and Altimetry. This indicates a rise in sea surface levels, which reflects the risk to the Egyptian coasts. Alexandria, Port Said, and El Arish are considered among the most coastal cities threatened by this risk, as highlighted by the results.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 GPS 与验潮站组合数据、单独验潮站数据、GRACE 及卫星测高数据，评估埃及地中海沿岸海平面变化风险。作者用 Python 实现 SARIMA 以及 XGBoost、CNN、LSTM 等模型进行分析，结果显示 XGBoost 表现最佳，R2 达 0.97。不同数据源给出的海平面变化率存在差异，其中卫星数据在多模型分析中表现较好，说明其对海平面变化率估计具有较强适用性。

articles.title: Ground-based Air-bearing Equivalent Verification for Active Vibration Isolation for Space Microgravity Utilization
articles.title_zh: 面向空间微重力应用主动隔振的地面气浮等效验证
articles.abstract: Ground-based verification of space active vibration isolation systems faces fundamental challenges because traditional gravity compensation methods - such as quasi-zero stiffness mechanisms, suspension systems, and magnetic levitation - cannot simultaneously realize an ideal microgravity state across multiple degrees of freedom (DOFs) due to mechanical coupling. Horizontal air-bearing systems can emulate the microgravity state in three DOFs simultaneously, but whether the air-bearing environment can serve as a faithful equivalent to true microgravity, and whether the system exhibits sufficient long-term stability, remain open questions. In this paper, we establish a dynamic model of the air-bearing system and theoretically analyze the equivalence of multi-DOF testing. We then design a verification environment comprising an air supply circuit, air-bearing structures, and a high-precision measurement and control system. Based on this platform, we conduct static control, wide-band excitation, and long-term stability tests on the active vibration isolation system, and evaluate the influence of the air-bearing environment on isolation performance. Both theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate that the air-bearing simulation method can effectively substitute for the space microgravity environment in verification, offering a viable technical pathway for performance testing of active vibration isolation systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对空间主动隔振系统地面验证中多自由度重力补偿困难的问题，研究水平气浮平台能否等效模拟微重力环境。作者建立气浮系统动力学模型，分析多自由度测试等效性，并搭建包含供气回路、气浮结构及高精度测控系统的验证平台。通过静态控制、宽频激励和长期稳定性试验，评估气浮环境对主动隔振性能的影响，旨在验证其作为地面等效测试手段的可靠性。

articles.title: An implication of activation functions for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve non-autonomous differential equations
articles.title_zh: 激活函数对物理信息神经网络求解非自治微分方程的影响
articles.abstract: Background: Activation functions play a fundamental role in artificial neural net works (ANNs) by introducing non-linearity, enabling approximation of complex dy namical behaviors. In differential equation learning models—especially Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)—performance varies dramatically depending on the acti vation function chosen. Although numerous activation functions have been proposed, determining the most effective option for solving differential equations remains an open research question.  Method: Weinvestigate the effectiveness of nine commonly used activation functions in solving first-order autonomous differential equations using a PINN framework. A benchmark set of ten non-autonomous ordinary differential equations (ODEs) con sisting of polynomial, exponential, and trigonometric functions were selected. Each ODE was trained using a fully-connected feed-forward neural network with identical architecture to isolate performance differences due solely to activation function choice.  Results and analysis: Results strongly indicate that GELU is the most robust activation function, achieving the smallest residual loss in over 50% of the exper iments. ELU and SELU followed closely, while Sigmoid and Softmax performed poorly due to saturation effects. A detailed comparison, graphical error profiles, and training stability characteristics are presented.  Conclusion: This study provides a clear empirical guideline for activation selec tion in neural differential solvers and highlights directions for future hybrid adaptive activation models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较九种常用激活函数在 PINN 框架下求解一阶非自治常微分方程的性能。作者选取包含多项式、指数和三角函数项的十个基准 ODE，并在相同全连接前馈网络结构下训练，以隔离激活函数本身的影响。结果表明 GELU 在超过半数实验中取得最低残差损失，整体鲁棒性最好，ELU 等函数也显示出一定竞争力。

articles.title: Design of A Novel Phosphohydrolase Mimic Enzyme And Its Enhanced Phosphohydrolase Activity for Rapid and Colorimetric Detection of Organophosphorus Pesticides
articles.title_zh: 新型磷酸水解酶模拟酶的设计及其增强磷酸水解活性用于有机磷农药快速比色检测
articles.abstract: Inspired by the structural biomimicry principles, we designed and fabricated a nanozyme mimic with high organophosphorus hydrolase activity——CeO2@ZIF-90 nanorods. And then a dual-mode biomimetic nanozyme sensor based on CeO2@ZIF-90 nanorods was proposed for rapid, colorimetric and electrochemical detection of OPs. In the presence of methyl parathion, the CeO2@ZIF-90 nanozyme catalyzed hydrolysis to generate para-nitrophenol (PNP), enabling dual-mode detection. In colorimetric sensing, the yellow color change afforded a linear range of 0.01–0.15 mM with a detection limit of 1.3 µM. In electrochemical sensing, the electroactive PNP provided a linear range of 5–80 µM and a detection limit of 0.51 µM. The nanozyme also showed excellent selectivity, anti-interference ability, reusability, and stability. Good recoveries of 99.9%–107.2% were obtained in spiked celery, apple, and grape samples, demonstrating its potential for rapid on-site monitoring of OP residues.Overall, the proposed CeO2@ZIF-90 nanozyme offers an efficient strategy for integrating catalytic degradation with separate colorimetric and electrochemical detection modes, providing a promising platform for rapid food safety monitoring and on-site residue analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者基于结构仿生思想构筑了具有有机磷水解酶活性的 CeO2@ZIF-90 纳米棒，并将其用于甲基对硫磷的快速比色与电化学双模式检测。该纳米酶催化甲基对硫磷水解生成对硝基苯酚，比色检测线性范围为 0.01–0.15 mM、检出限 1.3 µM，电化学检测线性范围为 5–80 µM、检出限 0.51 µM。材料表现出良好的选择性、抗干扰性、重复使用性和稳定性，在芹菜、苹果和葡萄加标样品中回收率为 99.9%–107.2%，适合食品安全现场监测。

articles.title: Exact pair density wave in topological moire flat bands and universal superfluid stiffness
articles.title_zh: 拓扑莫尔平带中的精确对密度波与普适超流刚度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26245v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pair-density waves (PDWs) are unconventional superconducting states beyond the BCS paradigm, but identifying them unambiguously in microscopic lattice models is generally challenging due to various competing orders. In particular, an exact realization of PDW in interacting models with topological bands remains elusive. Here we construct an interacting model on a twisted bilayer checkerboard lattice (TBCB) featuring topological flat bands, and rigorously show that an exact PDW ground state can be induced by quantum geometric nesting (QGN), owing to its momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry. We further prove that the superfluid stiffness of any nondegenerate QGN superconductor (including the PDW studied here and uniform superconductor) obeys the universal relation Dₛ₌₂Nₘ̊ fₗₐₜν(1-ν)mₘ̊ ₚₐᵢᵣ⁻¹, where Nₘ̊ fₗₐₜ, ν, and mₘ̊ ₚₐᵢᵣ are the number of flat bands, flat band filling, and the two-particle effective mass, respectively. Our results reveal a rich interplay among PDW order, quantum geometry, and band topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在扭转双层棋盘晶格的拓扑平带相互作用模型中，严格构造了由量子几何嵌套诱导的精确对密度波基态。其机制源于动量空间的非点式对称性，使非常规 PDW 序可在含拓扑能带的显微模型中被明确实现。作者进一步证明，任意非简并量子几何嵌套超导体的超流刚度满足只由平带数、填充和两粒子有效质量决定的普适关系，揭示 PDW 序、量子几何与能带拓扑之间的联系。
authors: Zhengzhi Wu, Ming-rui Li, Hong Yao

articles.title: Critical Properties and Glass Transitions in Randomly Coupled Fields
articles.title_zh: 随机耦合场中的临界性质与玻璃转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an assembly of N scalar fields coupled via a quenched random interaction, equivalent to a spin glass whose spins are promoted to d-dimensional fields. When N is large, the random coupling matrix produces a family of Gaussian universality classes whose critical exponents are determined by the behavior of the eigenvalue density near the spectral edge. For a Wigner matrix, the correlation length diverges at criticality but the susceptibility remains finite, and one-loop replica analysis supports an upper critical dimension of unity. In an exactly solvable spherical variant, the heat capacity jumps at the transition in d>1, and correlations remain pinned to their critical form throughout the glass phase, giving generic scale invariance despite the absence of a Goldstone mode.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察 N 个标量场通过淬火随机相互作用耦合的体系，可视为将自旋玻璃中的自旋推广为 d 维场。大 N 极限下，随机耦合矩阵产生一族高斯普适类，其临界指数由谱边附近本征值密度行为决定。对于 Wigner 矩阵，临界点处关联长度发散但磁化率有限，一圈复制分析支持上临界维数为 1；在可精确求解的球形变体中，d>1 时热容在转变处跳变，玻璃相内关联保持临界形式。

articles.title: Dynamical signatures of deconfined spinons in dimerized sawtooth chains
articles.title_zh: 二聚化锯齿链中退禁闭自旋子的动力学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the ground-state properties and dynamical response of the Heisenberg model on the sawtooth chain in and away from the exactly solvable valence-bond-solid (VBS) point. We employ U(1)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) methods to compute equilibrium diagnostics and the zero-temperature dynamical structure factor (DSF) Szz(q,ømega) across the dimerized phase, a valence-bond-ordered state in which the two symmetry-equivalent apex--base bonds of each triangle develop unequal spin correlations, probing the approach to the continuous lower phase boundary, the exact VBS point, and the approach to the first-order upper boundary. In every regime, the DSF is a broad continuum dominated by a bright band at its lower edge, with the intensity at the one-triplon energy ømega simeq JAB suppressed. We identify the spectrum as a deconfined two-spinon continuum of kink and antikink domain walls between the two degenerate singlet coverings. Closed-form spinon dispersions fix the continuum edges and track the dominant band across the zone in all three regimes, while an explicit finite-separation two-kink calculation in a constrained Hilbert space reproduces the measured intensity distribution. Our results provide a microscopic picture of fractionalized excitations in the dimerized sawtooth chain and are relevant to the recently discovered Ti³⁺ kagome fluorides, where strongly anisotropic exchange interactions can generate sawtooth-chain building blocks.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究锯齿链 Heisenberg 模型在精确可解价键固体点及其附近的基态性质和零温动力学结构因子。利用 U(1) 对称 DMRG 与 TDVP 方法，他们扫描二聚化相，包括接近连续下边界、精确 VBS 点和一级上边界的区域。结果显示动力学结构因子表现为宽连续谱，低能边缘存在强亮带而单三重态能量附近强度受抑，谱可解释为连接两个简并单态覆盖的 kink/antikink 畴壁组成的退禁闭双自旋子连续谱。
authors: Nishan Ranabhat, Brandon B. Le, Seung-Hun Lee, Gia-Wei Chern

articles.title: When dissipative steady states admit thermodynamic occupation laws
articles.title_zh: 耗散稳态何时服从热力学占据律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-equilibrium steady states (NESSs) generally lack thermodynamic occupation laws because finite stationary circulation and a globally exact rate-ratio field cannot coexist for the same Markov generator. Here we construct a sector-separated geometry that overcomes this incompatibility without arresting dissipation. Entropy-production exposure-and-separation excludes the entropy-producing state~0 from the conditional occupation manifold while retaining it in the dissipative full graph; physical returns i→0→0^ast become effectively Markovian in the strong-bias/rapid-reset (SR) limit. For a thermodynamically complete conditional manifold, autonomous redistribution (AR) eliminates residual futile circulation, making the rate-ratio one-form exact. Thermodynamic calibration gives Xᵢ₌β(Δμ- mathcal Fᵢcost) and pᵢ₌ₑXᵢ/Z_C, with Z_C=1+sumᵢ eXᵢ. Full-graph probabilities factorize exactly as P_α=(1-P₀₎ₚ_α. In the SR limit, the kinetic factor tends to unity while p_α→ eX_α/Zₘₐₜₕcal C, yielding P_α→ p_α while finite dissipation persists. Near AR, integrability is lost linearly in residual cycle current whereas dissipation begins quadratically. In the binary zero-cycle-rank limit, occupation redistributes autonomously under maintained Δμ bias, yielding the inverted Fermi--Dirac law, which is applied to thermal smearing in quantum-dot lasers. The framework provides constructive acquisition conditions and failure diagnostics for thermodynamic occupation laws in dissipative NESSs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论非平衡稳态中热力学占据律与有限稳态环流通常不相容的问题，并构造一种“扇区分离”几何来在保持耗散的同时恢复条件占据流形上的热力学形式。通过将产熵态从条件占据流形中排除、并在强偏置/快速重置极限下使返回过程有效马尔可夫化，作者得到精确的速率比一形式和玻尔兹曼型占据概率。结果表明，在自主再分配条件下全图概率可因子化，SR 极限中条件概率趋于热力学占据，而有限耗散仍可存在；偏离该条件时，可积性随残余循环流线性丧失，而耗散从二阶开始增加。

articles.title: Electronic Structure and Band-Edge Character of Ga-Substituted α-Al₂O₃: A First-Principles Study
articles.title_zh: Ga 取代 α-Al₂O₃ 的电子结构与带边特征：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26977v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a first-principles density functional theory study of substitutional Ga incorporation in an α-Al₂O₃₋derived host, isolating chemical embedding effects without explicit geometric quantum confinement. Using a 30-atom α-Al₂O₃ supercell with two substituted Ga atoms, we examine three nonequivalent Ga-pair configurations and combine configuration-dependent energetics, local structural analysis, Ga-centered distortion metrics, and electronic-structure calculations.% to establish the relationship between local coordination distortion and band-edge modification. The energetically preferred configuration is governed not solely by Ga--O bond expansion but by the ability of the host lattice to accommodate bond-length and angular distortions around substituted Ga centers. Ga incorporation narrows the band gap relative to pristine α-Al₂O₃ without generating mid-gap states, primarily modifying the conduction-band manifold while preserving the oxygen-dominated valence edge. Band-edge charge densities and charge-density-difference maps show that the electronic response remains localized around the Ga-centered coordination environment. These results establish a chemically resolved baseline for understanding Ga incorporation in ultrawide-band-gap oxides and for future studies of confinement and interface effects in Ga-containing oxide nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文用第一性原理密度泛函理论研究 α-Al₂O₃ 衍生宿主中取代 Ga 的化学嵌入效应，采用含两个 Ga 取代原子的 30 原子超胞并比较三种非等价 Ga 对构型。结果表明，稳定构型不仅由 Ga–O 键长扩张决定，还取决于晶格容纳 Ga 周围键长和键角畸变的能力。Ga 掺入使带隙相对本征 α-Al₂O₃ 缩小但不引入带隙中态，主要改变导带态，同时保持价带边以氧态为主；带边电荷密度响应局域在 Ga 配位环境附近。
authors: Z. S. Machavariani, R. Ya. Kezerashvili, T. Tchelidze

articles.title: Nonparametric multiscale modeling of boundary lubrication: hexadecane in highly pressurized gold asperity contacts
articles.title_zh: 边界润滑的非参数多尺度建模：高压金粗糙峰接触中的十六烷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Boundary lubrication is governed by molecular processes at the sliding interface that are inaccessible to classical continuum descriptions. While molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can resolve these processes in atomistic detail, incorporating their output into engineering-scale models through semi-empirical constitutive laws becomes increasingly difficult as confinement approaches the molecular scale. Here, we apply a nonparametric multiscale framework based on Gaussian process (GP) regression to model boundary lubrication of hexadecane confined between gold surfaces under pressures up to 1 GPa and gap heights down to 1.4 nm. The GP surrogates are trained on nonequilibrium MD simulations of the confined fluid and directly provide stress predictions to a continuum thin-film solver, circumventing the need for fixed-form constitutive laws. The framework naturally captures molecular phenomena such as density layering, viscosity changes, and the strongly nonlinear wall slip that dominates the frictional response at high pressures and small gap heights. Our results reproduce the atomistic benchmark data of Codrignani et al., demonstrating that nonparametric surrogate models offer a flexible and physically transparent route toward predictive continuum modeling of boundary lubrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将基于高斯过程回归的非参数多尺度框架用于描述十六烷在金表面间、最高约 1 GPa 压力和低至 1.4 nm 间隙下的边界润滑。模型由非平衡分子动力学数据训练，直接向连续薄膜求解器提供应力预测，从而避免预设半经验本构关系。该方法可自然捕捉分子尺度密度分层、黏度变化以及高压小间隙下主导摩擦响应的强非线性壁面滑移，并能复现实原子模拟基准结果。
authors: Hannes Holey, Michael Moseler, Peter Gumbsch, Lars Pastewka

articles.title: Band's Geometry Origin of Quantum Spin Transport Phenomena
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋输运现象的能带几何起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a geometric description of spin-dependent transport based on the local geometric structure of electronic bands and the Fermi surfaces. For quasi-two-dimensional systems, we show that hyperbolic regions of constant-energy surfaces generate a geometrical contribution to the Fermi velocity that couples naturally to electron spin and produces a spin-current response. We further show that, in the presence of time-reversal symmetry, the algebra of spin operators can be related to the exterior algebra of the band's tangent space, providing an additional geometric interpretation of spin in momentum space. This framework motivates a symplectic description of spin-separated transport on Fermi surfaces and its extension to three-dimensional band manifolds through contact geometry. Our results establish a direct connection between Fermi-surface geometry and intrinsic spin transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于电子能带局域几何结构和费米面的自旋相关输运描述。对于准二维体系，作者指出等能面中的双曲区域会产生几何性的费米速度贡献，并与电子自旋自然耦合，从而诱导自旋流响应。在时间反演对称存在时，自旋算符代数还可与能带切空间的外代数联系起来，进而支持用辛几何和接触几何描述费米面上的自旋分离输运及其三维推广。

articles.title: Least Variable Quantum Counting Processes
articles.title_zh: 最小波动量子计数过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Counting processes provide a fundamental description of stochastic events ranging from photon detection to clock ticks. A central question is how accurately such events can be timed when only finite memory resources are available. Here, we investigate this problem within a general framework of finite-dimensional classical and quantum counting processes. We derive a rigorous finite-memory variance bound obeyed by every classical d-state counting process, which is tight and saturated by a discrete Erlang-type ladder process. Through numerical optimization, we identify quantum counting processes that violate this classical bound, achieving smaller first-tick fluctuations than any classical process with the same memory size and mean tick time. For the qubit case, we further derive an analytical large-mean bound within a single-Kraus no-tick family, showing that the quantum advantage persists asymptotically within this class. The optimized quantum processes exhibit coherent conditioned dynamics and approach a continuous-time quantum-jump description as the mean increases. Our results establish a finite-memory quantum advantage in temporal precision and connect discrete-time counting processes with continuous-time quantum timekeeping.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究有限记忆资源下随机计数事件（如光子探测或时钟滴答）可达到的定时精度，并建立有限维经典与量子计数过程的统一框架。作者推导出所有经典 d 态计数过程必须满足的严格方差下界，该界可由离散 Erlang 型阶梯过程饱和。数值优化显示，量子计数过程可突破该经典界，在相同记忆大小和平均滴答时间下实现更小的首次滴答涨落；对量子比特情形，还在单 Kraus 无滴答族中给出大平均时间解析界，表明量子优势可渐近保持。
authors: Bita Olamaei, Florian Meier, Costantino Budroni, Pharnam Bakhshinezhad, Giuseppe Vitagliano

articles.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
articles.title_zh: 为什么 Cooper 对存在于 AdS₂ 中：Yukawa-SYK 模型的谱分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26251v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-N bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue kłeft(hi̊ght) analytically for arbitrary conformal weight h and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on m̊ dS₂, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to m̊ AdS₂ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in m̊ AdS₂, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从大 N 双局域有效作用量出发，建立 Yukawa–Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev 模型中 Cooper 配对几何表述的谱基础，并推导偶频自旋单态 Cooper 通道的高斯涨落核。作者解析求得任意共形权重下的核本征值，并将配对涨落分解为相关 de Sitter 空间拉普拉斯算符的连续谱与离散谱部分。结果显示，超导不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于连续散射谱中，离散模不临界；最低连续模附近的展开给出限制在连续谱子空间上的 dS₂ Klein–Gordon 作用量，该子空间可通过逆 Radon 变换映射到 AdS₂ 中的标量物质场。

articles.title: Quantum cellular automata and invertible phases of matter
articles.title_zh: 量子元胞自动机与可逆物质相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26456v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce and study (fermionic and bosonic) invertible quasi-local algebras over uniformly locally finite metric spaces X with infinite-dimensional local von Neumann algebras. We show that the group of Brauer equivalence classes of such algebras is isomorphic to both the group of phases of invertible states and the group of stable equivalence classes of quantum cellular automata over X× Z. Using K-theory of the symmetric monoidal category of invertible quasi-local algebras and bounded spread isomorphisms, we propose a definition of an Ømega-spectrum of invertible phases as conjectured by Kitaev. We then show that the c=frac12 chiral Majorana fermion net and the (E₈)₁ conformal net provide Brauer non-trivial invertible quasi-local algebras, thus providing explicit constructions of non-trivial invertible states and quantum cellular automata on Z². In addition, we show that the time-slice nets of rational diagonal conformal field theories admit lattice degrees of freedom, which implies the discretization of any holomorphic conformal net is invertible.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文引入并研究定义在一致局部有限度量空间上的玻色/费米可逆准局域代数，局域代数取无限维 von Neumann 形式。作者证明这类代数的 Brauer 等价类群同构于可逆态的相群，也同构于定义在 X×Z 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群。基于可逆准局域代数和有界传播同构的对称幺半范畴 K 理论，文中提出 Kitaev 所猜想的可逆相 Ω-谱定义，并给出手征 Majorana 费米子网和 (E₈)₁ 共形网导致非平凡 Brauer 类的显式构造，从而在二维晶格上实现非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机。
authors: Corey Jones, Nikita Sopenko, Ryan Thorngren

articles.title: Measuring the Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ Landé g-factor Using Singlet-Triplet Oscillations in a Circular Rydberg State of Strontium
articles.title_zh: 利用锶圆形 Rydberg 态中的单重态-三重态振荡测量 Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ Landé g 因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26784v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Circular states of strontium are promising platforms for quantum technologies. They exhibit much longer lifetimes than laser-accessible Rydberg states and possess an optically active ionic core that can be manipulated with laser light. Here we trap circular states in optical tweezers by exploiting the dynamical polarizability of the ionic core. We measure the decay of the orbital component of a n=51 circular state and observe singlet-triplet spin oscillations arising from the interplay of vector light shifts induced by the optical tweezers, spin-orbit coupling associated with the Rydberg electron, and the difference in Landé g-factor between the ionic core and the Rydberg electrons. By observing the two electron spin dynamics, we measure the spin-orbit interaction and the correction δ g sim 10⁽⁻⁵⁾ of the Landé g-factor of the Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ ionic core electron with respect to that of a free electron. This provides a first high-precision measurement of g_Sr⁺, 5s₁/₂ = 2.002290(1).
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用锶原子圆形 Rydberg 态作为量子技术平台，并通过离子芯的动态极化率将其俘获在光镊中。实验测量 n=51 圆形态轨道分量的衰减，并观测由光镊矢量光移、Rydberg 电子自旋轨道耦合以及离子芯与 Rydberg 电子 Landé g 因子差异共同导致的单重态-三重态自旋振荡。通过双电子自旋动力学，作者测得自旋轨道相互作用以及 Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ 离子芯电子相对自由电子 g 因子的约 10⁻⁵ 修正，给出 g_Sr⁺,5s₁/₂ = 2.002290(1) 的高精度结果。
authors: Baptiste Muraz, Mathis Pepin, Corentin Guimard, Michel Brune, Brice Bakkali-Hassani, Sébastien Gleyzes

articles.title: Geometric optimality of entanglement-induced fast qubit reset
articles.title_zh: 纠缠诱导快速量子比特重置的几何最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26897v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fast and reliable qubit reset is essential for the efficient operation of quantum processors. Among the proposed strategies, Mpemba-effect-based protocols offer a simple route to accelerated relaxation, but provide limited insight into the optimality of the full reset dynamics. Geometric approaches, by contrast, quantify optimality but do not generally suggest practical acceleration protocols. Here, we bridge these perspectives through a geometric analysis of entanglement-assisted qubit reset. We show that entangling operations can redistribute local coherences across a multi-qubit register, allowing the reduced state of each qubit to follow a geodesic path towards the ground state. Remarkably, this locally optimal behaviour can emerge even when the collective evolution becomes suboptimal in the full state space. We illustrate this interplay for different families of initial multi-qubit states. Our results provide a geometric perspective on Mpemba-inspired reset acceleration and clarify when extending two-qubit protocols to larger registers provides a further advantage in the reset process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从几何角度分析纠缠辅助量子比特快速重置，连接 Mpemba 效应式加速协议与量子态空间中最优路径的描述。作者表明，纠缠操作可在多量子比特寄存器内重新分配局域相干性，使每个量子比特的约化态沿测地线路径趋向基态。值得注意的是，即便整体多体演化在完整态空间中并非最优，局域重置仍可呈现几何最优行为；文中还比较了不同初始多量子比特态族，并讨论两比特协议推广到更大寄存器时何时带来额外优势。
authors: Davide Rinaldi, Mattia Moroder, Dario Gerace, Giacomo Guarnieri, Steve Campbell

articles.title: Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
articles.title_zh: Packora：用于生成式分子晶体结构预测的系统化设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26962v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Packora，一种用于分子晶体结构预测的流模型生成器，可从分子图联合预测原子坐标和晶格。该模型支持多组分和有机金属晶体，并能在同一框架中条件化使用任意子集的分子构象、立体化学标签和空间群信息。作者借鉴 CCDC 晶体结构预测盲测，将结构生成与排序分开评估，并系统考察网络结构、训练、条件化、推理和尺度扩展因素；结果显示，基于可缓存成对推理、合适训练目标与数值求解器、条件 dropout 以及表示尺度均衡的设计在生成和排序任务上优于基线。
authors: Nayoung Kim, Kiyoung Seong, Sungsoo Ahn

articles.title: Fast On-Chip Thermometry with TiN Kinetic Inductance Resonators in 22 nm Process Technology
articles.title_zh: 22 nm 工艺中基于 TiN 动能电感谐振器的快速片上测温
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27057v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding the temporal and spatial dependence of temperature is critical in high-performance cryogenic devices. Typical thermometry techniques struggle to simultaneously combine high bandwidth, sensitivity and on-chip integration, limiting their ability to measure fast intra-device thermal fluctuations. Here, we demonstrate a time-resolved thermometry platform based on TiN kinetic inductance resonators integrated in a 22 nm FDSOI chip. By tracking temperature-dependent shifts in the resonant frequency, we achieve sub-millikelvin temperature sensitivity down to temperatures of 100 mK. Time-resolved on-chip pulsed heating experiments as a function of distance reveal an onset delay, consistent with a quasi-ballistic heat propagation velocity of 3.9 ± 0.1 mm μs{}⁻¹. We also show that elevated temperatures increase net thermal conductance, shortening thermal relaxation times across all spatial separations. This behaviour manifests in two distinct regimes: a substrate-limited regime at 100 mK, where cooling rates vary with heater distance, and a Kapitza boundary-limited regime at 400 mK, where thermal relaxation becomes more spatially uniform.These measurements demonstrate kinetic inductance thermometry's ability to rapidly probe non-equilibrium temperature dynamics in cryogenic devices such as quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文展示了一种集成在 22 nm FDSOI 芯片上的 TiN 动能电感谐振器时间分辨测温平台，用于低温高性能器件中的快速片上热涨落测量。通过跟踪谐振频率随温度的变化，系统在低至 100 mK 条件下实现亚毫开尔文温度灵敏度。片上脉冲加热实验揭示随距离变化的热响应起始延迟，对应约 3.9 ± 0.1 mm μs⁻¹ 的准弹道热传播速度；升高温度会增加净热导并缩短热弛豫时间，表现出 100 mK 下受衬底限制和 400 mK 下受 Kapitza 边界限制的不同热输运机制。
authors: Johann Drayne, George Ridgard, Lorenzo Peri, Frederic Schlattner, Fabio Olivieri, Mathieu de Kruijf, Isaac Harris, Grayson Noah, James Kirkman, Alberto Gomez-Saiz, M. Fernando Gonzalez-Zalba, Thomas Swift

articles.title: Programmable Cavity Squeezing for Distributed Sensing in a Tweezer Array
articles.title_zh: 镊阵列中用于分布式传感的可编程腔压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Field sensing with state-of-the-art atom interferometers is restricted to the use of uncorrelated devices op- erating in parallel. We can overcome this limitation by using distributed sensing protocols where quantum correlations among spatially-separated devices are engineered in the spatial mode carrying the signal. We show that a tweezer array in a cavity offers an ideal testbed to engineer quantum states for distributed sensing, with the possibility to generate entanglement both within and between the clouds. The competition between local and intercloud cavity-mediated exchange allows the sign and spatial pattern of the intercloud couplings to select the squeezed mode. For two ensembles, positive coupling produces uniform collective squeezing, whereas negative coupling generates strong staggered, nonlocal squeezing. A semiclassical analysis reveals a counter-twisting- like phase-space flow, qualitatively distinct from standard one-axis twisting. The analysis and results can be further generalized to a larger number of ensembles. We apply the scheme to differential Ramsey interferometry with common phase noise spanning the full 2 π range, the resulting staggered states reduce the phase uncertainty below the standard quantum limit, with an ellipse estimator approaching the Cramèr-Rao bound. These results establish programmable cavity interactions as a scalable route to entanglement tailored to distributed signals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出利用腔中光镊阵列为分布式量子传感制备可编程压缩态，以克服传统原子干涉仪多为互不关联并行运行的限制。方案可在原子云内部及原子云之间产生纠缠，局域与云间腔介导交换的竞争使云间耦合的符号和空间分布能够选择被压缩的空间模式。对于两个系综，正耦合产生均匀集体压缩，负耦合产生强交错的非局域压缩；半经典分析显示其相空间流类似反扭转且区别于标准单轴扭转，并可推广到更多系综及差分 Ramsey 干涉测量场景。
authors: Youssef Trifa, Marco Fattori, Luca Pezzè

articles.title: Stochastic transport of a Goldstone mode in a self-organized atomic crystal
articles.title_zh: 自组织原子晶体中 Goldstone 模的随机输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27387v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spontaneous breaking of a continuous symmetry produces a massless Goldstone mode that can evolve across a degenerate manifold at zero energy cost. Goldstone modes have been identified primarily through excitation spectra, mode softening or collective oscillations. However, their time-domain transport under intrinsic fluctuations and dissipation has remained largely unexplored. Here we directly track the stochastic transport of a Goldstone mode in a self-organized atomic crystal inside an optical ring cavity. The ring cavity maps the order-parameter phase onto the real-space position of the emergent crystal. Without any external perturbation, fundamental photon-scattering recoil drives the collective transport, while cavity dissipation generates friction. We monitor individual trajectories of the atoms and their self-generated optical lattice by measuring the cavity output phase. We find that the diffusion constant decreases as 1/N, indicating that all atoms move collectively as a rigid object rather than independently. By tuning the Langevin driving force and cavity-mediated damping, we show that the normalized diffusion constant collapses onto a single universal curve. This work extends the study of continuous symmetry breaking from excitation-frequency measurements to real-time tracking of transport, and opens routes for studying non-equilibrium collective transport, phonon dynamics, and defect formation in driven-dissipative quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在光学环形腔内的自组织原子晶体中，直接跟踪连续对称性自发破缺产生的 Goldstone 模在时间域中的随机输运。环形腔将序参量相位映射为涌现晶体的实空间位置；无外加扰动时，光子散射反冲提供 Langevin 驱动，腔耗散提供摩擦。通过测量腔输出相位监测原子及其自生光晶格轨迹，作者发现扩散常数随原子数按 1/N 降低，表明原子作为刚体式集体模式运动。
authors: Zhanhai Yu, Di Xiang, Xiaotian Zhang, Hao Zhang

articles.title: Detuning- and Stark-robust Rydberg gates
articles.title_zh: 对失谐和 Stark 位移鲁棒的 Rydberg 量子门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27426v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rydberg entangling gates driven by a two-photon transition in alkali atoms suffer from an adverse scaling of light-shift-induced errors. Robustness to such detuning errors is known to be impossible to achieve in the design of conventional Rydberg gate protocols, where only one of the qubit states is coupled to the Rydberg state. Here, we show that in a more general framework, in which both qubit states take part in the gate, full or partial robustness to these errors can be realized. We present two gate constructions, which either cancel the errors outright or convert them into single-qubit errors that can be corrected locally. We map the regimes -- in terms of light-shift strength, intensity inhomogeneity, and Rydberg decay rate -- in which these protocols outperform the widely used time-optimal Rydberg gate, and find that they already include the conditions of state-of-the-art experiments. Finally, we show the existence of a Rydberg `fly-by' entangling gate, an important primitive for an emerging class of neutral-atom quantum computing architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对碱金属原子双光子驱动 Rydberg 纠缠门中由光移导致的失谐误差，提出同时让两个量子比特态参与门操作的更一般方案。作者给出两类门构造：一种直接抵消误差，另一种将误差转化为可局域校正的单量子比特误差。通过比较光移强度、强度不均匀性和 Rydberg 衰减率等参数区间，论文指出这些方案在当前先进实验条件下已可优于常用时间最优 Rydberg 门，并讨论了 Rydberg “fly-by”纠缠门的存在性。
authors: Elie Bataille, Gyohei Nomura, Manuel Endres

articles.title: Fast optical data transfer into a Josephson junction array
articles.title_zh: 向 Josephson 结阵列的高速光学数据传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.05074v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We employ externally shunted Nb-AlOₓ₋Nb Josephson junctions for demonstrating a circuit that is suitable for an optically driven Josephson Arbitrary Waveform Synthesizer (JAWS). This technology enables overdamped junctions with characteristic frequencies above 100 GHz and critical currents of the order of 100 μA, which is promising, e.g., for low-dissipation optical control of quantum circuits such as superconducting quantum bits. Here we utilize a double-pulse technique to experimentally determine the maximum rate at which optical pulse data can be reliably delivered to the superconducting circuit. We demonstrate the feasibility of data transfer up to 60 Gbit/s, which is about factor 4 higher than for typical JAWS.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者采用外部分流的 Nb-AlOx-Nb Josephson 结，演示了适用于光驱动 Josephson 任意波形合成器的超导电路。该技术可实现特征频率超过 100 GHz、临界电流约 100 μA 的过阻尼结，适合低耗散光学控制超导量子电路。通过双脉冲技术，实验测得光脉冲数据可靠注入超导电路的最高速率可达 60 Gbit/s，约为典型 JAWS 的 4 倍。
authors: K. Kohopää, J. Nissilä, E. Mykkänen, P. Selvasundaram, T. Fordell, K. Langi, E. T. Mannila, S. Kafanov, S. Ahopelto, H. Systä, M. Ribeiro, P. Sethi, M. Kiviranta, R. Loreto, J. -W. Lee, T. Rantanen, V. Vesterinen, O. Kieler, M. Bieler, J. Govenius, J. Senior, A. Kemppinen

articles.title: Photoinduced Metal-to-Insulator Transitions in 2D Moiré Devices
articles.title_zh: 二维莫尔器件中的光诱导金属—绝缘体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.21005v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Photoexcitation has been utilized to control quantum matter and to uncover metastable phases far from equilibrium. Among demonstrations to date, the most common is the photo-induced transition from correlated insulators to metallic states; however, the reverse process without initial orders has not been observed. Here, we show ultrafast metal-to-insulator transition in gate-doped WS2/WSe2 and WSe2/WSe2 moiré devices using photo-thermionic hole injection from graphite gates. The resulting correlated insulators are metastable, with lifetimes exceeding microseconds. These findings establish an effective mechanism for the ultrafast control of correlated electronic phases in van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了在栅掺杂 WS2/WSe2 和 WSe2/WSe2 莫尔器件中，通过石墨栅的光热电子空穴注入实现超快金属到绝缘体转变。与常见的光诱导关联绝缘体熔化为金属态相反，作者展示了在无初始有序态条件下生成关联绝缘态的过程。所形成的关联绝缘体为亚稳态，寿命超过微秒，为范德华异质结构中关联电子相的超快控制提供了机制。
authors: Yiliu Li, Esteban Rojas-Gatjens, Yinjie Guo, Birui Yang, Dihao Sun, Luke Holtzman, Juseung Oh, Katayun Barmak, Cory R. Dean, James C. Hone, Nathaniel Gabor, Eric A. Arsenault, Xiaoyang Zhu

articles.title: Automatic generation of exchange-correlation response kernels
articles.title_zh: 交换-关联响应核的自动生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computing density-functional response properties requires contracting derivatives of the exchange--correlation (xc) energy with perturbed densities on a grid. While the xc functional's derivatives have long been available to high orders from libraries such as Libxc, the surrounding contraction layer - the chain rule that combines them with the grid-based basis-function and density data into the total xc contribution - has instead been hand-derived and hand-coded in every program, for every functional family, spin case, and property. We present libxckernel, a library that automatically generates this layer by symbolic differentiation. The xc functional's ingredients are expressed as sesquilinear forms in the density matrix, so the xc energy can be differentiated to any order while the functional derivatives remain opaque. The basis functions and the orbital coefficients may both be complex. The chain rule then produces any xc matrix element: Fock matrices, orbital Hessians, and response terms of any order. Terms sharing a pattern are collapsed for efficiency. Extensible plugins emit the expressions as NumPy Einstein sums, compiled C kernels with C++/Fortran interfaces, or host-program specific source code. libxckernel is free and open-source software under the BSD-3-Clause license, enabling rapid implementation of functionality missing from many electronic structure programs. We demonstrate it by extending Psi4 with meta-generalized gradient approximation (mGGA) response kernels for orbital stability analysis and time-dependent density-functional theory (TD-DFT), GGA and mGGA analytic nuclear Hessians, and exact quadrature grid response, and by extending GPAW with mGGA and triplet TD-DFT kernels and gradient-corrected kernels for periodic dielectric response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍 libxckernel：一个通过符号微分自动生成密度泛函理论中交换-关联响应收缩层的库。传统程序需手工推导并编码交换-关联能量导数与格点密度、基函数数据之间的链式法则收缩，而该库将泛函成分表示为密度矩阵的半双线性形式，可在保持泛函导数黑箱化的同时生成任意阶交换-关联矩阵元。其目标覆盖 Fock 矩阵、轨道 Hessian 和高阶响应项，并支持复基函数与复轨道系数及多种代码生成后端。

articles.title: Ultra-broadband transient absorption down to 200 nm enabled by soliton dynamics in gas-filled hollow capillary fibers
articles.title_zh: 气体填充空芯毛细管中孤子动力学实现低至 200 nm 的超宽带瞬态吸收
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The deep ultraviolet (DUV) window (200-300 nm) is essential for the characterization of (bio)chemical and material systems through the UV signatures of nucleobases, amino acids, peptide bonds, many organic moieties, and wide bandgap transitions. However, extending ultrafast spectroscopy to the DUV to access the associated electronic and structural dynamics has largely remained elusive, due to the limited bandwidth and efficiency of common femtosecond DUV pulse sources. We now close this gap and demonstrate ultra-broadband femtosecond transient absorption (TA) spanning 200-800 nm, achieving unprecedented coverage of the entire DUV window. We generate supercontinuum probe pulses through soliton self-compression in a helium-filled hollow capillary fiber at a repetition rate of 20 kHz and fully suppress their high intrinsic intensity fluctuations via a correlation matrix referencing scheme. We thus achieve detector-noise-limited TA measurements with an exceptional resolution of 9 μOD in one second, and demonstrate these novel capabilities by resolving the ultrafast spin-crossover dynamics of a Fe(II) complex in the DUV. This work opens the path to unravel previously inaccessible photophysical and photochemical dynamics encoded in the DUV.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用氦气填充空芯毛细管中的孤子自压缩产生超连续谱探测脉冲，实现覆盖 200–800 nm 的飞秒瞬态吸收测量，完整进入深紫外窗口。通过相关矩阵参比方案抑制超连续谱固有强度涨落，实验达到探测器噪声受限的灵敏度，1 秒积分下分辨率为 9 μOD。该技术被用于解析 Fe(II) 配合物在深紫外区的超快自旋交叉动力学，为研究生物化学分子和宽带隙材料的深紫外电子结构动力学提供了工具。
authors: Pieter J. Brongers, Kyle Barlow, Deepjyoti Satpathy, John C. Travers, Christian Brahms, Malte Oppermann

articles.title: Franson-Interferometric Bounds on Entangled Two-Photon Absorption
articles.title_zh: 基于 Franson 干涉的纠缠双光子吸收界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entangled photons offer quantum correlations with no classical analogue. In entangled pair two-photon absorption (ETPA), absorption rate is predicted to scale linearly rather than quadratically with photon flux, promising molecular excitation at fluxes far below the classical threshold. Reported ETPA cross sections nevertheless vary widely across experiments, largely since the observable, the differential of the transmitted flux or weak fluorescence, is difficult to separate from scattering and linear losses. We present a method which uses Franson interference to study entangled two-photon absorption through delay-dependent coincidence measurements on dye molecules. Applying the method to Rhodamine 6G, we observe a small asymmetry in the Franson interference envelope and obtain a model-derived effective cross section of approximately 2.1 E(-21) centimeter squared for Rhodamine 6G. However, the estimated systematic uncertainty does not allow a definitive ETPA assignment. Instead, the experiment establishes a quantitative bound on the ETPA response and provides a background-free benchmark for future measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用 Franson 干涉，通过延迟依赖的符合计数来研究染料分子的纠缠双光子吸收，以减少传统透射差分或弱荧光测量中散射和线性损耗背景的干扰。对罗丹明 6G 的测量显示 Franson 干涉包络存在小不对称性，并由模型得到约 2.1×10⁻²¹ cm² 的有效截面。由于系统不确定度仍较大，作者未给出确定的 ETPA 归因，而是建立了定量上限和无背景基准。
authors: Albin Hedse, Sankaran Ramesh, Luis Matheis, Sebastian Gstir, Andreas Wacker, Gregor Weihs, Robert Keil, Qi Shi, Amitav Sahu, Tõnu Pullerits

articles.title: Detuning-robust Rydberg entangling gates from echoed pulses
articles.title_zh: 由回波脉冲实现的抗失谐 Rydberg 纠缠门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26446v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rydberg-based two-qubit gate fidelities in neutral atom arrays are limited chiefly by laser intensity inhomogeneity and by detuning errors from frequency miscalibration, background-field drift, intermediate state light shift and Doppler shifts. Quantum optimal control can suppress the former, but no pulse can render a controlled-Z gate first-order insensitive to detuning. Here we show that this obstruction can be circumvented by designing Rydberg gate pulses with every leading-order detuning error relegated to single-qubit Z-rotations, which an echoed sequence removes. The resulting maximally-entangling ZZ gate has no leading-order response to arbitrary detunings on either atom, maintaining an infidelity below 10⁻³ much wider range of single-atom detunings than previous gate designs. We further show that a large fraction of residual error is dominated by population outside the computational subspace, which can be converted into heralded erasures. Our results significantly reduce the requirements on laser frequency stability and intensity homogeneity, field calibration and atomic temperature toward practical fault-tolerant quantum computing with neutral atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对中性原子阵列 Rydberg 双量子比特门中由频率标定、背景场漂移、中间态光移和多普勒效应引起的失谐误差，提出将一阶失谐误差全部转化为单量子比特 Z 旋转并用回波序列消除的设计。所得最大纠缠 ZZ 门对任一原子的任意失谐均无一阶响应，在比以往设计更宽的单原子失谐范围内保持低于 10⁻³ 的失真。作者还指出残余误差中相当部分来自计算子空间外布居，可转化为可标记的擦除错误，从而降低容错量子计算对稳定性和温度的要求。
authors: Zhubing Jia, Yichao Yu, Xiye Hu, Lintao Li, Jacob Zheng, Christopher Monroe, Jacob P. Covey

articles.title: Evaluating Quantum Kernel Methods for Track-Based Classification in High-Energy Physics
articles.title_zh: 面向高能物理径迹分类的量子核方法评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27333v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a systematic design for large-scale quantum kernel classification, demonstrated through a quantum support vector classifier (QSVC) for particle-track classification using centroid-based CLAS12 drift-chamber features. Each event is encoded into a six-qubit state via a fully entangled ZZFeatureMap, whose fidelities define a quantum kernel within a standard SVM framework. By decoupling state preparation from kernel construction and distributing evaluation across a multi-node MPI-based HPC allocation, the approach scales to 1.0x10⁵ training and 4.0x10⁵ test events with an exactly constructed kernel matrix, to our knowledge more than an order of magnitude larger than prior high-energy-physics quantum-kernel studies. Benchmarked against linear, polynomial, RBF, and sigmoid SVM kernels and extremely randomized trees (ERT), the ideal QSVC achieves the highest recall (99.99%) among all models. Under a calibrated hardware noise model (FakeMumbaiV2, 500 training / 2,000 test events), AUC falls from 0.9985 to 0.9671 and peak significance improvement falls from 17.5 to ~3.5, yet recall remains at 99.51% -- indicating this signal-retention advantage is attenuated but not eliminated by circuit-level decoherence. Geometric analysis of the quantum embedding shows near-orthogonal inter-class states with coherent intra-class neighborhoods under ideal simulation; under noise this structure compresses toward the maximally mixed state while preserving its relative ordering. These results demonstrate a scalable, reproducible workflow for quantum kernel experimentation at HEP-relevant scale, quantifying the practical cost of realistic hardware noise on quantum-enhanced classification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作系统设计并评估了大规模量子核分类方法，用量子支持向量分类器处理基于 CLAS12 漂移室质心特征的粒子径迹分类。每个事件被编码为六量子比特全纠缠 ZZFeatureMap 态，其保真度定义量子核，并通过 MPI 高性能计算并行精确构造核矩阵，规模达到 10⁵ 个训练事件和 4×10⁵ 个测试事件。理想 QSVC 在召回率上达到 99.99%，优于多种经典 SVM 核和极端随机树；在校准硬件噪声模型下 AUC 和显著性提升下降，但召回率仍保持 99.51%。

articles.title: Population Metrology of a Hidden Exciton Reservoir: Quasi-Thermalization versus Localization
articles.title_zh: 隐藏激子库的布居计量：准热化与局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Long-lived dark states can dominate the lowest-energy manifold of optically driven quantum materials, yet their occupation remains difficult to quantify, leaving it unclear whether it reflects thermal redistribution or kinetic trapping. We combine microsphere-enabled far-field access with quantitative optical-response calibration to retrieve dark-to-bright population ratios in monolayer WSe2. Temperature-dependent measurements and controlled defect enhancement separate mobile and localized contributions. Near room temperature, the mobile dark-to-bright ratio reaches approximately 65% of its Boltzmann limit, indicating substantial but incomplete quasi-thermalization, whereas the low-temperature excess is dominated by defect-assisted localization. Dark-state dominance alone therefore does not establish equilibration, a distinction essential for interpreting transport and collective phases in optically hidden quasiparticle reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合微球辅助远场访问和定量光学响应标定，测量单层 WSe2 中暗态与亮态激子的布居比，以区分热重分布和动力学俘获。温度依赖实验与受控缺陷增强显示，近室温下可移动暗态-亮态比约达到玻尔兹曼极限的 65%，说明存在显著但不完全的准热化。低温下的额外暗态布居主要由缺陷辅助局域化贡献，因此暗态占优本身并不能证明体系已达到平衡。
authors: Guangyu Dai, Xinyu Zhang, Jiaxin Yu, Zi'ang Xing, Miao Cai, Zhaoqi Gu, Junyuan Zhang, Lin Dou, Fuxing Gu, Yiming Zhu, Songlin Zhuang

articles.title: A brief history of quantum vs classical computational advantage
articles.title_zh: 量子与经典计算优势简史
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.14703v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this review article we summarize all experiments claiming quantum computational advantage to date. Our review highlights challenges, loopholes, and refutations appearing in subsequent work to provide a complete picture of the current statuses of these experiments. In addition, we also discuss theoretical computational advantage in example problems such as approximate optimization and recommendation systems. Finally, we review recent experiments in quantum error correction -- the biggest frontier to reach experimental quantum advantage in Shor's algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述总结了迄今声称实现量子计算优势的实验，并梳理后续工作中提出的挑战、漏洞和反驳，以评估各实验的当前状态。文章还讨论了近似优化、推荐系统等问题中的理论计算优势主张。最后，作者回顾了量子纠错的最新实验进展，强调其是通向 Shor 算法等实用量子优势的关键前沿。

articles.title: SWCNTs thin film transistor circuits fabricated on flexible substrates with inkjet-printed silver electrodes for photodetectors
articles.title_zh: 用于光探测器的柔性基底喷墨银电极 SWCNT 薄膜晶体管电路
articles.abstract: We demonstrate thin film transistors (TFTs) and PMOS inverter circuit using drop casted single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) as active semiconductor and spin-coated poly(4-vinylphenol) (PVP) dielectric on a flexible polyethylene naphthalate (PEN) substrate of 125-µm-thick. All the electrodes were inkjet-printed using silver ink. The fabricated TFTs exhibit a linear field-effect mobility of 2.43 cm2V−1s− 1, while the saturated-load PMOS inverter achieves a voltage gain of 1.5 at a supply voltage of -15 V. The optoelectronic characteristics of these TFTs are systematically investigated under white-light illumination by monitoring drain-current (ID) transients at different gate voltages (VGS). The transfer characteristics reveal a reversal in hysteresis direction between dark and illuminated conditions, indicating that photo-induced charge-carrier recombination governs the device response. Under positive gate bias, the TFTs exhibit a pronounced and fully reversible photoresponse, with the drain current recovering completely after the light is switched off. In contrast, under negative gate bias, illumination suppresses the drain current, and the stretched-exponential transient decay becomes progressively faster with increasing negative VGS, reflecting Fermi-level-dependent carrier dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在 125 μm 厚 PEN 柔性基底上制备了以滴涂单壁碳纳米管为有源半导体、旋涂 PVP 为介电层、喷墨打印银为电极的薄膜晶体管及 PMOS 反相器。器件线性场效应迁移率为 2.43 cm2 V⁻¹ s⁻¹，饱和负载 PMOS 反相器在 -15 V 电源电压下实现 1.5 的电压增益。白光照射下的瞬态漏电流和转移特性表明，暗态与光照下迟滞方向反转，说明光诱导载流子复合主导响应；正栅压下光响应显著且可完全恢复，负栅压下光照抑制漏电流并呈拉伸指数衰减特征。

articles.title: Evolution and Analysis of Biomolecule Induced Gate-All-Around CNT FET for Nanoscale Biosensing
articles.title_zh: 用于纳米尺度生物传感的生物分子诱导全包围碳纳米管FET的演化与分析
articles.abstract: Evolution and analysis of gate-all-around carbon-nanotube field-effect-transistors (GAA CNT FETs) on incorporating various functionalized biomolecules in (19,0) CNT channels form biosensors at nano regime employing non-equilibrium Green's function is the advent in today’s era. To investigate nanoscale biosensing, a 10 nm gate-all-around (GAA) CNT FET was employed, where glucose, biotin, cellulose, and a haemoglobin-derived peptide fragment (residues 64–76) were covalently functionalized onto the gated CNT channel, modulating NEGF-based quantum transport and producing distinct biomolecule-specific electrical signatures. Glucose- and biotin-based CNT FETs observe reduced OFF current ~ 97% and ~ 96%, respectively, in comparison to bare CNT FET, whereas the haemoglobin-fragment-functionalized device achieves the highest ON current of the simulated structures, 44.3 µA µm⁻¹, due to quantum-confined carrier transport enabling selective label-free biosensing. Enhanced sensitivity for glucose-based biosensor is acquired, with 15.7%, and 112.4% in ON-current, and threshold-voltage sensitivities, over existing graphene-based-glucose biosensor FET. Linearity and harmonic analyses reveals sensing stability, and reduced distortion supporting analog/RF operations in nano-quantum regime. The CNT biosensor thus offers high signal integrity, low-power operation and label-free analyte detection being highly sensitive, making itself a promising candidate for next-generation implantable biosensing device for possible real time applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在(19,0)碳纳米管沟道上引入功能化生物分子后，全包围栅碳纳米管场效应晶体管（GAA CNT FET）作为纳米生物传感器的电学响应。作者以10 nm器件为模型，将葡萄糖、亲和素、纤维素和血红蛋白来源肽段共价接枝到栅控CNT沟道上，并用非平衡格林函数分析量子输运与特征电流信号。结果显示，不同生物分子可产生可区分的器件指纹；其中葡萄糖和亲和素器件的关态电流显著降低，血红蛋白片段器件则表现出更高的导通电流，表明其在无标记选择性检测中具有潜力。

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Atomic Clocks for Military PNT and Secure Communications
articles.title_zh: 面向军事PNT与安全通信的量子增强原子钟
articles.abstract: Precise timekeeping is a foundational, often overlooked dependency of both positioning/navigation/timing (PNT) systems and secure communications: satellite navigation requires nanosecond-level clock synchronization to compute position from signal time-of-flight, and time-synchronized cryptographic protocols (including key-exchange window validation and frequency-hopping schemes) depend on clock stability at the transmitting and receiving ends. Current-generation atomic clocks (cesium and rubidium standards) achieve their stability by averaging over many independent, unentangled atoms, a strategy fundamentally limited by the standard quantum limit (SQL), in which timing precision scales with the number of atoms N as N. Quantum-enhanced atomic clocks propose replacing independent-atom ensembles with entangled (GHZ-state) ensembles, whose Heisenberg-limited precision scales instead as N². This study validates the two components of that claim independently: (1) the entanglement-derived precision advantage, via GHZ Ramsey spectroscopy simulated on the PKTron quantum computing framework across probe sizes N = 1, 2, 4, and 6, and cross-checked on IBM Quantum's ibm_fez hardware at N = 4; and (2) accurate recovery of an atomic transition's phase signal, via PKTron's built-in Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) algorithm, tested against three independent reference phases. Simulation reproduced exact Heisenberg scaling (measured Fisher information of 1.00, 4.00, 16.00, and 36.00 against theoretical N² values of 1, 4, 16, and 36) and exact QPE phase recovery (zero measured error across all three test phases). On real IBM Quantum hardware at N = 4, the zero-drift calibration point returned P(all-zero) = 0.972, and the maximum-sensitivity bias point returned P(all-zero) = 0.500, exactly matching the theoretical prediction. These results constitute a reproducible, multi-method, hardware-validated confirmation of the sensing and phase-extraction primitives that underlie quantum-enhanced atomic clock proposals. This work does not simulate or validate a physical atomic clock, an optical lattice clock, or any oscillator hardware; it validates the underlying discrete-variable sensing and estimation mechanisms only, and should be read accordingly.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕定位、导航与授时（PNT）以及安全通信对高精度时间基准的依赖展开，讨论了量子增强原子钟相较传统原子钟的潜在优势。作者将独立原子系综与纠缠的GHZ态系综进行对比，并通过量子电路模拟与IBM量子硬件上的Ramsey频谱实验验证其精度增强机制。由于原始摘要截断，具体性能提升与实验细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: BB84 Quantum Key Distribution on PKTron and IBM Quantum Hardware: Eavesdropper-Detection Validation for Secure Military Communications
articles.title_zh: 基于PKTron与IBM量子硬件的BB84量子密钥分发：用于安全军事通信的窃听探测验证
articles.abstract: Secure military communications depend on the confidentiality of exchanged cryptographic keys across command centers, satellite links, and classified order transmission. Classical key-distribution protocols rely on computational hardness assumptions that provide no intrinsic mechanism for detecting interception; an adversary who copies transmitted ciphertext leaves no physical trace. Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), and specifically the BB84 protocol, replaces this assumption with a physical guarantee derived from quantum mechanics: any attempt to measure an unknown quantum state necessarily disturbs it, rendering interception statistically detectable. This study implements the BB84 protocol at the circuit level — qubit state preparation, basis selection, interception modeling, and measurement — and validates its central security property, the Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) signature of eavesdropping, in two stages: (1) a noiseless statevector simulation using the PKTron quantum computing framework over ten independent trials per condition, and (2) hardware execution on IBM Quantum's ibm_fez superconducting processor. In simulation, the average QBER without an eavesdropper was 0.000, and with a full intercept-resend attack was 0.248, closely matching the theoretical prediction of 0.25. On real hardware, the undisturbed channel returned QBER = 0.000 (19 sifted bits) and the eavesdropped channel returned QBER = 0.261 (23 sifted bits), in close agreement with both theory and the simulated baseline. These results provide a reproducible, two-platform validation of the eavesdropper-detection mechanism that underlies the security claims made for QKD-protected communications. This study validates the cryptographic detection primitive only; it does not constitute a deployed secure communications system, and extending these results to operational command, satellite, or classified-order channels requires physical single-photon transmission hardware, authenticated classical channels, and full key-management infrastructure outside the scope of this work.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在电路层面实现了BB84量子密钥分发协议，重点验证窃听会引入可统计探测的量子比特误码率（QBER）这一核心安全性质。作者分别在PKTron无噪声态矢模拟和IBM Quantum的ibm_fez超导量子处理器上进行了测试，对比了有无窃听者条件下的密钥分发行为。结果表明，该协议能够体现量子测量必然扰动未知态的安全机制；由于摘要截断，更完整的数值结果需参考原文。

articles.title: Reliability-aware multimodal prioritization of natural-product candidates against Candida albicans using gray-zone MIC modeling and applicability-domain analysis
articles.title_zh: 基于灰区MIC建模与适用域分析的白色念珠菌天然产物候选物可靠性优先排序
articles.abstract: The discovery of anti-Candida albicans candidates from natural-product libraries is challenged by heterogeneous MIC data, uncertain activity boundaries, and limited reliability of direct model-based ranking. Here, we developed a gray-zone augmented multimodal prioritization workflow for anti-C. albicans candidate screening. MIC records from ChEMBL, PubChem, and CO-ADD were standardized and divided into strict active/inactive samples and gray-zone samples using dual MIC thresholds. Three complementary molecular representations, including SMILES-based ChemBERTa, 2D fingerprints/descriptors, and 3D EGNN graphs, were trained under scaffold-isolated splits and integrated by an uncertainty-aware dynamic routing module using out-of-fold probabilities and entropy features. On the independent strict test set, the final UADR fusion model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.9181, PR-AUC of 0.7917, and Brier score of 0.0559, outperforming the strongest single-modality model while showing only marginal improvement over static mean fusion. Gray-zone ablation, source-held-out validation, entropy-stratified reliability analysis, and applicability-domain assessment were further used to evaluate deployment robustness. Among the top-ranked natural-product candidates, 86 analyzable candidate entries were stratified into experimental-priority, exploratory, and lower-priority groups according to model score, entropy, modality disagreement, and nearest-neighbor Tanimoto similarity. Docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations provided structural plausibility for selected candidates. This study provides a reliability-aware chemoinformatics workflow for prioritizing anti-C. albicans natural-product candidates for experimental follow-up.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一套面向抗白色念珠菌天然产物筛选的灰区增强多模态优先排序流程，旨在缓解MIC数据异质、活性边界不确定以及直接模型排序可靠性不足的问题。作者整合ChEMBL、PubChem和CO-ADD中的MIC记录，并按双阈值将样本划分为严格活性、严格失活和灰区样本；随后结合SMILES编码、2D指纹/描述符与3D EGNN图表示，并在骨架隔离划分下训练和融合。独立严格测试集上，最终UADR融合模型取得ROC-AUC 0.9181、PR-AUC 0.7917和Brier分数0.0559，同时还通过灰区消融、来源外推验证和适用域分析评估了部署鲁棒性。

articles.title: Permutationally symmetric molecular aggregates
articles.title_zh: 置换对称分子聚集体
articles.abstract: Linear optical spectra of molecular aggregates are often approximated by classical optics methods such as the discrete-dipole approximation (DDA), coherent exciton scattering (CES), and coherent potential approximation (CPA), where the only quantum-mechanical input to the calculation is the linear susceptibility of the monomers. However, the limits of validity of these classical optics methods remain opaque. Here, starting from a quantum mechanical Hamiltonian for the aggregate, we identify a limit where DDA/CPA/CES is exact: all-to-all coupled permutationally symmetric aggregates of N → ∞ monomers, starting from a totally symmetric initial state. The permutational symmetry of this molecular version of the Lipkin–Meshkov–Glick model, which is closely related to that of the molecular polariton problem of many identical molecules coupled to a single-cavity mode, allows us to borrow recent techniques developed for the latter. In particular, we identify a 1/ N expansion that corrects the classical optics limit with finite N corrections to the linear response of the aggregate. These corrections feature as Raman-like transitions of a single monomer. We illustrate these findings with calculations on the very physically relevant setup of a homodimer. Our findings clarify how quantum optical features that go beyond classical optics can already be present in simple arrays of quantum emitters such as molecular aggregates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从分子聚集体的量子力学哈密顿量出发，考察离散偶极近似、相干激子散射和相干势近似等经典光学方法的适用极限。作者指出，在全连接、置换对称且单体数趋于无穷的分子聚集体中，若初态完全对称，这些经典光学方法可成为精确描述。基于与分子极化激元问题相近的对称性，研究进一步建立 1/N 展开，用有限尺寸修正刻画聚集体线性响应，其中修正表现为类似单分子 Raman 跃迁的特征。
