articles.title: Single-Mode Control of High-Speed and Low-Threshold III-V/Si Quantum Dot Microring Lasers via Azimuthal Gratings
articles.title_zh: 利用方位角光栅实现高速低阈值 III-V/Si 量子点微环激光器的单模控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid III-V/silicon quantum-dot microring lasers are compact, energy-efficient O-band sources, but their whispering-gallery cavities are inherently multimode and bidirectional, producing unstable mode hopping that is incompatible with dense wavelength-division multiplexing. We show that an azimuthal grating patterned into the silicon ring - a single lithographic degree of freedom - converts this multimode cavity into a wavelength-addressed, single-mode source. A coupled-mode analysis derives the angular-momentum selection rule from first principles and shows that the inner-wall corrugation replaces the degenerate counter-propagating pair with symmetric and anti-symmetric standing-wave supermodes of unequal radiative loss. At the second-order Bragg condition the anti-symmetric mode is symmetry-protected, yielding a high-quality-factor state at exactly one azimuthal order; finite-element simulations confirm this and identify grating depth as the primary loss-engineering handle. Devices fabricated in-house on a 100 mm silicon-on-insulator platform hold a single longitudinal order with a side-mode suppression ratio of 37.9 dB and continuous, hop-free tuning, while the emission wavelength stays fixed across a factor-of-two change in cavity loading, set lithographically rather than by the gain peak. Because the grating decouples the lasing wavelength from the quantum-dot gain, the detuning becomes a mask-level design variable that sets the temperature of minimum threshold current, reaching 1.95 mA near 50 degC. Combined with side-mode suppression beyond 37 dB and multi-gigahertz direct modulation, these lasers are practical building blocks for cascaded, wavelength-addressed transmitter arrays in data communication and co-packaged optics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出在硅微环中引入方位角光栅，用单一光刻自由度将本征多模、双向传播的 III-V/硅量子点微环激光器转化为波长可寻址的单模光源。耦合模分析给出角动量选择定则，并说明内壁起伏将简并反向传播模分裂为辐射损耗不同的对称与反对称驻波超模；在二阶 Bragg 条件下反对称模受对称性保护而在单一方位角阶形成高 Q 态。片上器件实现单纵模工作，边模抑制比达到 37.9 dB，显示其面向密集波分复用硅光源的潜力。
authors: Xucheng Yang, Yingtao Hu, Eunso Shin, Antoine Descos, Yatiraj Ramanujam, Bassem Tossoun, Yuan Yuan, Geza Kurczveil, Jonathan Wierer, Ray Beausoleil, Di Liang, Stanley Cheung

articles.title: Core-valence double ionization of SF6 involving S2p, F1s and S1s inner shells
articles.title_zh: 涉及 S2p、F1s 与 S1s 内壳层的 SF6 芯-价双电离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Core-valence double ionization electron spectra near the S2p, F1s and S1s edges of SF6 are presented, analyzed and compared with conventional valence photoelectron spectra and quantum chemical calculations. The core-valence spectra are energetically stretched out, revealing salient structures between 15 and 40 eV that are sufficiently separated for molecular orbital analysis. The spectra offer new insights into the electronic structure, showing that the core hole substantially rearranges the molecular orbital order. This effect can be traced to orbital localization and nodal structure, as well as to valence-to-core penetration. The singlet and triplet splittings of the dicationic states progressively decrease in all three core-valence spectra towards deeper core levels, with larger splittings for S2p than S1s, reflecting greater valence-to-core penetration and exchange interaction for S2p. By large, the MO interpretation holds in frozen or self-consistent-field representations, except for the inner parts of the F1s spectra, which require analysis in terms of MO breakdown effects. An intensity model for CV spectra is derived using an independent-channel approach, where primary core ionization is treated by dipolar coupling to a continuum and the valence electron is promoted to a second continuum through shake-off. Full spin coupling and spin selectivity between the discrete doubly ionized states and the two continuum electrons are maintained. The primary molecular photoelectron intensity is expressed as a weighted sum of atomic subshell cross sections using a one-center atomic orbital projection of the relevant molecular orbital. The calculated spectra agree well with experiment and allow detailed assignment. In particular, symmetry breaking at the F1s core-ionization site is identified and discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道并分析了 SF6 在 S2p、F1s 和 S1s 边附近的芯-价双电离电子谱，并与常规价带光电子谱及量子化学计算比较。芯-价谱在能量上被拉伸，在 15–40 eV 区间显现出可用于分子轨道分析的分立结构，表明芯空穴会显著重排分子轨道能级次序。单重态—三重态分裂随芯层加深而减小，S2p 的分裂大于 S1s，反映出更强的价电子向芯区穿透和交换相互作用；F1s 谱内侧还需要考虑分子轨道图像失效效应。
authors: Veronica Daver Ideböhn, Daniel M. Pereira, Lucas M. Cornetta, Richard J. Squibb, Andreas Hult Roos, Emelie Olsson, Måns Wallner, Marco Parriani, Nihar Ranjan Behera, Gunnar Öhrwall, Florian Trinter, John H. D. Eland, Hans Ågren, Raimund Feifel

articles.title: Quantum motility-induced phase separation
articles.title_zh: 量子运动诱导相分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motility-induced phase separation (MIPS) describes a central clustering phenomenon in active matter systems where particles spontaneously separate into dense and dilute phases even in the absence of interparticle attractive forces. Recent theoretical and experimental efforts have taken the first steps to extend active matter concepts to the quantum level. However, whether a genuine quantum analog of MIPS exists and how quantum coherence would compete or cooperate with the dissipative self-propulsion has remained open so far. Here, we provide evidence that quantum MIPS can occur in a model of active hard-core bosons in one dimension. Our model yields superlinear number fluctuations characteristic of MIPS, leading to microphase separation with large but finite cluster size. Adding nearest-neighbor repulsive interactions, we find numerical evidence for restoring genuine phase separation with a divergent correlation length. Crucially, the clustered steady states maintain a long-distance quantum coherence, revealing a genuinely quantum feature with no classical counterpart. These results provide a foundation for exploring quantum MIPS and suggest that the coherence-activity interplay can generate new types of nonequilibrium quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文探讨主动体系中运动诱导相分离（MIPS）的量子对应物，研究一维主动硬核玻色子模型中耗散自推进与量子相干的竞争或协同。数值证据显示，该模型出现 MIPS 特征的超线性数涨落，并形成具有较大但有限团簇尺寸的微相分离。加入最近邻排斥相互作用后，体系可恢复具有发散关联长度的真正相分离；关键的是，团簇稳态仍保持长程量子相干，体现出无经典对应物的量子特征。
authors: Laurin Brunner, Ricard Alert, Reyhaneh Khasseh, Markus Heyl

articles.title: Surpassing Gaussian optimality in multiparameter estimation with indefinite causal order
articles.title_zh: 利用不定因果序在多参数估计中超越高斯最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25870v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We identify single-mode Gaussian probes, generated by displacement and squeezing operations on the vacuum state, which are optimal for the simultaneous estimation of displacement and squeezing operations in continuous-variable quantum systems. Importantly, our results reveal that the best precision at a fixed energy is achieved not by an experimentally costly squeezing resource, but rather by redirecting some of the energy towards displacement, thus allowing for more resource-effective operations. Furthermore, introducing indefinite causal order (ICO) in either the probe preparation or parameter encoding step can surpass the Gaussian precision bound, even though the optimal Gaussian probe state is agnostic to the ordering of the operations. Specifically, we observe that odd-parity superpositions of the two definite orders can enhance precision over optimal Gaussian probes in specific parameter regimes. Further, the observed advantage cannot be attributed solely to non-Gaussianity, as quantified by the relative entropy of non-Gaussianity, highlighting ICO as an independent resource for enhancing multiparameter estimation.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者确定了由真空态经位移和压缩操作生成的单模高斯探针，用于连续变量系统中位移与压缩操作的同时估计，并给出固定能量下的最优配置。结果显示，最佳精度并非依赖代价较高的压缩资源，而是将部分能量分配给位移可更有效利用资源。进一步地，在探针制备或参数编码中引入不定因果序可在特定参数区间超越高斯精度界，且该优势不能仅由非高斯性解释，表明不定因果序是提升多参数估计的独立资源。
authors: Sudipta Das, Rivu Gupta, Aditi Sen De, Himadri Shekhar Dhar

articles.title: A heterogeneously integrated coupled-cavity frequency beam splitter
articles.title_zh: 异质集成的耦合腔频率分束器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26028v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frequency encoded photonic qubits promise a scalable path towards high-dimensional quantum information processing, but require efficient components for coherently mixing frequency modes. Coupled cavity modulators provide this functionality by using only a single driving microwave tone to couple hybridized optical supermodes. Here, we demonstrate a heterogeneously integrated thin-film lithium-niobate-on-silicon coupled-cavity modulator that realizes tunable bidirectional frequency mode transformations, including (50/50) beam splitting and near complete frequency swapping with (>20~dB) pump extinction at a (10~GHz) supermode splitting. Because the electro-optic film is bonded onto a foundry fabricated silicon photonics platform, the approach is compatible with co-integration of photon pair sources, spectral filters, active tuning elements, and single photon detectors. We also bond thin-film lithium tantalate onto the same coupled-cavity platform, demonstrating material flexibility for scalable integrated frequency bin quantum photonic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了一种薄膜铌酸锂/硅异质集成耦合腔调制器，可对频率编码光子量子比特执行可调的双向频率模式变换。器件利用单一微波驱动耦合杂化光学超模，在约 10 GHz 超模分裂下实现 50/50 分束和近乎完全的频率交换，并具有超过 20 dB 的泵浦抑制。由于电光薄膜键合在代工硅光平台上，该方案有望与光子对源、谱滤波器、主动调谐单元和单光子探测器共同集成；作者还展示了薄膜钽酸锂在同一平台上的材料兼容性。
authors: Lucas M. Cohen, Manuel H. Muñoz-Arias, Mohan Sarovar, Nicholas A. Boynton, Shawn C. Arterburn, Thomas A. Friedmann, Nils T. Otterstrom, Paul S. Davids, Michael Gehl

articles.title: Curvature of Physical Space and Geometric Projection: A Possible Geometric Understanding of Quantum Mechanics and Relativity
articles.title_zh: 物理空间曲率与几何投影：量子力学和相对论的一种可能几何理解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Starting from a formal comparison between the Schrödinger equation and the Jacobi field equation, this paper proposes the hypothesis that, within the framework of non-relativistic quantum mechanics, the sectional curvature of microscopic physical space can be expressed as (K(x) = 2m(E-V(x))/hbar²), and attempts to offer a possible unified geometric understanding of quantum mechanics and relativity. The paper is divided into three parts. The first part identifies the Schrödinger equation, in its mathematical form, as a Jacobi field equation. The wave function is made to correspond to a Jacobi field, giving it the geometric meaning of the deviation of geodesics in physical space. Phenomena such as quantum tunneling, energy quantization, and the path integral are then interpreted, from this perspective, as geometric manifestations of different spatial curvatures. The second part proposes a geometric projection scheme based on semi-geodesic coordinates. The transverse metric factor of a curved space, which satisfies a Jacobi field equation, is taken as a unified geometric framework. It is demonstrated that the metric correction terms in classical mechanics, special relativity, general relativity, and quantum mechanics can all be derived from the same equation, with the curvature (K) arising from different physical sources. The third part extends this framework to statistical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从薛定谔方程与 Jacobi 场方程的形式类比出发，提出在非相对论量子力学中可将微观物理空间的截面曲率表示为 K(x)=2m(E−V(x))/ℏ²。作者将波函数对应于物理空间中测地线偏离的 Jacobi 场，并由此重新解释量子隧穿、能量量子化和路径积分等现象。文中还基于半测地坐标提出几何投影框架，尝试把曲率空间的横向度量因子作为联系量子力学与相对论效应的统一几何描述；该观点属于假设性理论构建，需进一步检验。

articles.title: Optomechanical crystal in light-resilient quantum ground state
articles.title_zh: 抗光照扰动的量子基态光机械晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.15724v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Interaction between light and high-frequency sound is a key area in integrated photonics, quantum and nonlinear optics, and quantum science. However, typical suspended optomechanical structures suffer from poor thermal anchoring, making them susceptible to thermal noise arising from optical absorption. Here, we demonstrate a chip-scale, release-free silicon optomechanical crystal cavity operating cryogenically with improved resilience to laser light. Relative to a suspended design, we observe 18 dB suppression of the thermo-optic effect, and the device also sustains near-unity phonon occupation at 35 dB higher intracavity optical energy in continuous-wave operation. Non-exponential decay dynamics from an as yet unidentified thermal process limit transfer of this performance to pulsed operation. Resolving this channel would open a clear path to near-term quantum protocols, such as microwave-to-optical quantum transduction. More broadly, the release-free architecture offers a novel platform for studying thermal noise dynamics with results relevant across silicon optomechanical platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文展示一种芯片级、无需释放的硅光机械晶体腔，在低温下运行并相较悬空结构显著提升对激光吸收热效应的耐受性。与悬空设计相比，器件的热光效应被抑制 18 dB，并能在连续波工作中于高 35 dB 的腔内光能下保持接近 1 的声子占据数。脉冲工作性能仍受一种尚未识别的非指数热衰减过程限制；若解决该通道，将有助于推进微波—光学量子转导等近期量子协议。
authors: Johan Kolvik, Paul Burger, David Hambraeus, Trond H. Haug, Joey Frey, Mads B. Kristensen, Raphaël Van Laer

articles.title: Attosecond Control of Squeezed Light
articles.title_zh: 压缩光的阿秒控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Squeezed light is a key resource in quantum metrology and quantum information science. It is primarily generated through nonlinear optical interactions, where the degree of squeezing is set by the nonlinearity of the medium. Here, we modulate the third-order nonlinear response of a dielectric with strong ultrafast laser fields to control squeezed light generation on attosecond time scales. By tuning a sub-cycle phase delay between the input femtosecond pulses, we switch the generated light between amplitude-squeezed and phase-squeezed states. We measure the quantum noise using a frequency-resolved balanced homodyne detection scheme that extracts field quadratures in many frequency modes simultaneously. From these measurements we obtain the complete coherency matrix containing quadrature correlations across the frequency modes of the pulse. These results enable quantum light sources with sub-cycle control of squeezing and open a route to transduction of dynamical quantum correlations in matter to quantum correlations in electric fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用强超快激光场调制介质的三阶非线性响应，从而在阿秒时间尺度上控制压缩光的生成。通过调节输入飞秒脉冲之间的亚周期相位延迟，作者实现了生成光在振幅压缩态和相位压缩态之间的切换。实验采用频率分辨平衡零拍探测，同时提取脉冲多个频率模式的场正交分量，并重构包含跨频率模式正交关联的完整相干矩阵，为具备亚周期压缩控制的量子光源提供了路径。
authors: Russell Zimmerman, Shashank Kumar, Shiva Kant Tiwari, Md Ehsanuzzaman, Eric Liu, Francis Walz, Siddhant Pandey, George J. Economou II, Hadiseh Alaeian, Chen-Ting Liao, Valentin Walther, Niranjan Shivaram

articles.title: AgentWorld: Personality-Aware Reliability Evaluation for Agentic Information Retrieval
articles.title_zh: AgentWorld：面向代理式信息检索的个性感知可靠性评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24076v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluation of agentic information retrieval remains limited to scripted interactions with uniform users, missing both natural personality diversity and adversarial brittleness. We present AgentWorld, a simulation framework combining (i)Big Five (OCEAN) personality-driven user populations with stateful tool-use environments; (ii)the pass^k consistency metric with structured fault classification, partial-credit scoring, and dual-control handoff verification; (iii)score-thresholded training-data export in six fine-tuning formats; and (iv)an adversarial Risk Analyser that snapshots required-intermediate-state spines, branches Monte-Carlo rollouts under four task-aware perturbation types, and quantifies risk via Δ P / Δ T scoring, Dempster--Shafer evidence fusion, and Shapley attack-category attribution. Three experiments demonstrate the framework: a conversational analytics agent across 10 OCEAN personas (240 evaluator judgments); a customer-support agent across 5 tasks × 4 persona variants; and adversarial stress-testing of 5 tasks revealing pre-existing trajectory brittleness (Vₘᵢₙ=0.375 without perturbation) and tool/infrastructure-layer attack dominance (Shapley: 46% system, 38% action). Personality variation surfaces failure modes uniform testing cannot expose---cross-domain leakage, contextual drift, a 0.27-point quality gap, and 50% vs. 100% pass-rate across personas on the same task---while the Risk Analyser quantifies trajectory-level brittleness that pass^k alone cannot measure.
articles.abstract_zh: AgentWorld 是一个用于评估代理式信息检索系统可靠性的仿真框架，旨在弥补现有评测中过度依赖脚本化交互和同质用户的不足。该框架结合基于大五人格（OCEAN）的用户群体、有状态工具使用环境、pass^k 一致性指标、结构化故障分类、部分得分和双控制交接验证。它还支持按得分阈值导出多种微调格式，并包含对中间状态轨迹进行快照、扰动和风险归因的对抗风险分析器；多个实验用于展示其在会话分析、客户支持和对抗压力测试中的应用。
authors: Gunja Agarwal, Arup Kumar Das, Arun Menon, Jitesh Chandra Mishra, Vignesh Divakaran

articles.title: Constructive Resolution of High-Temperature Superconductivity Mechanisms via Mersenne Superlattice Phase Resonances and Room-Temperature Interconnects
articles.title_zh: 通过梅森超晶格相位共振与室温互连实现高温超导机制的构造性解释
articles.abstract: For four decades following the landmark 1987 discovery of 93 K YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋ₓ (YBCO) high-temperature superconductors at the University of Houston, condensed matter physics has lacked a definitive analytical theory explaining why Cooper pair formation persists far beyond the conventional Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) phonon limit (T_c < 30 K). Here we report the theoretical derivation and physical realization of room-temperature dynamical quasi-superconductivity by transforming continuous spatial manifolds into discrete Mersenne prime superlattices (M₁₂₇ = 2¹²⁷ - 1). We prove that inelastic electron-phonon scattering can be geometrically zeroed at room temperature (293.15 K) without cryogenic liquid nitrogen or helium cooling. By driving standard copper and aluminum interconnects with a 4-phase orthogonal drive (Phiₘ = m*pi/2), the first-order Lippmann-Schwinger scattering matrix amplitude collapses identically to zero (1 - i - 1 + i = 0), inducing an active Floquet quasi-energy gap (Delta_F). Coupled with a 94.7% Active Phase-Resonance Locked (ACRL) adiabatic charge-recovery circuit, we demonstrate zero DC resistance (R_DC = 0) and a 99.999% reduction in thermal heat dissipation—slashing semiconductor interconnect power losses from 64 MW to 8.5 W. These findings resolve the long-standing high-T_c mechanism, establishing a heat-dissipation-free paradigm for semiconductor interconnects, AI data centers, and quantum electronics protected under Korean Patent Application No. 10-2026-0157375.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出一种高度非常规的理论框架，声称将连续空间结构离散化为梅森素数超晶格后，可在室温下几何抵消非弹性电子-声子散射。作者进一步声称，用四相正交驱动铜和铝互连可使一阶散射矩阵振幅相消，并结合主动相位共振锁定电路实现零直流电阻和极低热耗散。相关结论属于预印本中的理论与实验主张，需独立重复验证。

articles.title: The non-relativistic nature of spin in quantum mechanics: a historical and pedagogical perspective
articles.title_zh: 量子力学中自旋的非相对论本质：历史与教学视角
articles.abstract: Conventional methods for teaching spin at a university level generally follow four main approaches. The first introduces spin into the Schrödinger equation artificially, leaving its physical meaning unclear. The second connects spin to the representation of the rotation group, which clarifies its nature but requires knowledge of group theory. The third approach derives from field theory, separating angular momentum into orbital and intrinsic parts, the latter corresponding to spin; however, this cannot be done within quantum mechanics alone. The fourth derives electron spin from Dirac’s 1928 relativistic equation, which, though correct, has led to the misconception that spin is a purely relativistic effect. A detailed analysis of Dirac’s 1928 papers shows that the concept of spin arises from the need to construct an equation linear in both energy and momentum to preserve Born’s probabilistic interpretation. This linearization of the Klein–Gordon equation reveals that spin is conceptually independent of relativity. Historical and pedagogical perspectives can together clarify conceptual difficulties and promote a deeper understanding of fundamental ideas in physics. Drawing on selected passages from Dirac’s original work, the present discussion offers broader conceptual and cultural considerations that introduce the notion of spin with limited mathematical requirements and can be applied independently of the didactic approach adopted.
articles.abstract_zh: 文章梳理大学物理教学中引入自旋的四类常见路径：人为加入薛定谔方程、旋转群表示、场论角动量分解以及从狄拉克方程导出。作者通过分析狄拉克1928年的论文指出，自旋概念源于构造能量和动量均为线性的方程以保持玻恩概率解释，而非相对论本身的必然结果。该文主张结合历史与教学视角，有助于澄清“自旋是纯相对论效应”的常见误解。

articles.title: Spin-Coating-Speed-Dependent Structural and Optical Properties of Open-Air-Processed MAPbI 3 Thin Films: Experimentally Informed SCAPS-1D Device Simulation
articles.title_zh: 旋涂速度对空气中制备MAPbI₃薄膜结构与光学性质的影响：结合实验参数的SCAPS-1D器件模拟
articles.abstract: Spin coating remains one of the most accessible routes for depositing metal-halide perovskite absorbers, yet the strong coupling between rotational speed, solvent removal, crystallization and film properties complicates process optimization under ambient conditions. This study investigates the influence of spin-coating speed (2000–5000 rpm) on the structural and optical properties of open-air-processed methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI₃) thin films and uses the experimentally determined optical bandgaps to inform one-dimensional device simulation. Films were deposited from a 1.25 M MAPbI₃ precursor using ethyl acetate antisolvent treatment and annealed at 110 °C for 10 min under controlled cleanroom conditions (24.4 °C and 41.5% relative humidity). X-ray diffraction confirmed tetragonal MAPbI₃ with preferential (110) orientation and no detectable PbI₂ reflection. The response to spin speed was non-monotonic: the film deposited at 3000 rpm exhibited the narrowest (110) peak (0.352°), largest crystallite size (22.73 nm), lowest microstrain (1.257 × 10⁻²) and lowest dislocation density (1.936 × 10⁻³ linesnm⁻²), indicating the best crystalline quality. UV–visible analysis yielded optical bandgaps of 1.59–1.60 eV. When these bandgaps were incorporated into an FTO/TiO₂/MAPbI₃/Spiro-OMeTAD/carbon SCAPS-1D model, the 1.59 eV absorber produced a prototype efficiency of 16.67%, compared with 16.47% for the 1.60 eV absorber. Subsequent optimization of layer thicknesses, carrier densities, bulk and interface defect densities, and resistive parameters increased the predicted power-conversion efficiency to 25.38%, with an open-circuit voltage of 1.25 V, short-circuit current density of 24.24 mA/cm² and fill factor of 83.61%. The results identify 3000 rpm as the most favourable condition for crystalline film quality and demonstrate how experimentally constrained optical data can improve the physical relevance of device-level optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察2000–5000 rpm旋涂速度对开放空气条件下制备的MAPbI₃钙钛矿薄膜结构和光学性质的影响，并将实验获得的光学带隙用于一维器件模拟。X射线衍射显示薄膜为四方相MAPbI₃且具有优先(110)取向，未检测到PbI₂峰。结果表明旋涂速度影响呈非单调性，其中3000 rpm样品表现出最窄衍射峰、较大晶粒尺寸、较低微应变和位错密度，结晶质量最佳。

articles.title: Singular Three-Point Density Correlations in Two-Dimensional Fermi Liquids
articles.title_zh: 二维费米液体中的奇异三点密度关联
articles.abstract: Author(s): Pok Man Tam and Charles L. Kane A singular density correlation that is generic to all two-dimensional Fermi liquids offers an independent method for measuring the Landau parameters that characterize the Fermi-liquid phase using quantum-gas microscopy. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 096504] Published Thu Aug 27, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者指出，二维费米液体普遍存在一种奇异的三点密度关联。该关联可作为一种独立手段，借助量子气体显微镜测量刻画费米液相的Landau参数。
authors: Pok Man Tam and Charles L. Kane

articles.title: Anomalous Dynamical Scaling at Topological Quantum Criticality
articles.title_zh: 拓扑量子临界性下的异常动力学标度
articles.abstract: Author(s): Menghua Deng, Sheng Yang, Chen Sun, Fuxiang Li, and Xue-Jia Yu Driven dynamics at topologically nontrivial quantum critical points leads to anomalous boundary and edge scaling beyond the Kibble–Zurek prediction in several quantum spin chain models. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 096605] Published Thu Aug 27, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在拓扑非平庸量子临界点附近的驱动动力学行为。结果表明，在若干量子自旋链模型中，边界与边缘的标度律会偏离Kibble–Zurek预测，呈现异常动力学标度。
authors: Menghua Deng, Sheng Yang, Chen Sun, Fuxiang Li, and Xue-Jia Yu

articles.title: Eightfold classification of superconducting orders
articles.title_zh: 超导序的八重分类
articles.abstract: Author(s): Alexander V. Balatsky and Saikat Banerjee Superconductivity begins when electrons bind into pairs. Because electrons are fermions, exchanging the two partners in a pair must flip the sign of its wavefunction — and that minus sign can be paid for in four different currencies: the pair’s spin, its spatial shape, its orbital character, and, less obviously, the relative time between the two electrons. Sharing one minus sign among four ± choices leaves exactly eight allowed kinds of Cooper pair. Balatsky and Banerjee show here that this eightfold rule is one face of a larger structure. A pair also has a center of mass — a place and a moment — and a superconductor can order in those as well. Taking internal shape (ρ), internal timing (τ), spatial modulation (R), and temporal modulation (T) as four independent axes builds the Berezinskii–Abrahams hypercube: a sixteen-corner map of superconducting order. BCS sits at the origin; each single axis recovers a familiar family — p - and d -wave gaps, odd-frequency pairing, FFLO and pair-density waves, driven superconductors. The corners in-between are hybrids. A few have been touched; most are empty, and the far corner, with all four switched-on at once, has never been visited. The hypercube is at once a classification and a search map. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 074511] Published Thu Aug 27, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从库珀对交换反对称性出发，系统总结了超导配对的八种允许类型。作者进一步把配对的内部形状、内部时间、空间调制与时间调制视为四个独立轴，构建出一个16个顶点的超导序超立方体框架。该框架将BCS、p/d波、奇频配对、FFLO与配对密度波、驱动超导等多种情形统一起来，并指出其中仍有许多尚未探索的组合态。
authors: Alexander V. Balatsky and Saikat Banerjee

articles.title: Conformational stability of lysozyme in choline chloride–polyol aqueous deep eutectic solvents (ADES)
articles.title_zh: 氯化胆碱–多元醇水合深共熔溶剂中溶菌酶的构象稳定性
articles.abstract: Naturally occurring deep eutectic solvents (NADES) offer a tunable microenvironment for biomolecular stabilization. Yet, the atomistic mechanisms governing the protein–solvent interactions remain poorly understood. Here, we present microsecond-long atomistic molecular dynamics simulations investigating lysozyme (Lys) stability in Choline Chloride (ChCl)–polyol (erythritol, xylitol, and sorbitol) aqueous deep eutectic solvents as a function of water wt. % (fw=0,25,50,75). Lys maintains its native structure across all conditions, with stable Rg, RMSD, RMSF, and secondary structure populations. The stabilization mechanism involves three coupled effects. First, solvent–solvent radial distribution functions (RDFs) and inter-component hydrogen bond (H-bond) analysis demonstrate that each NADES component preserves its characteristic H-bond network even in the presence of Lys, confirming that the bulk solvent structure is not disrupted. Second, the poorly structured protein–NADES RDFs are consistent with the preferential exclusion of NADES components from the protein surface with increasing hydration. Third, protein–polyol H-bonds remain persistently high and largely independent of water content, revealing a stable surface association layer that is not displaced by water. Among the polyols, xylitol exhibits significantly higher protein–alcohol H-bonds at low and intermediate hydration levels, owing to its intermediate flexible geometry and hydroxyl density. These findings demonstrate that the Lys stabilization in ChCl–polyol NADES arises from a polyol-dependent interplay among the preserved solvent network structure, inferential evidence for preferential exclusion, and persistent interfacial interactions. Overall, the study provides a molecular framework for rational NADES design for biomolecular stabilization applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用微秒级原子分子动力学模拟，研究了溶菌酶在氯化胆碱–多元醇（赤藓糖醇、木糖醇、山梨醇）水合深共熔溶剂中的稳定性，并考察不同含水量下的结构响应。结果显示，溶菌酶在所有条件下都能保持天然构象，Rg、RMSD、RMSF和二级结构分布总体稳定。其稳定机制可归因于三方面：溶剂内部氢键网络在蛋白存在下基本保持、随水化增强NADES组分对蛋白表面的优先排斥，以及蛋白与多元醇之间持续存在的氢键相互作用。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Configurational entropy as a potential metric for empirical potential development and validation
articles.title_zh: 构型熵作为经验势函数开发与验证的潜在指标
articles.abstract: Empirical interatomic potentials remain widely used due to their high computational efficiency. Yet their development and validation protocols typically emphasize properties that have limited sensitivity to the overall shape of the potential energy landscape (PEL) and can give rise to poor transferability to other properties. Here, we consider the configurational and vibrational entropy of liquid silicon (Si) predicted by seven widely utilized empirical potentials with a view of using these energy landscape parameters to assess potentials more broadly. Both vibrational and configurational entropy contributions are found to be remarkably sensitive to the form of the potential, revealing substantial differences in basin curvature, basin density, and overall PEL topology that are not captured by conventional fitting targets. With a view toward using this information for future potential development, we also show that the Debye–Waller parameter u2 provides a practical experimental proxy for configurational entropy through the localization model of relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以液态硅为例，比较了七种常用经验原子间势所预测的构型熵与振动熵，评估这些量作为势函数开发和验证指标的可行性。结果表明，这两类熵对势函数形式极为敏感，能够揭示势能面中基底曲率、基底密度及整体拓扑的差异，而这些信息通常不会被传统拟合目标捕捉。作者还提出，Debye–Waller参数u2可通过局域化弛豫模型作为构型熵的实验代理量。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Assignment of H 2 O–HF rotational lines via ab initio calculations
articles.title_zh: 基于从头算计算的H2O–HF转动谱线指认
articles.abstract: Significant progress in the assignment of rotational transitions in the H 2 O–HF dimer using ab initio calculations is described. For the first time, rovibrational calculations are performed up to J = 6 using a full-dimensional Hamiltonian, including all intra- and inter-molecular interactions. Previous work had assigned lines of H 2 O–HF belonging to the ground state and one excited vibrational state ν β ( o ) with K a ≤ 4. Two existing spectra covering the J ranges 12 to 24 and 10 to 26 are re-analyzed using the new ab initio calculations, yielding assignments and corresponding rotational constants for 25 more vibrational state K a combinations. In particular, five new vibrational states, ν β ( i ) , ν σ , 2 ν β ( o ) , ν σ + ν β ( o ) , and ν β ( o ) + ν β ( i ) , are assigned for K a = 0 and several excited K a values. Differences between the predicted, ab initio rotational B constants and the experimentally determined ones are systematic and about 40 MHz, which serves as confirmation of the correctness of these assignments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用从头算方法推进了H2O–HF二聚体转动跃迁的指认工作。作者首次基于完整维哈密顿量进行到J=6的振动转动计算，包含所有分子内与分子间相互作用，并重新分析了两组已知谱图。借助新计算结果，研究者为更多振动态与Ka组合给出了指认，新增了5个振动态在多个Ka取值下的分配；理论与实验B转动常数之间约40 MHz的系统偏差反而支持了这些指认的正确性。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Atmospheric UV synthesis of aldehydes and oxidant from CO2, CO and H2O initiating the first ancestral metabolism
articles.title_zh: 大气紫外化学由CO2、CO和H2O合成醛类与氧化剂，启动最初的祖先生命代谢
articles.abstract: Prebiotically-important organics could be synthesized by atmospheric UV chemistry on early Earth and early Mars. Formaldehyde (HCHO) has been known to be produced from CO in CO2 atmospheres, but it is not the only product. Here, we report systematic experiments investigating how and which molecules are produced from CO2, CO and H2O through atmospheric photochemistry and subsequent aqueous reactions. Broadband UV irradiation (wavelength >175 nm), simulating sunlight, into CO+H2O±CO2±H2 yields not only formaldehyde, but also glyoxal and acetaldehyde through gas phase radical chemistry initiated from photodissociation of H2O. Oxidation of these aldehydes is inevitable due to co-produced oxidants (OH and H2O2), leading to formate, acetate, glycolate, glyoxylate and oxalate. Upon dissolution in liquid water, these species further converted into more than 140 organic compounds: glycolaldehyde and other hydroxy aldehydes, hydroxy acids, keto acids, dicarboxylic acids and fatty acids. From the small aldehydes, a majority of detected species can be produced through condensation, oxidation and decarboxylation reactions. Interestingly, some specific aldehydes, hydroxy and keto acids are recycled through these three reactions. The overall structure of the proposed reaction network mimics biological metabolisms, particularly “respiration”, and therefore we term it the Primitive Respiration Cycle (PRC). In steady state, this specific set of molecules survive even under the co-generated oxidative stress as long as the small aldehydes are supplied from atmosphere, whereas the other non-recycled byproducts are oxidized ultimately into CO2 if excess oxidant is available. Therefore, the PRC offers a selection mechanism of a chemical system via oxidative decomposition, one that can nonetheless be sustained in the environment, potentially underpinning evolvability of the chemical system. Furthermore, these carbon species react with ammonia to form amino acids and various heterocyclic nitrogen compounds including imidazole, pyridine, pyrimidine and their derivatives, some of which resemble coenzymes used in biological metabolism. Our results imply that non-enzymatic ancestral metabolism was self-organized from CO2, CO and H2O under solar UV radiation, sustained in and adopted to the environment, and transitioned potentially to enzymatic systems through catalytic feedback from the products to the system itself. The proposed mechanism could bridge the gap between geochemistry and living systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过实验系统研究了早期地球和早期火星大气光化学中，CO2、CO和H2O在紫外辐照下可生成的前生物有机物。结果表明，模拟太阳光的宽谱UV不仅生成甲醛，还可通过由水光解触发的气相自由基反应产生乙二醛和乙醛；同时伴随生成的OH和H2O2会进一步氧化这些醛类，形成甲酸、乙酸、乙醇酸、乙醛酸和草酸等产物。溶入水相后，这些小分子还能继续转化为140余种有机物，说明简单大气组分即可通向复杂前生物化学网络。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Cole Peeters, Themba Hodge, and Stephan Rachel The degeneracy breaking hybridization between Majorana zero modes leads to unwanted dynamic phase accumulation and thus introduces error to topological quantum gates. In certain regimes, the effects of hybridization can be cancelled by the inclusion of an equal amount of “negative hybridization” that has been demonstrated via simulation to drastically reduce dynamic errors in Z , X , and ᴄɴᴏᴛ gates. [Phys. Rev. Research 8, L032032] Published Thu Aug 27, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了马约拉纳零模编织过程中，简并性破缺的杂化会引入动力学相位累积，从而导致拓扑量子门误差。作者提出在特定参数区间内加入等量“负杂化”，可抵消原本的杂化效应。数值模拟表明，这种方法能够显著降低Z、X和CNOT门中的动力学误差。
authors: Cole Peeters, Themba Hodge, and Stephan Rachel

authors: Maxim Dzero, Maxim Khodas, Alex Levchenko, and Vladyslav Kozii

articles.title: Simulations reveal asymmetric diffusion of magnetic skyrmions through an off-center gate
articles.title_zh: 模拟揭示磁性斯格明子通过偏心门控结构时的非对称扩散
articles.abstract: Diffusion is a fundamental natural phenomenon that can be observed across a wide range of length and time scales. It plays a key role in many fields, including physics, biology and economics. In particular, asymmetric or directional diffusion of particle systems has attracted growing interest for practical applications, including the development of unconventional artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, where it could enable nonlinear, geometry-controlled information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道围绕磁性斯格明子在偏心门控几何中的扩散行为展开，强调几何不对称可诱导方向性或非对称扩散。此类机制对基于粒子体系的非线性、几何可控信息处理具有潜在意义，尤其可能服务于非常规人工智能硬件设计。

articles.title: Integrating Molecular Simulations and Machine Learning for Predicting HFC Adsorption in Zeolites
articles.title_zh: 结合分子模拟与机器学习预测沸石中氢氟烃吸附
articles.abstract: This study re-audits and models a simulation-derived database for the adsorption of fluoromethane (R41), difluoromethane (R32), trifluoromethane (R23), and tetrafluoromethane (R14) in zeolites 13X, 3A, 4A, and 5A. The fully documented primary population contains 1,536 adsorption-loading observations (4 HFCs × 4 zeolites × 6 temperatures × 16 pressures) and 1,440 modeled isosteric-heat values; the 96 source heat zeros occurring at P = 0 were preserved in the audit data but were not used as evaluated heat targets. Ensemble regressors were compared under leakage-aware validation. Model selection was performed only within the development pool using five-fold isotherm-grouped cross-validation, followed by evaluation on a predefined balanced HFC–zeolite-pair holdout. Random row-level splitting was retained only as an interpolation benchmark. Histogram Gradient Boosting was selected for adsorption loading and achieved R² = 0.845, RMSE = 0.512 mmol g⁻¹, and MAE = 0.371 mmol g⁻¹ on the balanced pair holdout. Extra Trees was selected for isosteric heat and achieved R² = 0.885, RMSE = 0.617 kJ mol⁻¹, and MAE = 0.559 kJ mol⁻¹. Model attribution indicates that pressure and temperature are important for loading, whereas heat prediction depends more strongly on correlated framework and molecular descriptor families. Leave-one-HFC-out and leave-one-zeolite-out analyses show that the present surrogate is reliable mainly for interpolation within the studied chemical domain and is not yet validated for unseen HFC or zeolite identities. The revised workflow therefore provides a transparent and reproducible surrogate while defining its applicability limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究重新审计并建模了四种氢氟烃在13X、3A、4A和5A沸石中的模拟吸附数据库，包含1536个吸附量观测和1440个等量吸附热建模值，并采用避免数据泄漏的验证策略。吸附量模型选用直方图梯度提升，在平衡HFC–沸石对留出集上达到R²=0.845；等量吸附热模型选用Extra Trees，达到R²=0.885。模型归因显示压力和温度是关键输入变量，说明机器学习可在受控验证下有效代理分子模拟吸附预测。

articles.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer Learning for Real-Time Melt Pool Geometry Prediction in Directed Energy Deposition
articles.title_zh: 面向定向能量沉积熔池几何实时预测的仿真到真实迁移学习
articles.abstract: In Directed Energy Deposition (DED), melt pool geometry governs part quality, but its depth lies below the surface and cannot be measured directly in real time, a long-standing barrier to closed-loop control. This paper presents a Sim-to-Real transfer learning framework that predicts melt pool width and depth in real time from infrared (IR) imagery and process parameters, bridging physics-based thermal simulation with a small set of experimental data. A multi-input hybrid CNN is pretrained on a large, simulated corpus of surface temperature maps paired with laser power, scan speed, and spot size, then fine-tuned, with all layers unfrozen, on a limited set of labeled IR frames from single-track builds. Against a baseline trained on experiments alone, the fine-tuned model is more accurate and converges faster and more stably, with the clearest gains for depth in the low-data regime (for small training sets it reaches R² > 0.7 where the baseline stays below 0.2). On six previously unseen single-track builds, frame-by-frame real-time prediction yields a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 7.41% for width and 22.45% for depth, versus 29.35% and 74.66% for the baseline. An input ablation confirms that pairing thermal imagery with process parameters gives the best accuracy. Together these results show the approach is practical for sensor-driven monitoring and points toward closed-loop control in metal additive manufacturing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出Sim-to-Real迁移学习框架，利用物理热模拟和少量实验红外图像实时预测定向能量沉积中的熔池宽度与深度。多输入混合CNN先在模拟温度场及工艺参数上预训练，再在单道成形实验红外帧上全层微调，相比仅用实验训练的基线收敛更快且精度更高，低数据条件下对深度预测提升尤为明显。在六个未见单道实验中，模型宽度和深度预测MAPE分别为7.41%和22.45%，显著优于基线。

articles.title: Metastable nanoparticle cores amplify single-ion quantum level crossings
articles.title_zh: 亚稳纳米颗粒核心放大单离子量子能级交叉信号
articles.abstract: Classical size dispersion and experimental artefacts have long obscured the discrete quantum energy levels of individual magnetic sites in disordered nanoparticle ensembles. We report a field-periodic, phase-coherent switching resonance—robust under instrumental and processing controls—in the first-order reversal curve (FORC) response of biogenic magnetoferritin at 2 and 5 K. The period, μ₀ΔH = 11.9 ± 1.6 mT, is invariant and phase-coherent (p ≈ 10⁻³), and the resonance disappears above the blocking temperature. Cross-correlation shows the ridges tilt in proportion to the core remanence slope (ρ ≈ 0.78): the structure tracks the internal hysteretic state of the core, not the applied field, excluding instrumental and processing origins. The spacing gives an axial zero-field splitting D = 0.016 ± 0.002 K, identifying the active unit as an individual surface Fe³⁺ ion (S = 5/2), whose relaxation is exponentially amplified by cores thermally poised at their switching threshold (Γt ≈ 1). The resulting size–temperature window (TB/9.0 ≤ T ≤ TB) accounts for the thirty-year absence of resolved resonances in conventional magnetometry and predicts the geometric signature recovered in independent data at 6.9σ. This establishes a paradigm where macroscopic metastability serves as a quantum amplifier, enabling benchtop spectroscopy of single-ion quantum states in inherently disordered nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在生物源磁铁蛋白的FORC响应中观察到低温下场周期、相干相位的开关共振，周期为μ₀ΔH=11.9±1.6 mT，并在阻塞温度以上消失。交叉相关分析表明共振脊线随核心剩磁斜率倾斜，说明信号跟踪颗粒核心内部滞后态而非外加场或仪器伪影。能级间隔对应轴向零场分裂D=0.016±0.002 K，指向单个表面Fe³⁺离子，其弛豫被处于开关阈值附近的亚稳核心指数放大。

articles.title: High-Frequency Activity in Scalp EEG Validated by Concurrent Intracranial EEG During Working Memory
articles.title_zh: 工作记忆任务中同步颅内脑电验证头皮脑电高频活动
articles.abstract: Background Reliable neural markers of cognitive processing support objective cognitive assessment and rehabilitation. High-frequency (HF) activity recorded with intracranial EEG (iEEG) is a well-established marker of local cortical processing, yet whether HF signals measured non-invasively from scalp EEG reflect underlying neural activity remains controversial.Methods We examined the physiological validity of scalp HF activity using simultaneous scalp EEG and iEEG from nine subjects performing a verbal working memory (WM) task. Using spatial-spectral and connectivity analyses, we characterized scalp HF responses (60–120 Hz) and quantified their crossmodal correspondence with intracranial HF broadband activity across WM phases and memory loads. We further extracted iEEG-informed features using scalp EEG and implemented a knowledge distillation framework in which intracranial signals guided non-invasive EEG WM decoding.Results Scalp HF activity exhibited robust task-dependent modulation and significant concordance with intracranial HF dynamics, particularly during WM retrieval over frontal, temporal, and parieto-occipital regions. Additionally, scalp HF activity increased with task difficulty across multiple EEG electrodes within these regions. Cross-modal coherence analyses revealed phase- and region-specific synchronization between EEG and iEEG signals, with the strongest coherence observed between frontal scalp electrodes and entorhinal cortex, as well as between temporal–parietal scalp electrodes and hippocampal regions during retrieval. Scalp EEG exhibited distinct alpha–HF coupling patterns, with enhanced parietal coupling during maintenance and frontal coupling during retrieval. WM decoding achieved a LOSO accuracy of 90 ± 10% (AUC = 0.93) using iEEG, and 74 ± 13% (AUC = 0.79) using scalp EEG, with HF-related features contributing most strongly in both modalities. Importantly, incorporating intracranial representations through a knowledge distillation framework improved EEG-based decoding performance to 80.1 ± 7.6% (AUC = 0.88), highlighting the feasibility of the proposed iEEG-guided cross-modal learning framework.Conclusion Our findings provide direct physiological evidence that task-related scalp HF activity reflects underlying cortical processing. This work establishes a cross-modal framework for validating non-invasive HF biomarkers using intracranial ground truth, highlights the importance of investigating higher-frequency EEG signals beyond conventional frequency bands, and demonstrates the potential of iEEG-guided learning to improve interpretable EEG-based cognitive decoding, with potential applications in cognitive and broader neurorehabilitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用9名受试者在言语工作记忆任务中的同步头皮EEG和颅内EEG，检验头皮60–120 Hz高频活动是否反映真实皮层处理。空间-频谱和连接分析显示，头皮高频活动具有任务依赖调制，并与颅内高频宽带动力学显著一致，尤其在工作记忆提取阶段的额叶、颞叶和顶枕区域更明显。研究还利用颅内信号指导的特征提取和知识蒸馏框架改进非侵入式工作记忆解码，支持头皮高频信号作为认知处理标志物的生理有效性。

articles.title: Identifying the sulfur fumigation of traditional Chinese medicines based on terahertz spectroscopy and machine learning algorithms
articles.title_zh: 基于太赫兹光谱与机器学习算法识别中药硫熏处理
articles.abstract: Publication date: November 2026 Source: Chemical Physics Letters, Volume 898 Author(s): Tian'ai Zhao, Chunyi Zhang, Qiuhong Qu, Pengfei Wang, Mingxia He

articles.title: Observation of Antichiral Hinge States in a Three-dimensional Gyromagnetic Photonic Crystal
articles.title_zh: 三维旋磁光子晶体中反手性铰链态的观测
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77286-6 This work reports the observation of antichiral hinge states in a 3D gyromagnetic photonic crystal. Extending antichirality to higher-order topology, it reveals a topological semimetal with co-propagating transport along parallel hinges.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了在三维旋磁光子晶体中观测到反手性铰链态。研究将反手性概念推广到高阶拓扑体系，展示了一类拓扑半金属，其平行铰链上存在同向传播输运通道。

articles.title: Stabilization of charged domains in ferroelectric BiFeO 3 nanoneedles
articles.title_zh: 铁电 BiFeO₃ 纳米针中带电畴的稳定化
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76259-z The authors propose a top down strategy of modifying the surface boundary conditions in a BiFeO3 nanoneedle sample through ion milling. Surface curvature gradients and terminations induce charge compensation and ferroeleastic effects that facilitate charged domain wall stabilization.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种自上而下的策略，通过离子铣削改变 BiFeO₃ 纳米针样品的表面边界条件。表面曲率梯度与表面终止诱导电荷补偿和铁弹性效应，从而促进带电畴壁的稳定。

articles.title: Raman Circular Dichroism Reveals Higher-Order Quantum Geometry of Magnons
articles.title_zh: 拉曼圆二色性揭示磁振子的高阶量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant theory of higher-order magnon quantum geometry probed by two-magnon Raman circular dichroism (RCD). The Raman operator decomposes into Berry connections, covariant derivatives, and products of Berry connections, giving rise to quantum geometric tensors beyond the quantum metric and Berry curvature. Applying this theory to a field-polarized Kitaev magnet, we show that higher-order geometric tensors govern the dichroic response. Our results establish RCD as a spectroscopic probe of generalized magnon quantum geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立了由双磁振子拉曼圆二色性探测的、规范不变的高阶磁振子量子几何理论。拉曼算符可分解为 Berry 联络、协变导数及 Berry 联络乘积，由此引入超越量子度量和 Berry 曲率的高阶量子几何张量。应用于场极化 Kitaev 磁体时，作者表明这些高阶几何张量主导圆二色响应，从而确立 RCD 作为广义磁振子量子几何的光谱探针。
authors: Yong Chan Kim, Youngsu Choi, Kwang-Yong Choi, Kyusung Hwang

articles.title: Universal Spin-Position Coupled Rydberg Interactions
articles.title_zh: 普适的自旋-位置耦合里德堡相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong interactions between s-orbital Rydberg atoms underpin atom-array-based quantum computation and quantum simulation. Typically, the spin dependence of these interactions is negligible and plays no practical role. In this Letter, we uncover that a strong electron-spin-dependent Rydberg interaction can emerge when the principal quantum numbers of the two s-orbital atoms differ by a sweet-spot value. This interaction originates from the fine-structure splitting of nearby p orbitals, which endows it with distinct symmetry properties such that the electron spins are coupled to the relative position of the two atoms, featuring a spatially defined anisotropy. We further demonstrate that this interaction admits a universal form, independent of the principal quantum numbers, and highlight its fundamental distinction from conventional magnetic dipolar interactions, establishing it as a new type of native magnetic interaction in nature. Our findings introduce a new element to the Rydberg quantum simulation toolbox. As a concrete application, we propose a native realization of the Kitaev-Heisenberg model, which hosts an unusual stripe phase as a quantum many-body manifestation of spin-space locking.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，当两个 s 轨道里德堡原子的主量子数相差特定“甜点”值时，可出现强电子自旋依赖相互作用。该相互作用源于邻近 p 轨道的精细结构劈裂，使电子自旋与两原子的相对位置耦合，并表现出空间定义的各向异性。作者进一步证明其形式具有不依赖主量子数的普适性，区别于传统磁偶极相互作用，并提出可原生实现 Kitaev-Heisenberg 模型及其非常规条纹相。

articles.title: Observation of electron spin interactions between Rydberg atoms
articles.title_zh: 里德堡原子间电子自旋相互作用的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the observation of electron spin interactions between Rydberg atoms, which are driven by spin-orbit coupling through second-order dipole perturbation and exhibit a spatial anisotropy governed by the atomic configuration. Specifically, we observe coherent electron spin exchange dynamics, with the measured coupling strength agreeing well with both numerical calculations and theoretical models. Furthermore, we show that global microwave dressing enables active engineering and dynamical freezing of the spin exchange by introducing a differential AC Stark shift between the participating states. Additionally, we achieve tunability of the interaction by applying a stronger magnetic field, which effectively modifies the energy contributions of the underlying spin-orbit coupling channels. Finally, measuring spin dynamics in one-dimensional multi-atom chains aligned parallel or perpendicular to the magnetic field provides a self-consistent validation of the anisotropic XXZ framework. This electron spin interaction natively features spin-position coupling and enables a natural mapping onto the Heisenberg-Kitaev model. Our findings reveal a new class of electron spin-spin interactions among Rydberg atoms, expanding the scope of quantum simulation with Rydberg atom arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作实验观测到里德堡原子间由自旋-轨道耦合通过二阶偶极微扰驱动的电子自旋相互作用，并显示其各向异性由原子构型决定。实验实现了相干电子自旋交换动力学，测得耦合强度与数值计算和理论模型吻合。作者还利用全局微波 dressing、增强磁场和一维多原子链自旋动力学测量，对相互作用的工程调控、冻结及各向异性 XXZ 描述进行了验证，并指出其可自然映射到 Heisenberg-Kitaev 模型。
authors: Le Ruan, Ziqi Zhou, Yuchen Guo, Chengshu Li, Cheng Chen

articles.title: Tunable Magnetic Frustration in the Cu-Ru-based Double Perovskite La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆ (x = 0, 1, 2) Oxides
articles.title_zh: Cu-Ru 基双钙钛矿 La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆（x=0,1,2）氧化物中的可调磁阻挫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, we investigate structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the copper-ruthenate based oxide double perovskite La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆ (x = 0, 1, 2), synthesized through the solid-state reaction method. X-ray diffraction analysis reveals that all compounds crystallize in a monoclinic symmetry, with varying degree of structural distortion that increases in moving from La³⁺ to smaller size cation Sm³⁺. Electrical resistivity studies indicate insulating behaviour in all compounds, with variable-range-hopping domination at low temperatures, due to presence of anti-site disorder. AC susceptibility and heat capacity measurements suggest suppression of frustration in Sm-bearing compounds, affecting the magnetic behavior. Our first-principles calculations suggest that the combined effects of lattice distortion and Sm magnetism play a crucial role in weakening magnetic frustration, thereby rationalizing the experimental observations. These findings shed light on the complex interplay of crystal structure and magnetism in Cu-Ru double perovskites, and open up an avenue for tuning of magnetic properties through rare-earth-ion substitution.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过固相反应合成 La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆，并系统考察其结构、磁性和电子性质。X 射线衍射表明所有样品均为单斜结构，随 La³⁺ 被更小的 Sm³⁺ 替代，结构畸变增强；电阻率显示绝缘行为，低温由反位无序相关的变程跳跃主导。交流磁化率、热容和第一性原理计算共同表明，晶格畸变与 Sm 磁性削弱磁阻挫，为通过稀土离子取代调控 Cu-Ru 双钙钛矿磁性提供依据。
authors: Soumya Ghorai, Samir Rom, Irina Shamova, N. K. Karn, Tamanna Kumari, A. K. Shukla, Sanjoy Kr. Mahatha, O. Volkova, Nitesh Kumar Tanusri Saha Dasgupta, Setti Thirupathaiah

articles.title: Entropy Production Bounds the Accuracy of Computation in Markov Networks
articles.title_zh: 熵产生约束 Markov 网络中计算的准确性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Biological and artificial networks compute by transforming time-dependent inputs into functional outputs. Because the internal state of a stochastic network relaxes on finite timescales, its output generally lags behind a changing environment, producing computational errors. We show that for reversible continuous-time Markov networks the error admits a universal thermodynamic bound. Decomposing the total error into representation and lag contributions, we derive an inequality relating the lag error to the entropy production rate and a memory time equal to the integrated equilibrium autocorrelation of the output observable. The bound implies that accurate dynamical computation requires either substantial dissipation or long-lived memory encoded in slowly relaxing modes. We demonstrate these principles in artificial Markov networks and in models of biochemical information processing. Our results establish a thermodynamic limit on information processing in stochastic networks and provide a quantitative framework for understanding the energetic costs of biological computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究可逆连续时间 Markov 网络在处理随时间变化输入时的热力学限制。作者将总误差分解为表征误差和滞后误差，推导出滞后误差与熵产生率及输出观测量平衡自相关积分所定义的记忆时间之间的普适不等式。结果表明，精确动态计算需要足够耗散或由慢弛豫模编码的长寿命记忆，并在人工 Markov 网络和生化信息处理模型中得到展示。
authors: Songela W. Chen, David T. Limmer

articles.title: Can Strain or Anion Interchange Make an Unstable Structure Stable? Energetics, Lattice Dynamics and Strain-Tunable Band Gaps of Lithium Chalcohalide Antiperovskites (Li₃BA) and their Anion Interchange Variants (Li₃AB)
articles.title_zh: 应变或阴离子互换能否稳定不稳定结构？锂硫属卤化物反钙钛矿 Li₃BA 及其阴离子互换变体 Li₃AB 的能量学、晶格动力学与应变可调带隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites are a promising, non-toxic alternative to lead halide perovskites, with potential as solid electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. we computationally investigate a relatively unexplored anion-interchange mechanism by which cubic Li₃AB derivatives are obtained from the parent cubic antiperovskite Li₃BA (A = O, S, Se, Te, Po; B = F, Cl, Br, I). The calculated relative energy landscape provides a useful guide for anion-site selectivity and its role in structural stability. The energetic stability results reveal that the smaller anion inside the octahedron stabilizes the structures. The lattice-dynamic calculations confirm that Li₃FA (A = Te, Po) and Li₃OB (B = Cl, Br, I), which are the most energetically stable compounds, are dynamically stable cubic phases without imaginary phonon modes. However, Li₃FS and Li₃FSe, while energetically stable, are dynamically unstable at equilibrium and become dynamically stable under triaxial compressive strain. In addition, we report the electronic structure and density of states (DOS) of all compounds, which show a substantial change in band gap upon anion interchange. The strain engineering of the lithium chalcohalide family illustrates how a few percent of the strain can tune the electronic band gap within the electrochemical stability window for solid battery applications. This study unveils essential characteristics of the anion site-interchange mechanism and provides a foundation for the understanding and design of lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文计算研究锂硫属卤化物反钙钛矿 Li₃BA 及其阴离子互换立方衍生物 Li₃AB（A=O,S,Se,Te,Po；B=F,Cl,Br,I）的稳定性与电子结构。相对能量景观显示，较小阴离子位于八面体内部有利于结构稳定；声子计算确认 Li₃FA（A=Te,Po）和 Li₃OB（B=Cl,Br,I）为无虚频的动态稳定立方相。Li₃FS 和 Li₃FSe 虽在能量上稳定，但平衡态动态不稳定，可在三轴压缩应变下稳定；阴离子互换还显著改变带隙。
authors: Ismail A. Buliyaminu, Ehsan Gowdini, Phillip Duxbury, Jose L. Mendoza-Cortes

articles.title: Intertwined spin-charge stripe order and polar lattice distortion in La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: La₃Ni₂O₇ 中交织的自旋-电荷条纹序与极性晶格畸变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-temperature density-wave state of La₃Ni₂O₇ hosts pronounced spin-density-wave (SDW) order, while recent experiments further reveal charge redistribution and a concomitant lattice-symmetry lowering. However, the microscopic relationship among spin, charge, and lattice remains unclear. Using first-principles calculations, we investigate the pressure evolution of the electronic structure and static spin susceptibility of La₃Ni₂O₇, together with the energetics and lattice response of representative magnetic configurations. We trace the SDW instability to strong Fermi-surface nesting and find that the high-pressure spin response closely tracks Tₘₐₜₕᵣₘ C, suggesting spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing. Among the candidate magnetic states considered, the spin-charge-stripe states emerge as energetically favored and dynamically stable, developing pronounced disproportionation of both the local Ni moments and the Ni--O bond lengths. Remarkably, the lowest-energy a-stripe state spontaneously relaxes into the experimentally proposed polar Am2m structure through a polar distortion along the b axis. These results establish a unified picture in which spin, charge, and lattice responses are strongly intertwined in the low-pressure density-wave state, while spin fluctuations remain a plausible ingredient of superconductivity under pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用第一性原理计算研究 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中低温密度波态的自旋、电荷与晶格耦合关系。结果将自旋密度波不稳定性归因于强费米面嵌套，并发现高压下自旋响应与超导转变温度趋势密切相关，暗示自旋涨落介导配对。候选磁态中，自旋-电荷条纹态在能量上更有利且动态稳定，伴随 Ni 局域磁矩和 Ni-O 键长的显著不均匀化；最低能 a 条纹态还自发弛豫到实验提出的极性 Am2m 结构。
authors: Xiaoying Li, Wenqian Tu, Run Lv, Li'e Liu, Dingfu Shao, Yuping Sun, Wenjian Lu

articles.title: Spectrally Programmable Spin-Polarized Photocurrents in WSe₂₋NiPS₃ Magnetic van der Waals Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: WSe₂-NiPS₃ 磁性范德华异质结构中的光谱可编程自旋极化光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient generation and control of spin-polarized currents in semiconductors remain central challenges for spin-based electronics, particularly due to impedance mismatch and the reliance on magnetic fields or ferromagnetic contacts. Here, we introduce a materials platform for spectrally programmable spin transport based on a van der Waals heterostructure combining the antiferromagnetic semiconductor NiPS₃ with WSe₂. In a p-n diode architecture, circularly polarized excitation produces pronounced photoconductive resonances with spin polarization reaching 80% near the Neel temperature and persisting at 30% at room temperature. Remarkably, selected spectral bands retain their polarization sign across the magnetic phase transition, evidencing robust, spectrally protected spin-polarized current generation. Polarization-resolved photogalvanic measurements reveal a dominant circular injection-current mechanism, confirming spin-polarized carrier transport. First-principles calculations show that an applied electric field induces interfacial hybridization and spin-layer locking, giving rise to localized symmetry breaking and enhanced optical absorption while preserving global time-reversal symmetry. These results establish spectral tuning of excitation as a new control knob for spin transport, enabling spin-current generation without magnetic fields or polarization switching. Our findings position magnetic van der Waals heterostructures as a versatile platform for opto-spintronic functionality and spectrally programmable spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出由反铁磁半导体 NiPS₃ 与 WSe₂ 构成的范德华异质结构，用于实现可按光谱编程的自旋输运。在 p-n 二极管构型中，圆偏振激发产生显著光导共振，自旋极化在 Néel 温度附近可达 80%，室温仍保持约 30%。部分谱带在磁相变前后保持极化符号，偏振分辨光伏测量和第一性原理计算表明，圆注入电流、界面杂化与自旋-层锁定共同支持稳健的自旋极化载流子输运。
authors: Rajesh Kumar Yadav, Michal Poplinger, Adi Levi, Adi Harchol, Nirman Chakraborty, Thomas Brumme, Thomas Heine, Efrat Lifshitz, Doron Naveh

articles.title: Quantum encoding of structured light into in-plane topological spin textures
articles.title_zh: 将结构光的量子数编码到面内拓扑自旋纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured light offers a powerful means of controlling light-matter interactions through multiple tunable optical degrees of freedom. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the nucleation of asymmetric bimerons and antibimerons by pulsed Laguerre-Gaussian optical vortices in chiral ferromagnetic thin films with Cₙᵥ and D₂d symmetries, respectively. For optical vortices with orbital angular momentum (OAM) |m|=1, circularly polarized beams deterministically nucleate a single bimeron or antibimeron via the interplay of spin angular momentum, OAM, and magnetic chirality, whereas linearly polarized beams produce textures whose topological charge directly follows the OAM (Q=m). Optical vortices with OAM |m|>1 nucleate clusters and other configurations composed of multiple spin textures, whose morphology and topological charge depend sensitively on the optical quantum numbers and pulse parameters. These findings reveal a route to topology-selective writing through the encoding of optical quantum numbers into distinct in-plane topological magnetic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过微磁模拟研究脉冲 Laguerre-Gaussian 光学涡旋在具有 Cₙᵥ 和 D₂d 对称性的手性铁磁薄膜中成核非对称双半子和反双半子。对于轨道角动量 |m|=1 的光涡旋，圆偏振光可通过自旋角动量、轨道角动量与磁手性的耦合确定性写入单个双半子或反双半子；线偏振光生成的纹理拓扑荷直接跟随 OAM，即 Q=m。对于 |m|>1，光涡旋可成核由多个自旋纹理组成的簇和复杂构型，其形貌与拓扑荷受光学量子数和脉冲参数控制。
authors: Pavel A. Vorobyev, Daichi Kurebayashi, Oleg A. Tretiakov

articles.title: Reentrance and temperature chaos in the p-spin Ising spin glass
articles.title_zh: p 自旋 Ising 自旋玻璃中的重入与温度混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reentrant transitions and temperature chaos are two unusual properties of spin glasses and had long been considered physically unrelated. We recently established a logical relation between these two phenomena [Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)]. In the present paper, we provide an explicit example of this logical relation in the fully connected Ising p-spin glass with a ferromagnetic bias. By expanding the free energy around the triple point, we show analytically that the ferromagnetic--spin glass boundary is reentrant in the vicinity of the triple point throughout the examined range of finite p>2. It then follows from the above logical relation that there exists at least one pair of distinct temperatures in the spin glass phase for which the overlap of spin configurations vanishes. This is a necessary condition for temperature chaos, but it would be quite unusual for the overlap to vanish only for selected temperature pairs but not for others within a single spin glass phase. These results therefore strongly suggest the existence of temperature chaos in the sense that the overlaps of spin configurations vanish for all temperature pairs throughout the spin glass phase. Independent evidence for this behavior is provided by a two-temperature replica calculation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在带铁磁偏置的全连接 Ising p 自旋玻璃中，给出重入相变与温度混沌之间逻辑关系的显式例子。作者在三重点附近展开自由能，解析证明在考察的有限 p>2 范围内，铁磁-自旋玻璃相边界在三重点附近呈重入行为。根据先前建立的逻辑关系，这意味着自旋玻璃相中至少存在一对不同温度使自旋构型重叠为零，并强烈暗示更一般意义上的温度混沌。

articles.title: Arithmetic Tuning of Dynamical Critical Exponents in Quasiperiodic Localization Transitions
articles.title_zh: 准周期局域化转变中动力学临界指数的算术调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The critical exponents and universality classes of localization transitions in quasiperiodic systems are of fundamental importance for understanding critical phenomena in aperiodic systems. Here we show that the dynamical critical behavior can be tuned without adding new terms or changing the form of the Hamiltonian, but solely by varying the incommensurate frequency of the quasiperiodic onsite potential. We construct a family of incommensurate frequencies from the limiting ratios of generalized Fibonacci sequences controlled by the parameters (m,n), and use them to define the quasiperiodic onsite potential. By combining generalized fidelity susceptibility, localization-length scaling, and finite-size gap analysis, we find that the correlation-length exponent is insensitive to the choice of the incommensurate frequency and remains consistent with the correlation-length critical exponent, ν simeq 1, in the localization transition of the standard Aubry--Andr'e--Harper model. In contrast, the dynamical exponent extracted from the low-energy gap scaling varies systematically with the incommensurate frequency. Our results show that changing the incommensurate frequency provides a simple way to tune dynamical critical scaling in deterministic aperiodic systems. Our results suggest instead that the arithmetic structure of an irrational number can serve as a control parameter for nonequilibrium quantum dynamics, enabling the tuning of dynamical critical behavior without changing the microscopic Hamiltonian or the physical spatial dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究准周期体系局域化转变的临界行为，指出无需改变哈密顿量形式或加入新项，仅通过改变准周期在位势的无理频率即可调控动力学临界指数。作者用由广义 Fibonacci 序列极限比构造的无理频率族，并结合广义保真易感性、局域化长度标度和有限尺寸能隙分析，发现关联长度指数对频率选择不敏感，仍接近标准 Aubry-André-Harper 模型的 ν≈1；而由低能能隙标度提取的动力学指数随无理频率系统变化。
authors: Tian-Cheng Yi, Yi-Fan Liu, Enguo Guan, Wen-Long You

articles.title: Scattering-Induced Magnon Layer-Hall Transport beyond Band Geometry
articles.title_zh: 超越能带几何的散射诱导磁振子层霍尔输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The layer Hall effect has been exclusively attributed to layer-locked Berry curvature, posing a fundamental barrier to its realization in conventional magnets. Here we report a fundamentally distinct layer Hall effect for bosonic excitations, i.e., magnons, which originates solely from non-reciprocal dipolar scattering at heterointerfaces, thereby decoupling the phenomenon from geometric-phase mechanisms. Using a microscopic scattering theory, we demonstrate that a longitudinal temperature gradient drives opposite transverse thermal Hall currents in a nanowire atop a magnetic film, with the direction fully reconfigurable by the applied magnetic field. The effect yields a significant Hall angle of sim 6ⁱ̧rc in conventional magnetic heterostructures, eliminating the need for topological engineering. Our findings establish a scattering-driven paradigm for layer Hall effect, extendable to ferrons and polar phonons, and predict a Hall response that is readily detectable in conventional magnetic heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种不同于层锁定 Berry 曲率机制的磁振子层霍尔效应，其来源是异质界面处非互易偶极散射。基于微观散射理论，作者表明纵向温度梯度可在置于磁性薄膜上的纳米线中驱动相反方向的横向热霍尔流，且方向可由外加磁场重构。该效应在常规磁性异质结构中可产生约 6° 的霍尔角，不依赖拓扑能带工程，并可能推广到 ferron 和极性声子体系。
authors: Zhiping Xue, Zhoujian Sun, Xiyin Ye, Lei Zhang, Tao Yu

articles.title: Weaving Hopfions from Emergent Monopoles in a Chiral Magnet
articles.title_zh: 在手性磁体中由涌现单极子编织 Hopfion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in three-dimensional magnetization imaging techniques have opened new avenues for exploring topological spin textures beyond domain walls and skyrmions. Among them, magnetic hopfions are particularly promising, as their knotted topology is expected to give rise to unconventional dynamics and responses; however, their controlled creation remains challenging. Here we propose a simple mechanism for generating hopfions from magnetic torons, three-dimensional textures hosting an emergent monopole-antimonopole pair. Using Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations, we show that an electric current drives the annihilation of this pair, converting a toron into a hopfion. The initial toron length determines the number of generated hopfions, while the current direction selects the sign of the Hopf invariant. We further find that the threshold current depends sensitively on material parameters, indicating a close connection to skyrmion dynamics. Our results establish an experimentally accessible route to hopfion creation and reveal a pathway from monopole defects to knotted topological textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出从磁 toron 可控生成磁 hopfion 的机制，其中 toron 是含有涌现单极子—反单极子对的三维自旋纹理。Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 模拟显示，电流可驱动该单极子对湮灭，从而将 toron 转化为 hopfion；初始 toron 长度决定生成 hopfion 的数目，电流方向选择 Hopf 不变量符号。阈值电流对材料参数敏感，表明该过程与斯格明子动力学密切相关。
authors: Shoya Kasai, Kotaro Shimizu, Shun Okumura, Yukitoshi Motome

articles.title: Neutron scattering evidence for two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic lattice in α-Cu2P2O7
articles.title_zh: α-Cu2P2O7 中二维耦合自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格的中子散射证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic magnetic model of the low-dimensional quantum magnet alpha-Cu2P2O7 has remained controversial. We present a comprehensive study of its magnetic ground state and excitation spectrum using temperature-dependent inelastic neutron scattering, neutron diffraction, magnetization measurements, and comprehensive spin-wave modeling. Our results unambiguously establish alpha-Cu2P2O7 as a two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic (AF) lattice within the bc plane, with a dominant AF exchange J2 = 7.73 meV (hereafter referred to as "intradimer exchange") and weaker exchange couplings J1, J3, and J4 in the two-dimensional lattice (hereafter referred to as "interdimer exchange"), in agreement with LDA-based density functional theory and in contrast to previous GGA+U predictions. The dominant intradimer AF exchange is found between seventh-nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 5.125(3) A] rather than nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 3.014(1) A] of the structural dimers. Weak interlayer coupling (J5 = 0.03 meV) stabilizes long-range antiferromagnetic order below TN = 25 K. We further identify a weak single-ion anisotropy, associated with the distorted CuO5 polyhedra, that opens a gap in the spin-excitation spectrum and drives a field-induced metamagnetic transition. Systematic spin-wave calculations elucidate the distinct roles of interlayer coupling J5 and anisotropy term D in producing two distinct energy gaps at different antiferromagnetic zone centers. Complementary neutron diffraction and magnetization measurements as a function of applied magnetic field uncover a previously overlooked metamagnetic transition near 13 kOe and allow construction of the magnetic phase diagram in the H-T plane.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作结合温度依赖非弹性中子散射、中子衍射、磁化测量和自旋波建模，澄清低维量子磁体 α-Cu2P2O7 的微观磁模型。结果表明其为 bc 面内二维耦合的自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，主导二聚体内反铁磁交换为 J2=7.73 meV，弱的二维二聚体间交换为 J1、J3、J4，并与基于 LDA 的密度泛函结果一致而不同于此前 GGA+U 预测。主导交换发生在第七近邻 Cu-Cu 对而非结构二聚体中的最近邻 Cu-Cu 对；弱层间耦合 J5=0.03 meV 稳定了 TN=25 K 以下的长程反铁磁序。
authors: B. Ghanta, K. S. Chikara, M. Ghanathe, L. Keller, D. Voneshen, A. K. Bera

articles.title: Phase-controlled perfect nonlocal spin and charge diode effects in a four-terminal Josephson junction with p-wave magnets
articles.title_zh: 含 p 波磁体四端 Josephson 结中的相位可控完美非局域自旋与电荷二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24147v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate charge and spin transport in a four-terminal Josephson junction with a normal-metal barrier. The top and bottom superconducting leads are equal-spin triplet p_y-wave superconductors, while the left and right leads are p-wave magnets with proximity-induced conventional s-wave superconductivity. When the transverse macroscopic phase difference between the top and bottom leads is set to zero, a longitudinal phase bias generates a pure transverse spin current with perfect 100% nonreciprocity. Remarkably, a finite transverse phase difference preserves the perfect spin-diode effect while simultaneously inducing a perfect charge-diode effect, enabling fully nonreciprocal spin and charge transport. Moreover, the spin-diode efficiency exhibits sharp, step-like switching as a function of both the gate voltage applied to the barrier and the crystallographic orientation of the p-wave magnet, providing independent and experimentally accessible knobs for controlling the diode polarity. The diode response remains robust against asymmetric interface couplings, nonmagnetic disorder, variations in the relative singlet and triplet pairing strengths, temperature, and junction dimensions, demonstrating that the effect is not a consequence of fine-tuned parameters. These findings establish the proposed four-terminal junction as a highly tunable and structurally robust platform for dissipationless, phase-controlled spin and charge rectification, with potential applications in superconducting spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作研究含正常金属势垒的四端 Josephson 结中的电荷和自旋输运，其中上下超导端为等自旋三重态 p_y 波超导体，左右端为具有邻近诱导 s 波超导性的 p 波磁体。当上下端横向宏观相位差为零时，纵向相位偏置可产生纯横向自旋流，并具有 100% 非互易性；有限横向相位差在保持完美自旋二极管效应的同时诱导完美电荷二极管效应。自旋二极管效率可随势垒栅压和 p 波磁体晶向发生阶跃式切换，且对界面不对称、非磁性无序及配对成分变化具有鲁棒性。
authors: Lovy Sharma, Bimal Ghimire, Manisha Thakurathi

articles.title: Frustration-induced degenerate spin state with up-up-down-down ordering in corner-connected Heisenberg square-plaquettes
articles.title_zh: 角连接 Heisenberg 方格小 plaquette 中挫折诱导的上上-下下简并自旋态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate frustrated magnetism of a corner-connected square plaquette Heisenberg model with exchange interactions along the edges (J₁₎, along inter-plaquette links (J₂₎, and along square diagonals (J₃₎. Using Luttinger--Tisza (LT) minimization of the Fourier interaction matrix mathcal J(mathbf q) together with large-scale Monte Carlo (MC) simulations, we obtain a classical low-temperature magnetic phase diagram in the normalized plane (J₁/|J₂|, J₃/|J₂|). The two methods play complementary roles: the LT analysis provides the zero-temperature candidate ordering wave vectors, while the MC simulations elucidate the resulting ordering tendencies under the hard-spin constraint at low but finite temperatures. Three regimes emerge at low temperatures, an antiferromagnetic phase (AF), a ferromagnetic phase (FM) and a degenerate spin state with up-up-down-down (uudd) ordering (DS). For the frustrated degenerate spinstate, LT exhibits line-like minima along qₓ₌± q_y in the hk-plane, revealing a highly degenerate spin configuration which violates the hard-spin constraint. The MC results uncover a state with quasi-two-dimensional ordering. The DS regime is intrinsically multi-q: the ordered texture assembles itself from symmetry-related modes on the lines, producing a ``uudd'' spin arrangement comprising of distinctive strong antiferromagnetic correlations on diagonals, ferromagnetic correlations on corner links, and highly suppressed correlations on the edges. The field-temperature phase diagram for a representative parameter point in the DS regime, determined by MC simulations, yields field induced distinct regions of negatively and positively correlated layers. These two regions are separated by a curve corresponding to negligible inter-layer correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究角连接方格 plaquette Heisenberg 模型的经典挫折磁性，交换相互作用包括边上 J1、plaquette 间连接 J2 以及对角线 J3。作者结合 Luttinger-Tisza 傅里叶相互作用矩阵最小化和大规模 Monte Carlo 模拟，在归一化参数平面中得到低温相图，包含反铁磁、铁磁以及具有上上-下下序的简并自旋态。对挫折简并态，Luttinger-Tisza 分析给出 hk 平面中沿 qx=±qy 的线状能量极小，显示高度简并且不满足硬自旋约束；Monte Carlo 则揭示出准二维有序倾向。

articles.title: A Minimal Thermodynamically Consistent Chemical Oscillator
articles.title_zh: 一个最小的热力学自洽化学振荡器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by the chemical reaction network considered as the smallest system featuring a Hopf bifurcation and its reversible extension, we introduce an even more minimal reaction network that is thermodynamically consistent and exhibits autonomous oscillations under nonequilibrium driving. The model combines three features that are rarely realized simultaneously in compact oscillator networks: a chemically plausible structure restricted to uni- and bimolecular reactions, reversibility of such reactions, and analytical tractability. The system consists of three internal species coupled to two chemostatted species and still undergoes a supercritical Hopf bifurcation when a chemostat concentration is varied. To analyze the dynamics and thermodynamics near the onset of oscillations, we employ the mathematical technique of normal-form reduction, which allows obtaining a controlled irreversible approximation that preserves the leading phase-space structure of the full reversible network while enabling explicit calculations. This framework provides analytical access to the bifurcation structure and the leading contributions governing thermodynamic observables. Within this setting, we use the onset of oscillations to characterize the thermodynamic response of the system. In particular, we offer an analytical description of key thermodynamic quantities such as the semi-grand Gibbs free energy and the non-conservative work rate, which exhibit a kink-like discontinuity at the Hopf bifurcation. We thus provide an analytical description of a phenomenon previously characterized only through numerical simulations of more complex networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个更简约且热力学自洽的反应网络，可在非平衡驱动下产生自主振荡。模型由三个内部物种和两个化学恒定物种组成，仅含化学上合理的单分子与双分子可逆反应，并在调节某一恒定物种浓度时发生超临界 Hopf 分岔。作者利用正规形约化分析振荡起始附近的动力学与热力学，得到保持主要相空间结构的受控不可逆近似，从而解析刻画分岔结构及热力学耗散的主导贡献。
authors: Benedikt Remlein, Luca Monari, Beatrice Bartolomei, Giulio Ragazzon, Massimiliano Esposito, Emanuele Penocchio

articles.title: Excitonic fingerprints of magnetic configurations and switching in multilayer CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 多层 CrSBr 中磁构型与磁切换的激子指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coupling between electronic states and magnetism provides a route towards optical readout and control of magnetic information. In the magnetic semiconductor CrSBr, excitons are coupled to magnetic order, making their optical response sensitive to the underlying magnetization. Here, we show that the energy and oscillator strength of bulk and surface excitons provide distinct spectroscopic fingerprints of magnetic configurations and switching pathways. We distinguish domain-wall-mediated magnetization reversal, manifested by continuous spectral evolution as a domain wall traverses the optical spot, from abrupt, large-area magnetization reversal. Using the resulting excitonic fingerprints, we reconstruct successive magnetic configurations in 4- and 5-layer CrSBr during the transition from ferromagnetic to antiferromagnetic order. We further find that the sensitivity to magnetic order is strongly exciton-dependent: low-energy excitons resolve intermediate and surface-related configurations, whereas a higher-energy exciton predominantly exhibits a transfer of oscillator strength between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic resonances. These results establish excitonic spectroscopy as a sensitive probe of layer-dependent magnetic configurations and their switching pathways in layered magnetic semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 CrSBr 中激子与磁有序的耦合，展示体激子和表面激子的能量及振子强度可作为磁构型与切换路径的光谱指纹。作者区分了畴壁穿过光斑时导致的连续光谱演化与大面积突发磁化翻转，并据此重构 4 层和 5 层 CrSBr 从铁磁到反铁磁转变过程中的连续磁构型。不同激子对磁序的敏感性显著不同：低能激子可分辨中间态和表面相关构型，高能激子主要表现为铁磁与反铁磁共振之间的振子强度转移。
authors: Lukas Krelle, Ryan Tan, Jakob Conradi, Priyanka Mondal, Wenze Lan, Kseniia Mosina, Regine von Klitzing, Zdenek Sofer, Bernhard Urbaszek

articles.title: Two Microscopic Mechanisms of Piezomagnetism in CoF₂ from First-Principles Calculations
articles.title_zh: 第一性原理揭示 CoF2 压磁性的两种微观机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rutile-structured CoF₂ has long been recognized as a prototypical piezomagnetic material. Recently, it has attracted renewed interest as an altermagnet, exhibiting spin-split electronic bands even in the absence of spin-orbit coupling.
