articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用多层电子叠层衍射成像直接观察 Sr₂CuO₃₊δ 薄膜中的氧掺杂原子，解决铜氧化物超导体中氧掺杂原子尺度可视化的难题。实验发现氧掺杂位于 Cu–O 链之间的间隙位置，并强烈倾向于在拉伸应变区域聚集，这些区域通常与位错和界面台阶相关。结果表明铜氧化物中的氧掺杂分布并非随机，而是对应变场高度敏感，提示应变可作为调控掺杂的重要参数。
authors: Hongbin Yang, Jinkwon Kim, Desheng Ma, Dasol Yoon, Darrell G. Schlom, David A. Muller

articles.title: Signatures of a light-induced exciton condensate exhibiting BEC-BCS crossover
articles.title_zh: 光诱导激子凝聚及其 BEC–BCS 交叉的实验迹象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exciton condensates provide a platform to study quasiparticle pairing, Bose-Einstein condensation-Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BEC-BCS) crossover, and excitonic topological phenomena. Achieving a nonequilibrium exciton condensate allows the ultimate tunability of these emergent phenomena. Yet, evidence of a light-induced, nonequilibrium exciton condensate and its BEC-BCS crossover remains elusive. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to demonstrate signatures of a non-equilibrium exciton condensate and its BEC-BCS crossover in monolayer MnBi2Te4. Following optical excitation, a distinctive hole-like dispersion representing excitons emerges and persists for >20 ps. Strikingly, energy-domain sharpening in the valence band occurs 2 ps after time zero and exhibits a sharp onset at a threshold pump fluence of 0.84 mJ/cm2. The delayed and strongly nonlinear response is difficult to reconcile with transient field effects or conventional carrier-induced band shifts but is consistent with a model of exciton condensation governed by a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition. The estimated threshold exciton density agrees quantitatively with the Nelson-Kosterlitz critical density. At higher fluences, the exciton feature develops a camel-back-shaped dispersion, consistent with the BEC-BCS crossover in the condensate framework. Our work establishes ultrathin MnBi2Te4 as a model system for studying nonequilibrium exciton condensates with a connection to superconductivity and exciton-driven topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱研究单层 MnBi2Te4 中光激发后的非平衡激子态，观测到持续超过 20 ps 的空穴型色散信号。价带能谱在约 2 ps 后出现锐化，并在泵浦通量 0.84 mJ/cm2 附近呈现阈值式非线性起始。作者认为这些特征难以由瞬态场效应或常规载流子诱导能带移动解释，而与受 Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless 转变控制的激子凝聚模型相符，指向光诱导激子凝聚及 BEC–BCS 交叉的证据。
authors: Khanh Duy Nguyen, Gabriele Berruto, Yunhe Bai, Thomas Marchese, Woojoo Lee, Haoran Lin, Jiangang Yang, Chong Liu, Y. Shirley Meng, Shuolong Yang

articles.title: Imaging the vacuum fluctuations of a quantum field
articles.title_zh: 量子场真空涨落的成像观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heisenberg uncertainties lead to inevitable fluctuations in the measurement outcomes for quantum-mechanical observables. For quantum fields, these uncertainties result in random spatial structures in snapshots of a field, even when the field is in its ground (vacuum) state. Such `vacuum fluctuations' are at the heart of a wide range of phenomena, from spontaneous decay processes to the Casimir force and Hawking radiation. Their existence is a key manifestation of the quantumness of the physical world, but usually it is only their consequences that are directly observed. Here, we directly observe spatial vacuum fluctuations of a bosonic quantum field. Our experiments are based on a homogeneous planar atomic Bose--Einstein condensate. The condensate comprises two coherently coupled interacting components (spin states), and the quantum field describes its spin degrees of freedom. In the regime where the interactions dominate over the coherent coupling, our system emulates a (massive relativistic) sine-Gordon field. Images of the field reveal simultaneous fluctuations on different length scales, with scale-dependent amplitudes consistent with theoretical predictions for a vacuum state. Observing such fluctuations in the sine-Gordon limit opens many possibilities for laboratory simulations of relativistic fields in regimes that are presently not theoretically tractable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在均匀二维原子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体中直接成像玻色量子场的空间真空涨落。体系由两个相干耦合且相互作用的自旋组分构成，在相互作用主导时可模拟有质量相对论性 sine-Gordon 场。实验图像显示不同长度尺度上的同时涨落，其尺度依赖幅度与量子真空涨落预期一致，从而直接可视化通常只通过效应间接观测的真空涨落。
authors: Yansheng Zhang, Feiyang Wang, Yi Jiang, Alexander C. Jenkins, Paul H. C. Wong, Christoph Eigen, Gehrig Carlse, Zoran Hadzibabic

articles.title: Torus Berry Data Determine All-Genus Abelian Topological Orders
articles.title_zh: 环面 Berry 数据决定所有亏格的阿贝尔拓扑序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that for Abelian Chern-Simons topological orders, torus Berry matrices determine the all-genus extended TQFT. We identify the topological part of the projective Berry holonomy under metric deformations with the mapping-class-group representation of the Abelian Chern-Simons TQFT and prove that the normalized torus data reconstruct its finite quadratic module (G,q). Recent work showed that (G,q) classifies the extended theory up to symmetric monoidal natural isomorphism, then genus-one data determine the all-genus theory without choosing a K-matrix presentation. We also prove that, for normalized character row errors δ<21.96%, nearest-row decoding recovers the Abelian fusion algebra independently of the number of anyons. The result applies to Abelian fractional quantum Hall and spin-liquid phases described by even-lattice Chern-Simons theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作证明，对于阿贝尔 Chern–Simons 拓扑序，环面上的 Berry 矩阵足以确定所有亏格的扩展拓扑量子场论。作者将度规形变下投影 Berry holonomy 的拓扑部分识别为映射类群表示，并证明归一化环面数据可重构有限二次模 (G,q)，从而无需选择 K 矩阵表象即可确定全理论。文中还给出在归一化特征行误差小于 21.96% 时恢复阿贝尔融合代数的最近行解码结果，适用于偶格 Chern–Simons 理论描述的阿贝尔分数量子霍尔和自旋液体相。

articles.title: Holographic Local Operator Quenches with Conserved Momentum and Spin
articles.title_zh: 具有守恒动量和自旋的全息局域算符淬火
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19305v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the holographic dictionary relating point particles carrying longitudinal momentum or angular momentum in asymptotically AdS₃ spacetimes to suitably regulated, time-evolved states created by local primary operators in the dual two-dimensional conformal field theory (2D CFT). We find that asymmetric left/right Euclidean smearing of local operators produces states carrying momentum, and the corresponding bulk excitation is a particle with conserved momentum. We compute the energy density and entanglement entropy in these states and in their dual back-reacted geometries, finding exact agreement between the CFT and gravity descriptions. We further extend this correspondence to particles with intrinsic spin, whose CFT duals are primary operators with unequal holomorphic and anti-holomorphic scaling dimensions. We again find a precise match between CFT and holographic calculations of energy densities and entanglement entropies. Finally, we explore applications of these setups beyond holography by deriving the evolution of Rényi entropies in 2D rational CFTs and introducing a new class of local quantum quench protocols with conserved longitudinal or angular momentum.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究 AdS3 时空中携带纵向动量或角动量的点粒子与二维共形场论中经适当正则化、时间演化的局域初级算符态之间的全息字典。作者发现，左右欧氏涂抹不对称的局域算符可产生携带动量的态，其体相对偶为具有守恒动量的粒子，并在能量密度和纠缠熵上与引力侧精确一致。研究还推广到具有内禀自旋的粒子，对应全纯与反全纯标度维数不等的初级算符，并进一步讨论了有理 CFT 中 Rényi 熵演化和新的局域量子淬火协议。
authors: Pawel Caputa, Pedro Castellini Grand, Justin R. David, Rahul Metya

articles.title: Dissipation-enhanced scrambling in the SYK model coupled to a lossy cavity
articles.title_zh: 耦合有损腔的 SYK 模型中的耗散增强扰乱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19310v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, a disordered model of N Majorana fermions and R=γ N bosons in which the bosons are linearly coupled to independent realizations of SYK p-body interactions, in the presence of dissipation, modeled by a Lindblad master equation. Motivated by recent proposals for implementing SYK models in quantum simulators, we focus on bosonic leakage at rate κ. Initializing the system in the steady state, we analyze the late-time fermionic relaxation rate and the Lyapunov exponent, solving the large-N theory both numerically and for p large, finding a rich landscape of dynamical behaviors. Most notably, the Lyapunov exponent remains positive for every value of κ and, for p>2, can even grow as κ increases. The QED case p=2, which lies between the fully chaotic regime p>2 and the integrable case p=1, exhibits special features. We also identify a critical value of the boson-to-fermion ratio γ_c approx 2/p² separating distinct dynamical regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究含 N 个 Majorana 费米子和 R=γN 个玻色子的 Yukawa–Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev 模型，并用 Lindblad 主方程描述玻色泄漏耗散。作者在大 N 极限下数值和大 p 解析求解晚时费米弛豫率与 Lyapunov 指数，发现丰富的动力学行为。主要结果是 Lyapunov 指数在任意泄漏率 κ 下保持为正，且对 p>2 甚至可随 κ 增大而增强；同时识别出 γ_c≈2/p2 的临界玻色/费米比例，分隔不同动力学区域。
authors: Pietro Pelliconi, Bastien Lapierre, Shinsei Ryu

articles.title: Thermal Throttling of Quantum State Transfer
articles.title_zh: 量子态传输的热节流效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum state transfer on qubit lattices is a crucial step in a panoply of quantum information processing tasks. Understanding its fundamental limits in the presence of practical imperfections remains a pressing open question. In particular, it is unclear how thermal noise in the intermediate ancilla sites impedes transfer. In this work, we derive tight lower bounds on the necessary growth of commutator norms to achieve approximate state transfer. Specializing to 1D power-law systems with thermal ancilla states, we demonstrate that state transfer runtimes depend sensitively on the scaling of temperature with system size, improving logarithmic bounds to algebraic ones. Our work extends previous results on exact state transfer to the qualitatively different and more practically relevant regime of approximate state transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究量子比特晶格中近似量子态传输在中间辅助位热噪声存在时的基本限制。作者推导了实现近似态传输所需对易子范数增长的紧下界，并将其应用于一维幂律相互作用体系中的热辅助态。结果表明传输时间对温度随系统尺寸的标度极为敏感，可将此前的对数型限制强化为代数型限制，扩展了精确态传输理论到更实际的近似传输情形。
authors: Twesh Upadhyaya, T. C. Mooney, Yifan Hong, Alexey V. Gorshkov

articles.title: Simulating Black Hole Thermality and Interior Scrambling on a Superconducting Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 在超导量子处理器上模拟黑洞热性与内部扰乱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We implement a chiral spin-chain black hole simulator on IBM superconducting quantum hardware and probe, within a common microscopic framework, both semiclassical horizon physics and interacting quantum scrambling. We first measure the dispersion relation across the exterior, horizon and over-tilted interior regimes, reproducing the predicted evolution of the effective light-cone structure. To probe Hawking thermality, we prepare a localised excitation inside the horizon and monitor its density response at an exterior site, observing the predicted inverse relation between the peak arrival time and the surface gravity, thereby establishing a calibrated dynamical estimator of the Hawking temperature. Beyond the semiclassical regime, we continuously tune the interactions and distinguish non-exponential operator spreading in the free-fermion limit from Lyapunov-like OTOC decay in the strongly interacting chiral regime. These measurements use observable-specific Floquet circuits derived from the same parent chiral model, including its mean-field and coordinate-equivalent XY descriptions, to reduce circuit depth while preserving the physics relevant to each probe. Our results provide a unified programmable platform for studying horizon geometry, Hawking thermality and interacting scrambling on quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在 IBM 超导量子硬件上实现手性自旋链黑洞模拟器，并在统一微观模型中探测半经典视界物理和相互作用量子扰乱。实验测量外部、视界和过倾内部区域的色散关系，重现实效光锥结构的演化；通过在视界内制备局域激发并监测外部响应，观察到峰值到达时间与表面引力的反比关系，用作 Hawking 温度的动力学估计。进一步调节相互作用强度，区分自由费米子极限中的非指数算符扩展与强相互作用手性区域中的类 Lyapunov OTOC 衰减。
authors: Ryan Smith, Ewan Forbes, Iason Sofos Andrew Hallam, Jiannis Pachos

articles.title: Inflationary Bispectra and IR Physics from Quantum Simulators
articles.title_zh: 利用量子模拟器研究暴胀双谱与红外物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19327v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bose-Einstein condensates have been used successfully as quantum simulators for early-universe particle production. Here we extend this analogy to the interacting theory. To this end, we compute the leading interaction terms expected in a general experimental setup that determine the 3-point correlations. We apply them to cosmologically motivated expanding model universes, but also periodically oscillating ones. While expanding scale factors do not necessarily lead to easily observable signatures due to experimental constraints on the realizable scale factor, periodically driven ones produce resonant correlators that grow linearly over time and lend themselves well to experimental detection. One direct application of this analysis is the experimental study of late-time infrared divergencies often discussed in the context of massless scalars in de Sitter space.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体作为早期宇宙粒子产生的量子模拟平台，从自由理论推广到相互作用理论。作者推导了一般实验设置中决定三点关联的主导相互作用项，并将其应用于宇宙学动机的膨胀模型和周期振荡模型。结果表明，受实验可实现尺度因子限制，膨胀情形未必给出易观测信号；而周期驱动可产生随时间线性增长的共振关联，更适合实验探测，并可用于研究 de Sitter 空间无质量标量晚时红外发散问题。

articles.title: Glassy dynamics with softened kinetic constraints on a noisy quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子计算机上软化动力学约束的玻璃态动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mid-circuit measurements provide direct access to trajectory-level observables, revealing dynamical structures in many-body systems that are invisible in ensemble-averaged quantities. We exploit this capability to realize and study an instance of the Floquet-East model on a superconducting quantum processor. Here, the combination of mid-circuit measurements, kinetically constrained unitary operations and hardware noise gives rise to intricate many-body phenomena. Analyzing trajectories obtained from temporally and spatially resolved mid-circuit measurements, we identify dynamical heterogeneity --- a hallmark of glassy dynamics. We quantify this emergent behavior by studying the probability of finding inactive space-time regions of a given size. This quantity displays a crossover from an area- to perimeter-dominated scaling, which is a characteristic property of glasses and is associated with the proximity to a dynamical first-order phase transition. Our results establish current noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices as scalable testbeds for investigating correlated many-body phenomena at the level of measurement trajectories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用超导量子处理器的中途测量，在 Floquet-East 模型中获取轨迹级观测量。中途测量、动力学约束幺正操作与硬件噪声共同产生复杂多体行为，作者在时空分辨测量轨迹中识别出玻璃态动力学的标志——动力学非均匀性。通过统计给定大小非活性时空区域的概率，研究发现从面积主导到周长主导的标度交叉，这与接近动力学一阶相变的玻璃特征相符。
authors: Marcel Cech, Igor Lesanovsky, Federico Carollo

articles.title: Rethinking Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 重新思考量子线路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19370v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: These notes develop four interconnected ways of reading a quantum circuit. A circuit for us begins as an operational composition of gates; then, it becomes a diagram whose local equalities may be used as calculations; next, it becomes a protected process once errors, syndromes, and logical degrees of freedom are separated; and finally, it becomes geometric when its connectivity, topology, and boundary data are treated as physical design parameters. The development begins at the level of bits and qubits before appealing to Deutsch's and Grover's algorithms as basic examples of quantum circuits. With the basics in hand, we interpret quantum circuits diagramatically, leading us to compact closed string diagrams and the ZX-calculus. After that, we consider how to correct quantum circuits by introducing the Knill--Laflamme condition, homological surface codes, and related concepts with a view towards thinking of these as operations on diagrams. The lectures eventually arrive at the properties of hyperbolic quantum codes and the prospect of physical superconducting circuits emulating the negatively-curved lattices needed to support those codes. These mathematical ideas and physical experiments, taken together, represent one way to impart a geometric layer onto quantum circuits. By the very end, we bring the ideas nearly full circle by assessing the extent to which these device physics experiments operationalize the basic ZX diagrams encountered much earlier in the story. While the later material reports on original research, and while the discussion becomes increasingly mathematical as the sections progress, no prior knowledge of quantum information, quantum computing, or quantum error correction is actually assumed.
articles.abstract_zh: 这组讲义从四个相互关联的角度解读量子线路：门操作的运算组合、可用局域等式计算的图式、区分误差/症状/逻辑自由度后的受保护过程，以及由连通性、拓扑和边界数据决定的几何对象。内容从比特和量子比特出发，经 Deutsch 与 Grover 算法引入线路基础，再讨论紧闭弦图和 ZX 演算。后续部分涵盖 Knill–Laflamme 条件、同调表面码、双曲量子码及用超导物理线路模拟负曲率晶格的可能性。

articles.title: Stability and squeezing of the three-photon degenerate parametric down-conversion
articles.title_zh: 三光子简并参量下转换的稳定性与压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19494v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nonlinear multiphoton conversion processes are theoretically and experimentally challenging systems in quantum optics and related areas. These phenomena bring remarkable quantum properties and can be of fundamental relevance in quantum information and computation applications. Based on recent experimental advances and the possible uses in generalized three-photon squeezing, we investigate degenerate three-photon parametric down-conversion generated inside a cavity fed by a classical pump. In addition, we consider that the process is stimulated by a coherent driving mode and subjected to dissipation by spontaneous emission of the cavity. A treatment using phase-space methods and stochastic differential equations is applied and the stability conditions of its steady states are found. We find that the system does not exhibit multistability, instead it has a limited parameter region leading to a single stable steady branch, alongside multiple unstable branches. Focusing on the stable steady states and linearizing the dynamics around them, we calculate the spectral densities of the quadrature variables. We identify and characterize the squeezing of three-photon down-conversion. Moreover, since the quasi-probability differential equations of the higher-order multiphoton processes have higher-order derivatives, hindering their mapping into stochastic differential equations, we make use of a positive Wigner function approach to calculate two-dimensional spectral densities associated with three-time correlation functions, with the goal of studying non-Gaussian properties of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究由经典泵浦驱动腔内产生的简并三光子参量下转换，并考虑相干驱动模式激发以及腔自发辐射耗散。作者采用相空间方法和随机微分方程分析稳态稳定性，发现体系不表现多稳态，而是在有限参数区域内具有单一稳定稳态分支及多个不稳定分支。围绕稳定稳态线性化动力学后，计算了正交分量的谱密度，用于表征三光子压缩相关性质。
authors: Vinícius V. Seco, Alencar J. de Faria

articles.title: Cavity-Enhanced Activation of Radiatively Suppressed Light-Hole Exciton Emission in Colloidal Nanoplatelets
articles.title_zh: 腔增强激活胶体纳米片中辐射受抑轻空穴激子发光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19681v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Light-hole (LH) excitons provide access to well-defined polarization and spin degrees of freedom that are central to quantum photonics and chiral light-matter interactions. Achieving LH emission is challenging because LH states are energetically unfavoured and typically relax non-radiatively. Existing strategies to access LH excitons rely on modifying the electronic band structure through strain, shape anisotropy, or piezoelectric fields, approaches that are material-specific and offer limited post-synthesis tunability. Here we demonstrate an all-photonic route to activate LH exciton emission in colloidal CdSe-CdS nanoplatelets (NPLs) using a distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) cavity, without altering the underlying band structure. In the absence of a cavity mode, the system exhibits amplified spontaneous emission from heavy-hole (HH) states without detectable LH emission at low excitation powers. By spectrally matching a cavity resonance to the LH exciton, cavity-coupled LH emission emerges at significantly lower excitation powers. Temperature-dependent spectroscopy reveals reversible switching between LH- and HH-coupled emission through exciton-cavity detuning, while polarization-resolved and spectrally resolved time-resolved photoluminescence measurements provide independent evidence distinguishing the cavity-coupled LH and HH emission channels. These findings establish cavity engineering as a general materials-level approach for accessing radiatively suppressed optical states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种全光学方法，在不改变化学合成后能带结构的情况下，通过分布式布拉格反射镜腔激活 CdSe–CdS 胶体纳米片中的轻空穴激子发光。无腔模时，低激发功率下体系主要表现为重空穴态放大的自发辐射，未见明显轻空穴发光；当腔共振与轻空穴激子谱匹配时，轻空穴耦合发光可在显著更低激发功率下出现。温度依赖光谱显示轻空穴与重空穴耦合发光之间可逆切换，表明光学腔可作为调控激子发射通道的后合成手段。
authors: Komal Sharma, Riya Dutta, Prathmesh Deshmukh, Vinod M. Menon, Jaydeep K. Basu

articles.title: Dynamical one-from-many quantum metrology: Sum rule and matrix-free precision bound
articles.title_zh: 动态“一对多”量子计量：求和规则与无矩阵精度界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19988v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Practical quantum single-parameter estimation is rarely a pristine task; it almost invariably involves nuisance parameters, casting it as a one-from-many problem. Existing approaches to this problem rely on multi-parameter metrology, reducing the matrix quantum Cramér-Rao bound to obtain scalar quantum precision limits. However, these methods are often hampered by the demanding inversion of the quantum Fisher information (QFI) matrix and the requisite choice of a weight matrix, and they break down when the QFI matrix becomes singular. Here, we show that for dynamical one-from-many estimation, a previously overlooked sum rule connecting the QFI about all model parameters to the QFI about time necessitates including the latter to consider an augmented QFI matrix while simultaneously rendering it inherently singular--precisely the scenario where conventional approaches fail. To meet this challenge, we derive a tight, matrix-free quantum precision bound that involves only scalar quantities, offers broad applicability, and subsumes existing results as special cases. Validated in both unitary and noisy settings, our findings provide a refined operational framework for practical quantum single-parameter metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究存在干扰参数时的单参数量子估计问题，即从多参数模型中估计一个目标参数。作者指出，在动态估计中所有模型参数的量子费舍尔信息与时间量子费舍尔信息之间存在被忽略的求和规则，要求引入增广量子费舍尔信息矩阵，但该矩阵天然奇异，使传统基于矩阵求逆的多参数方法失效。为此，论文推导出只依赖标量量的紧致无矩阵量子精度界，并在幺正和含噪情形中验证其适用性。

articles.title: Robust two-dimensional surface superconductivity and vortex lattice in the Weyl semimetal γ-PtBi₂
articles.title_zh: Weyl 半金属 γ-PtBi₂ 中稳健的二维表面超导与涡旋晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.04867v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The layered compound γ-PtBi₂ is a topological semimetal with Fermi arcs at the surface joining bulk Weyl points. Recent work has found signatures of surface superconductivity consisting of gap openings compatible with a critical temperature orders of magnitude larger than the bulk value. However, no superconducting vortices have been identified, raising questions about the robustness of the phase coherence. Here we use very low temperature Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) and find robust superconductivity with T_C=2.9 K and HC₂approx1.8 T linked to the Fermi arcs. We observe quantized superconducting vortices and the Josephson effect, demonstrating two-dimensional macroscopic quantum phase coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: γ-PtBi₂ 是具有表面费米弧和体 Weyl 点的层状拓扑半金属，近期实验提示其表面存在远高于体超导转变温度的能隙特征。作者利用极低温扫描隧道显微镜发现与费米弧相关的稳健表面超导，转变温度约 2.9 K、上临界场约 1.8 T。实验进一步观测到量子化超导涡旋和 Josephson 效应，证明该表面态具有二维宏观量子相干性。
authors: Jose Antonio Moreno, Pablo García Talavera, Edwin Herrera, Sara López Valle, Zhuoqi Li, Lin-Lin Wang, Sergey Bud'ko, Alexander I. Buzdin, Isabel Guillamón, Paul C. Canfield, Hermann Suderow

articles.title: Bridging atomic and mesoscopic length scales with Replica Scanning Tunneling Microscopy: Visualizing the atomic lattice of UTe₂ and the atomic scale superconducting gap modulations of FeSe close to micron length scales
articles.title_zh: 用复制扫描隧道显微镜连接原子与介观尺度：在近微米尺度可视化 UTe₂ 原子晶格和 FeSe 原子尺度超导能隙调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.19678v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy is a cornerstone technique for visualizing the electronic density of states with atomic resolution (typically below 0.1 nm). While the field of view of most STM setups extends up to a few microns, obtaining atomic resolution over these large areas is often impractical and excessively time-consuming. This is due to the need to acquire maps with a point number reaching 10⁷ or more with a full current or conductance vs voltage curve at each point. The standard procedure is to make large scale maps and then select small regions to zoom-in for high-resolution atomic scale analysis. However, this approach fails to address a question which is often critical: Does a specific atomic-scale modulation of the electronic density of states persist over much larger, mesoscopic length scales? Here we present a new method: Replica STM (R-STM), that overcomes this limitation, allowing the study of atomic-scale phenomena up to micron length scales. We obtained new large-area STM tunneling conductance maps in UTe₂ and FeSe, spanning areas over 200 nm in size. In these large scale maps we discovered periodic signals with wavelengths significantly exceeding interatomic distances. We show that these large-wavelength periodic signals are replicas of the underlying atomic-scale density of states modulations. R-STM leverages these replica signals to efficiently track atomic-scale features over large areas. We discuss the influence of phase slips, disorder and defects in the replicas. Our results suggest that atomic scale modulations of the superconducting density of states could persist over large length scales in FeSe. R-STM provides a new capability for STM to compare atomic scale with micrometer scale phenomena. The proof of principle of R-STM can be extended to any other scanning probe microscopy experiment where a periodic signal is traced as a function of position.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出复制扫描隧道显微镜（R-STM）方法，用于在数百纳米乃至接近微米的视场内追踪原子尺度电子态调制。传统 STM 虽具亚纳米分辨率，但在大面积上逐点获取完整谱图代价极高，难以判断局域原子尺度特征是否在介观尺度持续存在。作者将该方法用于 UTe₂ 和 FeSe 的大面积隧穿电导成像，展示其可在超过 200 nm 的区域中识别周期性信号和原子尺度超导能隙调制。
authors: Miguel Águeda Velasco, Jose D. Bermúdez-Pérez, Pablo García Talavera, Raquel Sánchez-Barquilla, Jose Antonio Moreno, Juan Schmidt, Sergey L. Bud'ko, Paul C. Canfield, Georg Knebel, Midori Amano Patino, Gerard Lapertot, Jacques Flouquet, Jean Pascal Brison, Dai Aoki, Paula Giraldo-Gallo, Jose Augusto Galvis, Isabel Guillamón, Edwin Herrera Vasco, Hermann Suderow

articles.title: Analog Simulation of Massive Relativistic Quantum Fields in 2 + 1 Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 2+1 维大质量相对论量子场的模拟量子仿真
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08840v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum field theories provide fundamental models of complex interacting systems, from high-energy physics and cosmology to condensed matter. However, solving these models in non-perturbative and dynamical regimes is often challenging, particularly in more than one spatial dimension. Analog simulation using tunable synthetic quantum systems can both verify existing theoretical predictions and lead to new physical insights. Here, we realize analog simulation of massive relativistic quantum fields in 2+1 dimensions (two spatial dimensions and time), using two coherently coupled spin components in a uniform two-dimensional atomic Bose--Einstein condensate. Specifically, we encode the paradigmatic sine-Gordon model in the long-wavelength modes of the field describing the relative phase, φ, of the two components. In the perturbative regime, collective field excitations exhibit a relativistic dispersion with a tunable mass gap. We also observe explicitly non-perturbative phenomena, including the existence of topological domain walls across which φ rapidly winds by 2π. Our work opens possibilities for studies of cosmologically relevant phenomena including preheating, dynamics of topological defects, and relativistic false-vacuum decay.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用均匀二维原子 Bose-Einstein 凝聚体中的两个相干耦合自旋组分，实现了 2+1 维大质量相对论量子场的模拟量子仿真。作者将双组分相对相位场的长波模式编码为 sine-Gordon 模型，在微扰区观察到具有可调质量能隙的相对论色散集体激发。实验还直接观测到非微扰拓扑畴壁，即相位 φ 在畴壁两侧快速缠绕 2π，为研究宇宙学相关场论动力学提供了平台。
authors: Yansheng Zhang, Feiyang Wang, Paul H. C. Wong, Alexander C. Jenkins, Yi Jiang, Konstantinos Konstantinou, Gehrig Carlse, Nishant Dogra, Joseph H. Thywissen, Christoph Eigen, Zoran Hadzibabic

articles.title: Solvable model of noisy coupled oscillators with fully random interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有全随机相互作用的含噪耦合振子可解模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.04404v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a solvable spherical model of coupled oscillators with fully random interactions and distributed natural frequencies. Using the dynamical mean-field theory, we derive self-consistent equations for the stationary response and correlation functions. We show that the finite-temperature spin-glass transition is suppressed for any nonmonodisperse natural-frequency distribution, including continuous, discrete, and asymmetric distributions, because the resulting low-frequency singularity of the correlation function is incompatible with the spherical constraint. At zero temperature, however, a spin-glass phase persists for arbitrary frequency dispersion. This residual zero-temperature glassiness is likely a special feature of the spherical dynamics and would be destroyed by local nonlinearities. The model thus provides a solvable oscillator framework for studying how nonequilibrium perturbations suppress finite-temperature glassy freezing.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者构建了一个含全随机相互作用和分布式自然频率的可解球形耦合振子模型，并用动力学平均场理论推导稳态响应与关联函数的自洽方程。结果表明，只要自然频率分布不是单分散的，无论连续、离散还是非对称分布，有限温度自旋玻璃转变都会被抑制，因为关联函数的低频奇异性与球形约束不相容。零温下仍存在自旋玻璃相，但作者认为这可能是球形动力学的特殊性，实际局域非线性可能破坏这种残余玻璃性。

articles.title: Toward Greater Autonomy in Materials Discovery Agents: Unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists
articles.title_zh: 迈向更自主的材料发现智能体：统一规划、物理与科学家
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.05616v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We aim at designing language agents with greater autonomy for crystal materials discovery. While most of existing studies restrict the agents to perform specific tasks within predefined workflows, we aim to automate workflow planning given high-level goals and scientist intuition. To this end, we propose Materials Agent unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists, known as MAPPS. MAPPS consists of a Workflow Planner, a Tool Code Generator, and a Scientific Mediator. The Workflow Planner uses large language models (LLMs) to generate structured and multi-step workflows. The Tool Code Generator synthesizes executable Python code for various tasks, including invoking a force field foundation model that encodes physics. The Scientific Mediator coordinates communications, facilitates scientist feedback, and ensures robustness through error reflection and recovery. By unifying planning, physics, and scientists, MAPPS enables flexible and reliable materials discovery with greater autonomy, achieving a five-fold improvement in stability, uniqueness, and novelty rates compared with prior generative models when evaluated on the MP-20 data. We provide extensive experiments across diverse tasks to show that MAPPS is a promising framework for autonomous materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出面向晶体材料发现的语言智能体 MAPPS，目标是在高层目标和科学家直觉给定后自动规划工作流，而非局限于预设流程中的单一任务。MAPPS 由工作流规划器、工具代码生成器和科学中介组成，可生成多步结构化流程、合成可执行 Python 代码并调用包含物理知识的力场基础模型，同时通过反馈、错误反思和恢复提升稳健性。在 MP-20 数据集评估中，该框架相较既有生成模型在稳定性、唯一性和新颖性指标上实现约五倍提升。
authors: Lianhao Zhou, Hongyi Ling, Keqiang Yan, Kaiji Zhao, Xiaoning Qian, Raymundo Arróyave, Xiaofeng Qian, Shuiwang Ji

articles.title: Time correlations from steady-state expectation values
articles.title_zh: 从稳态期望值推断时间关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.08661v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recovering properties of correlation functions is typically challenging. On the one hand, experimentally, it requires measurements with a temporal resolution finer than the system's dynamics. On the other hand, analytical or numerical analysis requires solving the system evolution. Here, we use recent results of quantum metrology with continuous measurements to derive general lower bounds on the relaxation and second-order correlation times that are both easy to calculate and measure. These bounds are based solely on steady-state expectation values and their derivatives with respect to a system parameter, and can be readily extended to the autocorrelation of arbitrary observables. We validate our method on two examples of critical quantum systems: a critical driven-dissipative resonator, where the bound matches analytical results for the dynamics, and the infinite-range Ising model, where only the steady state is solvable, and thus the bound provides information beyond the reach of existing analytical approaches. Our results can be applied to the experimental characterization of ultrafast systems and to the theoretical analysis of many-body models whose dynamics are hard to compute.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文利用连续测量量子计量的最新结果，提出仅由稳态期望值及其对系统参数的导数给出的弛豫时间和二阶关联时间下界。该方法避免了实验上要求超高时间分辨率或理论上求解完整动力学的困难，并可推广到任意可观测量的自关联函数。作者在临界驱动-耗散谐振子和无限程 Ising 模型中验证该方法，前者与解析动力学结果相符，后者则在仅稳态可解时提供了新的动力学信息。
authors: Wojciech Górecki, Simone Felicetti, Lorenzo Maccone, Roberto Di Candia

articles.title: Ergotropic Mpemba crossings in finite-dimensional quantum batteries
articles.title_zh: 有限维量子电池中的遍历功 Mpemba 交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11056v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect is a counterintuitive phenomenon in which a state initially farther from equilibrium relaxes more rapidly than one that starts nearer to equilibrium. In the context of finite-dimensional quantum batteries interacting with an environment, we introduce the notion of an ergotropic Mpemba crossing (EMC), defined by the intersection of ergotropy trajectories during the dynamics. For qubit batteries subjected to amplitude damping noise, we derive a condition for the occurrence of EMC in terms of the relative coherence of the initial states and fully characterize the region of state space that exhibits EMC with respect to a fixed reference state. Interestingly, our analysis reveals that under anisotropic Pauli noise, the emergence of EMC is jointly governed by the coherence and the energy of the initial states. To elucidate the physical origin of EMC, we decompose ergotropy into coherent and incoherent contributions and show that, in qubit systems, the coherent component plays a crucial role for EMC, an observation that strikingly does not extend to three-level batteries, providing the dimensional role in observing EMC. Further, by extending our analysis to non-Markovian environments, we demonstrate that, unlike the Markovian case, non-Markovian dynamics can give rise to multiple Mpemba crossings, with the total number of crossings always being odd. Also, we propose a set-up showing that EMC can be utilized to suppress the ergotropic loss, occurred due to dissipation. Moreover, analyzing the connection between the EMC and the conventional state Mpemba effect reveals that, for qubits, an EMC necessarily entails a state Mpemba crossing, while this correspondence breaks down for qutrits, where EMCs may arise without any state Mpemba crossing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将量子 Mpemba 效应引入与环境相互作用的有限维量子电池，定义了遍历功轨迹在动力学中相交的“遍历功 Mpemba 交叉”。对于受振幅阻尼噪声作用的量子比特电池，作者给出该交叉出现的条件，并用初态相对相干性刻画相对于固定参考态的状态空间区域。在各向异性 Pauli 噪声下，交叉由初态相干性和能量共同控制；进一步分解遍历功显示，相干贡献在量子比特中起关键作用，但这一特征不直接推广到三能级电池。
authors: Triyas Sapui, Tanoy Kanti Konar, Aditi Sen De

articles.title: UPLOAD-ANYON: Progress Towards an Optimised Twisted Anyon Cavity with High-Sensitivity AM-Noise Detection for an Ultralight Axion Dark Matter Search
articles.title_zh: UPLOAD-ANYON：面向超轻轴子暗物质搜索的高灵敏调幅噪声探测优化扭曲任意子腔进展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a superconducting single-mode microwave haloscope based on helical cavity resonators for the detection of ultralight dark matter axions over the mass range 10⁻¹⁸ to 10⁻¹³,eV. Building on the single-mode helical-cavity concept introduced by Bourhill et al. [Phys. Rev. D 108, 052014 (2023); arXiv:2208.01640], we use an inverse-design framework to develop practical resonator geometries compatible with superconducting niobium fabrication. The optimisation employs a figure of merit derived to minimise the measurement time required to achieve a fixed experimental sensitivity. Relative to the heuristic Möbius-geometry benchmark, the best subtractively manufacturable bulk-niobium design achieves a figure of merit more than three orders of magnitude larger. An experimentally informed microwave interferometric readout model, incorporating measured electronics noise and active suppression of pump amplitude noise, is used to project the sensitivity of the proposed experiment. For an acquisition time of three months, the haloscope is projected to reach gₐγγ<10⁻¹¹,GeV⁻¹ across more than four orders of magnitude in axion mass. The projected sensitivity extends approximately one order of magnitude below the current exclusion limits set by CAST, providing a practical pathway towards a high-sensitivity direct search for ultralight dark matter axions.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种基于螺旋腔谐振器的超导单模微波 haloscope，用于探测质量范围约 10⁻¹⁸ 至 10⁻¹³ eV 的超轻暗物质轴子。该设计在已有单模螺旋腔概念基础上，引入逆向设计框架，优化出与超导铌加工兼容的实际谐振器几何，并以固定灵敏度所需测量时间为目标构造品质因子。相较启发式 Möbius 几何基准，最佳可减材加工块体铌设计的指标提升超过三个数量级；结合含实测电子学噪声和泵浦幅度噪声主动抑制的干涉读出模型，三个月采集时间内预计可在四个数量级以上轴子质量范围达到 gₐγγ<10⁻¹¹ GeV⁻¹。
authors: Robert Crew, Emma Paterson, Maxim Goryachev, Eugene Ivanov, Pashupati Dhakal, Tugrul Talha Ersoz, Michael Tobar, Jeremy Bourhill

articles.title: Which pulse maximizes resonant nonlinear conversion?
articles.title_zh: 哪种脉冲能最大化共振非线性转换？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: At fixed pulse energy, which drive waveform extracts the most nth-order nonlinear conversion from a resonator (n=2 for second harmonic)? A short pulse couples poorly to a narrow resonance, a long one dilutes its energy, and no linear rule fixes the compromise. We solve the problem exactly for a single mode of amplitude decay rate κ. Eliminating the drive turns fixed incident energy into a constraint on the stored field alone, and the optimization becomes a sharp Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequality whose extremal is the ground-state soliton of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. The optimal stored field is sech¹/⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾[(n-1)κ t], sustained by an asymmetric input that rises as eκ t and falls as e⁻⁽²ⁿ⁻¹⁾κ t; the largest converted energy follows in closed form. A rising exponential, the time-reversal recipe, retains at most 79.0% of the bound at n=2 and 2/e at large n; a two-rate pulse retains above 97%. Critical coupling generalizes to n-fold overcoupling, with optimal input coupling n times the intrinsic loss rate. The bound applies from microrings to superconducting circuits and caps the per-pulse brightness of broadband photon-pair sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文求解了固定入射脉冲能量下，单模谐振器中 n 阶非线性转换效率最大化的精确波形问题。作者将驱动消去后，把约束转化为储能场约束，并将优化问题映射为尖锐的 Gagliardo-Nirenberg 不等式，其极值解为非线性 Schrödinger 方程基态孤子。最优储能场为 sech 型，需由上升和下降速率不对称的输入脉冲维持；结果给出最大转换能的闭式表达，并指出传统时间反演的上升指数脉冲并非最优，而临界耦合推广为输入耦合等于内禀损耗的 n 倍。

articles.title: Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Subsystem Density Functional Theory
articles.title_zh: 核-电子轨道子系统密度泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a new computational approach based on Nuclear-Electronic Orbital and Subsystem Density Functional Theory. The resulting NEO-sDFT methodology enables quantum chemical calculations of large molecular systems composed of thousands of atoms while also describing selected protons quantum mechanically. A key feature of the associated program implementation is its flexibility in assigning quantum protons to subsystems, allowing different embedding schemes to be employed within a unified framework. The accuracy of NEO-sDFT is assessed by computing water dimer interaction energies, which exhibit errors of only a few meV compared to reference Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Density Functional Theory results. The favorable computational scaling of NEO-sDFT is further showcased through calculations on water clusters of increasing size, with up to 303 protons being treated quantum mechanically. Our results demonstrate that NEO-sDFT is an accurate and efficient approach for incorporating nuclear quantum effects into large-scale simulations, providing a foundation for future applications to proton transfer processes in biochemical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出结合核-电子轨道理论与子系统密度泛函理论的新计算框架 NEO-sDFT，用于在含数千原子的大分子体系中对选定质子进行量子力学描述。其程序实现允许灵活地将量子质子分配到不同子系统，从而在统一框架下采用多种嵌入方案。通过水二聚体相互作用能测试，NEO-sDFT 相对参考 NEO-DFT 的误差仅为数 meV，并在不同尺寸水团簇、最多 303 个量子质子的计算中展示了良好的计算标度，为大尺度模拟中的核量子效应和生化质子转移研究提供了基础。

articles.title: Mutually phase-stable tunable attosecond soft X-ray attosecond pulses from a free-electron laser
articles.title_zh: 自由电子激光产生相互相位稳定且可调的阿秒软 X 射线脉冲对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the production of mutually phase-stable attosecond X-ray pulse pairs with tunable relative time delays and phases in a cascaded X-ray free-electron laser. We showcase the method in an experiment at the LCLS-II, in which a shaped electron beam is used in a split undulator configuration to generate the two attosecond pulses. We achieve mutual phase stability by reusing microbunching generated in the first undulator in order to seed the FEL process in the second at a detuned frequency. We measure controllable temporal delays between the two pulses directly in the time domain using angular streaking of photoelectrons, with a step size of 250 attoseconds. We then show that the behavior of the X-ray spectrum is consistent with phase stability between the two pulses, with a relative phase that can be easily tuned using inter-undulator phase shifters. This method is particularly well-suited to few to ten eV energy separations and sub to few femtosecond time delays, which are ideal for experiments in the soft X-ray regime for pushing the limits of our models for molecular dynamics and exerting direct coherent control over quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在 LCLS-II 级联 X 射线自由电子激光中演示了相互相位稳定的阿秒 X 射线脉冲对，其相对延迟和相位均可调。方法利用整形电子束和分段波荡器，并将第一段产生的微聚束复用于第二段失谐频率的 FEL 种子过程，从而实现相位稳定。实验通过光电子角条纹在时域直接测量了可控延迟，步进为 250 阿秒，并用光谱行为验证了脉冲间相位稳定性；该方案适合软 X 射线中数 eV 到十 eV 能量间隔、亚飞秒到数飞秒延迟的相干动力学实验。
authors: River Robles, David Cesar, Taran Driver, Paris Franz, Veronica Guo, Gabriel Just, Kirk A. Larsen, Randy Lemons, Ming-Fu Lin, Razib Obaid, Nicholas Sudar, Jun Wang, Zhen Zhang, James Cryan, Agostino Marinelli

articles.title: Mid-infrared distributed-feedback lasing from black phosphorus under nanosecond excitation
articles.title_zh: 纳秒激发下黑磷的中红外分布反馈激光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mid-infrared (MIR) light sources compatible with silicon photonics are highly desirable for environmental sensing and free-space optical communications. Conventional GaSb-based quantum-well and interband-cascade lasers, however, rely on complex epitaxial heterostructures, complicating their integration with silicon photonic platforms. Here, we demonstrate a room-temperature MIR surface-emitting distributed-feedback (DFB) laser using black phosphorus (b-P) as the active gain medium. By deterministically integrating exfoliated b-P flakes onto lithographically patterned SiO₂ gratings, we obtain narrowband emission with a full width at half maximum below 3 nm under 1064 nm optical excitation. The lasing wavelength is tunable from 3.79 to 4.05~μm through the b-P flake thickness, covering a technologically important region of the mid-infrared. Room-temperature thresholds as low as (0.25 ± 0.07) mJ/cm² are achieved under nanosecond excitation. Upon cooling to 110 K, the threshold decreases tenfold to (0.015 ± 0.005) mJ/cm². These results establish planar b-P DFB cavities as a promising platform for heterogeneously integrated MIR lasers based on van der Waals semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了以黑磷为增益介质的室温中红外表面发射分布反馈激光器，面向与硅光子学兼容的中红外光源。作者将剥离黑磷片确定性集成到光刻制备的 SiO₂ 光栅上，在 1064 nm 光激发下获得半高宽低于 3 nm 的窄带发射。通过调节黑磷厚度，激射波长可在 3.79–4.05 μm 范围内调谐；室温纳秒激发阈值低至约 0.25 mJ/cm²，降温至 110 K 后进一步降低一个数量级。
authors: Julien Brodeur, Laure Sène, Stéphane Kéna-Cohen

articles.title: Geometric Control of Cat States in High Harmonic Generation
articles.title_zh: 高次谐波产生中薛定谔猫态的几何控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20119v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-harmonic generation (HHG) provides a powerful platform for exploring the interaction between intense laser fields and matter on ultrafast timescales. Beyond its conventional description in terms of emitted radiation and electron dynamics, a fully quantum treatment of HHG reveals that the nonlinear light-matter interaction can modify the quantum state of the driving field itself, establishing correlations between the fundamental and harmonic modes. This perspective opens new possibilities for using HHG as a tool to engineer and control nonclassical states of light. In this work, we investigate the geometric properties of optical Schroedinger cat states generated in HHG via conditioning and post-selection. By analyzing the coherent-state displacements induced by different structured driving fields, we characterize the resulting phase-space evolution and the associated geometric phases of the generated quantum states. Particular emphasis is placed on how the polarization and spatial-mode structure of the driving light influence the geometry and evolution of displaced coherent states. Our results demonstrate that structured light offers a versatile means of controlling the geometric dynamics of HHG-generated cat states across the parameter space. Furthermore, we discuss the prospects for realizing genuinely topological optical cat states by exploiting more complex structured light configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从全量子高次谐波产生视角出发，考察强非线性光—物质相互作用如何通过条件测量和后选择生成并调控光学薛定谔猫态。作者分析不同结构化驱动光场诱导的相干态位移、相空间演化及相关几何相，重点讨论偏振和空间模式结构对量子态几何性质的影响。结果表明，结构化光场为在 HHG 平台上工程化非经典光态及其几何相提供了可调控制手段。
authors: Arti Gaharwar, Rocío Borrego-Varillas, Marcelo F. Ciappina, Anna G. Ciriolo, Javier Rivera-Dean, Philipp Stammer, Paraskevas Tzallas, Emilio Pisanty, Maciej Lewenstein

articles.title: Symmetry-guided modal control in elliptical femtosecond-laser-written photonic waveguides
articles.title_zh: 椭圆形飞秒激光直写光波导中的对称性引导模态控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Few-mode photonic circuits can increase functionality without multiplying waveguide paths, but bends and fabrication errors can mix their transverse modes. We investigate a strategy in which waveguide confinement and perturbation parity are engineered together in vertically elliptical, femtosecond-laser-written glass waveguides. The intended modal basis comprises the even 1S mode and the vertically odd 2P_y mode. No window-converged 2Pₓ state is resolved for a lower-confinement (LC) design, whereas a higher-confinement (HC) design guides 2Pₓ, which must therefore be isolated by symmetry. In scalar beam-propagation calculations, the 1S-2P_y propagation-constant splitting predicts the optimized periods of a vertically modulated coherent modal splitter to within 1.0%. Horizontal S-bends remain parity-mismatched for 1S łeftrightarrow 2P_y coupling, while the symmetry-allowed HC 1S i̊ghtarrow 2Pₓ transfer reaches only 0.6% at the largest displacement. At a displacement of 150~μm, the HC design retains approximately the same 2P_y power as the LC design retains at 40~μm. Thermal and stochastic writing-error calculations reveal the resulting trade-off: stronger confinement improves modal-power retention, but writing jitter that breaks x-parity can populate the guided 2Pₓ mode. These results demonstrate how modal-basis engineering can shift part of the crosstalk-control burden from the trajectory to waveguide symmetry, supporting joint path--mode degrees of freedom in quantum photonic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究通过同时设计波导约束和扰动宇称，在垂直椭圆形飞秒激光直写玻璃波导中实现少模光子线路的模态选择与串扰抑制。目标模态为偶宇称 1S 模和垂直奇宇称 2P_y 模；低约束设计不支持窗口收敛的 2Pₓ 态，而高约束设计可导引 2Pₓ，因此需要借助对称性隔离。标量光束传播计算显示，1S–2P_y 传播常数劈裂可在 1% 以内预测相干模态分束器的优化周期；水平 S 弯对 1S↔2P_y 保持宇称失配，而高约束下允许的 1S→2Pₓ 转移即使在最大位移下也仅约 0.6%。
authors: Tadas Paulauskas, Ubaid Ur Rehman, Eimantas Dermauskas, Valdemar Stankevic

articles.title: Observables and Anti-Hermitian Generators in Time-Dependent Unitary Coupled Cluster Theory
articles.title_zh: 含时幺正耦合簇理论中的可观测量与反厄米生成元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a time-dependent (TD) unitary coupled-cluster (UCC) formulation for electronic quantum dynamics, including the propagation of excited states and their superpositions, in both single- and multi-reference regimes. Standard TD coupled-cluster techniques offer size-extensivity, but they rely on non-Hermitian bivariational action functionals that break time-reversibility, giving transition matrix elements and amplitude estimators that are asymmetric (though accurate and systematically improvable). Here we use the time-evolution operator as an exponential map driven by TD anti-Hermitian cluster operators and first-order generators. Applying the Dirac-Frenkel action principle, we extract equations of motion governed by Heisenberg-picture-like commutators. This approach connects to our previous non-Hermitian formulations, where observables are expressed in terms of regular and extended cluster operators. From that connection we obtain a generator cluster operator whose unperturbed TD limit leads to the UCC eigenvalue problem. Even though this problem can be exact, the time dependence of the generator holds only at short propagation times, so we use the generator to prepare the initial state and then propagate that state with the formal TD UCC equation of motion. The theory is tested on an extended hard-core Bose-Hubbard ring with connections to neutral atom chains, and we discuss the theory's present limitations and possible extensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于电子量子动力学的含时幺正耦合簇形式，可处理激发态及其叠加态传播，并覆盖单参考和多参考情形。与传统非厄米双变分含时耦合簇方法不同，该方法将时间演化算符写为由含时反厄米簇算符和一阶生成元驱动的指数映射，并由 Dirac–Frenkel 作用量原理导出类似海森堡绘景对易子的运动方程。作者还将该框架与既有非厄米表述中的可观测量公式联系起来，得到生成元簇算符及其未扰动极限下的 UCC 本征值问题。

articles.title: Vibrational Activation Triggers Ultrafast Excited State Intramolecular Proton Transfer in Single-Benzene Fluorophores
articles.title_zh: 振动激活触发单苯荧光团中的超快激发态分子内质子转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-benzene fluorophores (SBFs) are exceptionally light-weight quantum emitters which have recently been shown to display Excited State Intramolecular Proton Transfer (ESIPT) and highly tunable dual-fluorescence that could be exploited for multiple applications. Here, we employ excited-state molecular dynamics to investigate the ultrafast dynamics of ESIPT in two different SBFs, one of which with a new structure proposed in this work. We find that both single and double ultrafast proton transfers can be triggered by exciting specific molecular vibrations. Strikingly, the kinetic activation of these vibrations - selected by atomistic, symmetry-based analysis - can considerably enhance the yield of proton transfer(s), as well as direct the reaction towards either single or double-transfer products. In-depth analysis elucidates the origins of this vibronic control, providing atomistic guidelines through which both the rate and fate of ESIPT could be steered using ultrafast IR-Vis spectroscopies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用激发态分子动力学考察两种单苯荧光团中的超快激发态分子内质子转移，其中一种结构为本文新提出。结果表明，选择性激发特定分子振动可触发单质子或双质子超快转移，并显著提高转移产率。通过基于原子尺度和对称性的振动选择与动力学分析，作者阐明了振电耦合控制的来源，并提出可利用超快红外-可见光谱调控 ESIPT 速率和产物通道的分子设计准则。
authors: Brieuc Le Dé, Simon Huppert, Riccardo Spezia, Alex W. Chin

articles.title: Computational Methods of Wave Propagation for Semiclassical Models of High Harmonic Generation in Bulk Solids
articles.title_zh: 块体固体高次谐波半经典模型中的波传播计算方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical framework for self consistent treatment of nonlinear light-matter interactions in the ultra-fast strong-field regime based on numerical solution of Maxwell's equations and semiconductor Bloch equations. This framework is shown to describe high-order harmonic generation and propagation in bulk semiconductors, investigating differences in reflected and transmitted harmonic spectra due to propagation effects. We show that the propagation of the combined field of the driving laser pulse and generated harmonics in a bulk semiconductor significantly modifies the harmonic spectra, affecting interpretation of experimental results relating the transmitted harmonic spectra to the underlying electronic structure of the material. This model allows the self-consistent description of strong-field light-matter interactions in the non-perturbative regime, opening the way to explore the transition between fully classical and quantum regimes of interaction, tunneling and multiphoton regimes of material ionization, and perturbative and non-perturbative regimes of harmonic generation in bulk materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个自洽描述超快强场非线性光—物质相互作用的理论框架，通过数值求解麦克斯韦方程与半导体布洛赫方程来处理块体半导体中的高次谐波产生与传播。研究表明，驱动激光脉冲与所产生谐波的联合场在材料内部传播会显著改变反射和透射谐波谱，从而影响由透射谱反推材料电子结构的实验解释。该模型可用于探索强场非微扰区间中经典—量子相互作用过渡、隧穿与多光子电离以及微扰—非微扰谐波产生机制。
authors: Ava N. Hejazi, Nicholas Karpowicz, Gregory D. Scholes, Julia M. Mikhailova

articles.title: An Irreducible Quantum Advantage in Aligning World Models with Reality
articles.title_zh: 使世界模型与现实对齐中的不可约量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: World models provide digital simulacra of the true world, allowing agents to be trained and tested before costly real-world deployment. At each time step, they receive an action and generate an observation and reward matching the statistics of the true world. In complex environments where present outcomes depend on events far in the past, this requires memory. One might expect that, by increasing memory, we can always build a model accurately enough to align the optimal agent policies of the real and virtual worlds. We show that this is false for classical world models, even when the true world itself is classical. We construct true worlds for which every finite classical model fails along the same possible trajectory: it either loses the ability to distinguish actions when the true world clearly prefers one, or repeatedly assigns the highest expected reward to suboptimal actions. Its expected-reward estimates also retain a nonvanishing average error. In contrast, each such true world admits a quantum world model using a single qutrit that reproduces it exactly: its reward estimates and preferred actions always match those of the true world, ensuring that the optimal policies of the real and virtual worlds remain perfectly aligned.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究强化学习式世界模型在具有长程历史依赖环境中对真实世界奖励估计和最优策略偏好的复现能力。作者构造了一类即使真实世界本身是经典的情形，其中任意有限经典世界模型都会在某些轨迹上失效：要么无法区分动作偏好，要么反复高估次优动作，并保持非零平均奖励估计误差。相比之下，相应真实世界可由一个单 qutrit 量子世界模型精确复现，显示出在模型记忆与现实对齐任务中的不可约量子优势。
authors: Josep Lumbreras, Hailan Ma, Jayne Thompson, Mile Gu

articles.title: Curvature-Information Duality Driven Geometrically Optimal Compression of Deep Models
articles.title_zh: 由曲率—信息对偶驱动的深度模型几何最优压缩
articles.abstract: One of the main challenges of edge artificial intelligence is keeping the model accuracy in the face of extreme resources limitations. The current model compression techniques are based primarily on heuristic techniques, which do not have theoretical support based on first principles. In this work, we introduce the Curvature-aware Information Bottleneck (CurvIB) model as a unified model compression technique based on the first principles of information geometry. Our central theoretical result is the curvature-information duality theorem: when measured against the Fisher-Rao metric, the local curvature of the loss surface follows an increasing trend with the information density of the area. This duality leads to the CurvIB framework as a combination of three important compression steps: (1) curvature-sensitive adaptive pruning, in which compression ratios are allocated automatically depending on the information densities of different layers; (2) Wasserstein-aware optimum quantization (Lloyd-Max iterative algorithm), in which quantization precision is distributed non-uniformly based on the underlying distribution geometry; and (3) optimal transport-controlled accuracy recovery, in which pre-compression feature distribution geometry is matched by post-compression geometry. Experiments on VGG-16/CIFAR-10 and ResNet-18/CIFAR-100 fully confirm our central hypotheses: (1) curvature-sensitive pruning is much more effective compared to weight-based pruning and random pruning (3.97% accuracy improvement at 30% pruning ratio); (2) Lloyd-Max optimal quantization has significantly smaller MSE at all bit rates and 6-bit quantization accuracy can be higher than full-precision baseline (quantization noise regularization effect); (3) optimal transport accuracy recovery is far better than conventional knowledge distillation (+3.09) and confirms the benefit of feature geometric alignment. We also observe that the classical quantile-based Wasserstein quantization approximation deteriorates catastrophically at large bit rates, whereas the genuine Wasserstein optimal quantization needs to be solved iteratively through the Lloyd-Max algorithm. CurvIB framework offers a unified geometric view to deep model compression and has very wide application opportunities in edge AI systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出曲率感知信息瓶颈 CurvIB 框架，试图从信息几何第一性原理统一解释和设计边缘人工智能中的模型压缩。核心理论主张为曲率—信息对偶：在 Fisher–Rao 度量下，损失曲面的局部曲率随区域信息密度增加而增强。基于该对偶，作者提出三步压缩流程：按层信息密度自适应剪枝、考虑 Wasserstein 几何的非均匀最优量化，以及由最优传输约束的精度恢复。

articles.title: Self-Correcting Toric-Code Memory in a Globally Controlled Rydberg Array
articles.title_zh: 全局控制里德堡阵列中的自校正环面码量子存储器
articles.abstract: The central prerequisite of any fault-tolerant quantum architecture is a quantum memory: a block of encoded physical qubits whose logical state is actively preserved against noise across many rounds of error correction. In neutral-atom Rydberg arrays, realizing such a memory is obstructed not by the entangling gates themselves, which are already fast and high-fidelity, but by the auxiliary operations that a conventional error-correction cycle requires — mid-circuit fluorescence measurement, inter-zone atom transport, and locally focused single-qubit addressing. Each of these introduces latency, atom loss, or optical crosstalk that exceeds the cost of the underlying gates by orders of magnitude. These costs accumulate cycle after cycle, progressively degrading the very logical information the code is meant to protect. Here we propose a protocol that stabilizes a toric-code quantum memory without moving, measuring or local addressing atoms. The key is to use a three-species Rydberg atom array for the complete stabilizer cycle, including syndrome extraction, coherent correction, and ancilla reset, under global, species-selective laser pulses. Numerical simulation of a 4!×!4 rotated toric code shows a longer qubit lifetime when the physical error rate is below a pseudo-threshold p^star!approx!0.034. The scheme offers a concrete, hardware-efficient route to topological quantum memory in neutral-atom platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种在中性原子里德堡阵列中稳定环面码量子存储器的方案，目标是避免传统纠错循环中代价高昂的中途测量、原子搬运和局域单量子比特寻址。方案使用三物种里德堡原子阵列，并通过全局、物种选择性激光脉冲完成稳定子循环，包括综合征提取、相干纠错和辅助比特复位。作者报告了针对小尺寸旋转环面码的数值模拟，主张该全局控制架构可降低由测量延迟、原子损失和光学串扰引入的累积误差；具体性能细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Theoretical analysis of forces generated by mitotic spindle
articles.title_zh: 有丝分裂纺锤体产生力的理论分析
articles.abstract: The mitotic spindle acts as the generator of force that drives mitosis. In prometaphase and metaphase the force is required to align kinetochore/chromosome pairs in the bio-orientated configuration while in anaphase the force is required to drive the separation of kinetochore/chromosome pairs. The forces have been measured experimentally in prometaphase or metaphase of many organisms. For example, in grasshopper spermatocytes, the force on each microtubule (kMT) attached to kinetochores in prometaphase was determined to be about 7 pN. By contrast, in anaphase of grasshopper spermatocytes the force required to halt the motion of a kinetochore/chromosome was determined to be about 700 pN, equivalent to a force of about 50 pN per kMT. A puzzling issue is why in grasshopper spermatocytes the force to stall the kinetochore/chromosome (700 pN) exceeds significantly the normal anaphase force (0.1 ~ 0.7 pN) and why the force of 50 pN per kMT in anaphase is also much larger than 7 pN in prometaphase. Here, based on our proposed model for the spindle in metaphase and anaphase, we study theoretically the forces generated by the spindle, explaining the puzzling issue. Moreover, prediction is provided that the total force to stall all kinetochores in anaphase of grasshopper spermatocytes is about 4-fold larger than the force to stall the single kinetochore or the force on each kinetochore to stall all kinetochores is only about 17% fraction of the force to stall the single kinetochore.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本围绕有丝分裂纺锤体在前中期、中期和后期产生的力进行理论分析，关注动粒/染色体对齐与分离过程中测得力值差异的物理机制。作者特别讨论蝗虫精母细胞中前中期每根动粒微管约 7 pN、后期阻停动粒/染色体所需总力约 700 pN 以及折合每根动粒微管约 50 pN 等实验现象之间的表观矛盾。基于其提出的中期和后期纺锤体模型，论文试图解释为何阻停力显著大于正常后期运动力，并给出可检验预测；具体推导和预测需查阅原文。

articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过微重力实验考察交替磁场驱动顺磁胶体体系的自组装行为。结果显示，时间调制磁场可使体系越过动力学阻滞，形成动态且高度各向异性的相；这些结构依赖持续能量耗散维持，体现了非平衡软物质自组装机制。

articles.title: Consistency of Dirac Hamiltonians and boundary conditions in finite graphene nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 有限石墨烯纳米带中狄拉克哈密顿量与边界条件的一致性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Víctor Barrera-Figueroa, Manuel Gadella, Şengül Kuru, Javier Negro, and Yunia Verónica García-Tejeda The electronic structure of graphene nanoribbons is determined by boundary conditions at their edges. Here, the authors establish a consistent continuum framework showing that zigzag and armchair boundary conditions must be imposed simultaneously in finite geometries. Tight-binding validation demonstrates that the continuum model reproduces the spectrum with machine-precision accuracy, establishing precise criteria for correctly applying Dirac Hamiltonians to realistic graphene nanostructures. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 115413] Published Fri Aug 21, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究有限石墨烯纳米带中连续狄拉克模型与边界条件的自洽适用性。作者建立了统一框架，指出在有限几何中锯齿型与扶手椅型边界条件需要同时施加，并用紧束缚计算验证该连续模型可高精度再现实谱。研究为真实石墨烯纳米结构中正确使用狄拉克哈密顿量给出了明确判据。
authors: Víctor Barrera-Figueroa, Manuel Gadella, Şengül Kuru, Javier Negro, and Yunia Verónica García-Tejeda

articles.title: High-resolution analysis of the S 1 –S 0 transition of magnesium phthalocyanine: Rotational structure and electronic angular momentum
articles.title_zh: 镁酞菁 S1–S0 跃迁的高分辨光谱分析：转动结构与电子角动量
articles.abstract: We report a high-resolution spectroscopic analysis of the S 1 –S 0 transition of magnesium phthalocyanine (MgPc), obtained by probing buffer-gas-cooled molecules with a narrow-linewidth laser. The observed spectrum exhibits a characteristic three-peak pattern, which is well reproduced by modeling MgPc as an oblate symmetric top with D 4h symmetry. A key result of this work is that the spectrum is strongly influenced by electronic Coriolis coupling, which is associated with electronic angular momentum. The electronic Coriolis constant is determined to be ∼2, indicating an effective orbital angular momentum of about 2 in the excited S 1 state, originating from the π-conjugated ring excitation. This provides a direct spectroscopic signature of electronic angular momentum in a large polyatomic molecule. The presence of nonzero electronic orbital angular momentum is qualitatively consistent with the perimeter model of phthalocyanines. The value lies within the range inferred from previous magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) studies. Compared with the previous MCD estimate, the present analysis provides a more state-specific and narrower constraint, demonstrating that high-resolution spectroscopy enables direct access to electronic and magnetic properties beyond conventional structural characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用窄线宽激光探测缓冲气体冷却的镁酞菁分子，对其 S1–S0 跃迁进行了高分辨光谱研究。实验谱线呈现出特征性的三峰结构，并可用具有 D4h 对称性的扁平对称陀螺模型很好描述。结果表明，谱线强烈受电子科里奥利耦合影响，说明激发态 S1 中存在显著的有效轨道角动量，这是大分子中电子角动量的直接谱学证据。

articles.title: Formation mechanism and optical/magnetic properties of high-entropy (FeCuMn)(WMo)O₄₋ₓSₓ nanosheets synthesized via hydrothermal method

articles.abstract: Breaking the NIR-II bottleneck, conventional inorganic semiconductors have long suffered from inadequate optical absorption, limiting their phototherapeutic efficacy. Here, we report a paradigm-shifting breakthrough: the first-ever hydrothermal synthesis of high-entropy (FeCuMn)(WMo)O₄₋ₓSₓ nanosheets. By overcoming the fundamental immiscibility of five transition metals, our monoclinic nanosheets unlock an unprecedented broadband absorption spanning 400–1400 nm, achieving record-high photothermal conversion in both the NIR-I and NIR-II biological windows (ΔT = 38°C at 808 nm). Remarkably, this high-entropy configuration simultaneously endows the material with strong T₁/T₂ magnetic relaxivity, enabling novel dual-modal MR imaging capability. This first demonstration of integrating photothermal and magnetic functionalities via hydrothermal high-entropy engineering opens a new avenue for theranostic nanoplatforms.

articles.title: Universal pattern revealed in quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 量子物质中揭示的普适模式
articles.abstract: When different materials transition from one phase to another, such as water coming to a boil or a magnet losing its ability to attract metals, something remarkable can happen: They begin to behave identically, following the same mathematical rules. "Physicists call this trait universality—the messy, microscopic details wash out and only a few essential features survive," explains Jason Alicea, William K. Davis Professor of Theoretical Physics. The math underlying these universal traits is commonly described by a theoretical framework called conformal field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同材料在相变过程中会表现出相同的行为规律，例如水沸腾或磁体失去磁性时，微观细节会被“洗掉”，只剩少数关键特征。本文介绍了物理学中的“普适性”概念：复杂系统在临界附近遵循相同的数学规则。其背后的理论框架通常用共形场论来描述。

articles.title: Connecting the power of the stars to geometry
articles.title_zh: 将恒星能量与几何学联系起来
articles.abstract: In the world of fusion energy, scientists and engineers study the fourth state of matter known as plasma in an effort to design and build a new type of power plant. Relying on the heat produced by two small atoms smashing together, a network of such facilities would help create a novel source of stable electricity and help ensure America's energy independence. And while scientists in this endeavor are devoting their attention to complex machinery and temperatures hotter than the surface of the sun, they are also trying to determine the best designs for such a power plant by focusing on geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚变能源研究关注等离子体这一第四态物质，目标是利用轻原子碰撞释放的热量实现稳定发电。除了复杂装置与极端温度，研究者也在从几何设计角度优化聚变电站布局。该文强调了几何形状在提升装置性能与工程可行性中的作用。

articles.title: WTFFN-YOLO: An Improved Lightweight Method for Surface Defect Detection on Wind Turbine Blades
articles.title_zh: WTFFN-YOLO：用于风力涡轮机叶片表面缺陷检测的轻量化改进方法
articles.abstract: As critical components of wind turbines, blade surfaces may develop defects such as cracks and wear, which significantly affect operational stability and service life.Therefore, accurate and efficient defect detection is essential for the maintenance and safe operation of wind turbines.This paper proposes a blade surface defect detection method based on the WTFFN-YOLO framework.First,the C3K2 module is replaced with the C3K2-SACA attention mechanism.Second,the traditional upsampling layer is replaced with a frequency-aware feature fusion module (FreqFusion).Finally,we designed the neck network introduces the WTFFN module to replace the conventional concatenation layer.This design enables more effective multi-scale feature integration,achieving accurate detection while reducing model parameters and computational cost,thereby improving both efficiency and feature representation capability.Experimental results show that the improved model achieves 6.9% increase in mean average precision (mAP), In small-object mAP improvement 8.2%,and 8% reduction in model parameters, satisfying both accuracy and lightweight design requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对风机叶片表面裂纹、磨损等缺陷对运行安全与寿命的影响，本文提出一种基于WTFFN-YOLO的缺陷检测方法。该方法用C3K2-SACA注意力模块替换原C3K2模块，用频率感知特征融合模块FreqFusion替代传统上采样，并在颈部网络中引入WTFFN模块以增强多尺度特征融合。实验表明，该模型在保持轻量化的同时提升了检测精度，mAP提高6.9%，小目标mAP提高8.2%，参数量减少8%。

articles.title: Production-network embedding and embodied carbon–energy footprints in semiconductor supply chains: An MRIO scenario analysis of Taiwan, Japan, and the United States
articles.title_zh: 半导体供应链中的生产网络嵌入与隐含碳—能足迹：基于台湾、日本和美国的MRIO情景分析
articles.abstract: Resilience-oriented reconfiguration of strategic supply chains may create environmental co-benefits or trade-offs, yet its embodied carbon and energy consequences remain poorly understood. Using the Eora Full multi-region input–output (MRIO) database, we compare Taiwan’s Semiconductors sector with observed semiconductor-related production structures in Japan and the United States. These comparisons are scenario-based footprint envelopes, not relocation forecasts or identical-fab efficiency estimates. Relative to Taiwan’s baseline, EDGAR CO₂ multipliers are 88.9% lower for the descriptive midpoint of the two Japanese sector scenarios and 93.6% lower for the US sector scenario; Eora I-ENERGY multipliers, interpreted only as 2022 cross-sector diagnostics, are 96.4% and 97.4% lower. Under cumulative B1b, which retains Taiwan’s upstream input structure while substituting the host target-sector direct intensity and reassigning only the direct electricity input, CO₂ reductions are 20.4% for the Japan midpoint and 22.9% for the United States. Upstream decomposition links Taiwan’s high multiplier to identifiable domestic electricity and heavy-industry sectors, while strict residual-account shares remain below 0.5% in all CO₂ decompositions. The results suggest that the environmental implications of semiconductor reconfiguration are associated mainly with upstream production-network embedding rather than siting or cleaner host electricity alone. The analysis covers embodied CO₂ and energy requirements, not material, water, social, or economic sustainability outcomes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Eora多区域投入产出数据库，对台湾半导体部门与日本、美国的观察到的半导体生产结构进行情景比较，评估供应链重构对隐含碳与能源足迹的影响。结果显示，不同情景下的足迹水平存在显著差异，台湾的较高乘数可追溯到国内电力与重工业等上游部门。作者强调这些比较是情景边界分析，不是迁移预测或等效工厂效率估计。

articles.title: Latent debt in PINNs with SIR Models: Dynamical Compensation and Topological Bottlenecks
articles.title_zh: PINN与SIR模型中的隐性债务：动力补偿与拓扑瓶颈
articles.abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for parameter inference in nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with increasing relevance in data-scarce domains such as digital health, where reliable inference under limited observations is critical for decision-making. However, their behaviour in early dynamical regimes, characterised by sparse information and near-linear system dynamics, remains insufficiently understood, particularly regarding loss landscape geometry and error propagation. By analyzing the Normalized Hessian within a subdetermined SIR model, we show that parameter inference becomes fundamentally ill-conditioned during the exponential growth phase, where the loss landscape exhibits a locally flat, rank-deficient structure. In this regime, optimization algorithms can minimize residual losses while converging to incorrect parameter values, compensating through systematic distortions in unobserved latent state variables. Temporal domain decomposition further introduces failure mechanisms whereby small initial-condition errors propagate across windows. As a result, the model may produce solutions that are numerically accurate yet associated with incorrect parameter estimates, reflecting a trade-off between insufficient curvature in short windows and the embedding of early-phase artefacts in longer horizons. These findings reveal that the limitations of PINNs arise from deeper topological pathologies in the optimization landscape and underscore the need to move beyond standard residual minimization toward structurally informed regularization strategies, providing a principled foundation for more robust and biologically consistent scientific machine learning models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究物理信息神经网络（PINN）在SIR传染病模型参数反演中的早期动力学行为。结果表明，在指数增长阶段，由于损失景观局部平坦且秩亏，参数识别会变得根本上病态，优化过程可能在残差变小的同时收敛到错误参数，并通过未观测隐变量的系统性偏差进行补偿。时间域分解还会放大初值误差传播，导致数值上看似正确但物理上失真的解。

articles.title: Deep Learning-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization of Surface Finish and Tool Wear in CNC Dry Turning
articles.title_zh: 基于深度学习的CNC干式车削表面质量与刀具磨损多目标优化
articles.abstract: Achieving fine surface finish without sacrificing tool life is the defining trade-off of computer numerical control (CNC) turning, yet parameter selection on production-grade lathes still relies largely on conservative handbook values. This paper develops a fully data-driven, deep-learning-enabled multi-objective optimization framework for dry turning of medium-carbon steel and validates it experimentally on a production CNC lathe. A three-factor, three-level full factorial experiment spanning the practical operating envelope of spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut provides the training dataset. Analysis of variance establishes that surface roughness and tool wear are governed by different, partly conflicting subsets of the cutting parameters, confirming a genuine two-objective conflict. Deep neural network regression surrogates are trained for both responses and benchmarked against classical power-law models under leave-one-out cross-validation; the superior surrogates are then embedded in the reference-point-based evolutionary algorithm NSGA-III to trace the Pareto front, and TOPSIS ranking with knee-point identification and weight-sensitivity analysis converts the front into operatorready recommendations in which feed rate and depth of cut collapse to single robust values, leaving spindle speed as the sole trade-off dial. Quantitatively, the deep networks reduce the cross-validated mean absolute percentage error of the roughness model from 9.79% to 7.65% and of the wear model from 6.68% to 1.01%; the predicted Pareto front extends 28% deeper into the fine-finish region than the power-law front, exposing an experimentally observed optimum that the parametric model overestimates by 40% and would therefore misprice; and the knee-point compromise recommendation is complemented by a TOPSIS ranking that is robust for all roughness weightings up to 55%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向中碳钢干式车削，构建了一个数据驱动的深度学习多目标优化框架，用于同时改善表面粗糙度与刀具磨损。作者通过三因素三水平全因子试验获取训练数据，并用神经网络回归代理模型替代传统幂律模型，再结合NSGA-III搜索Pareto前沿。结果表明，表面粗糙度与刀具磨损受不同且部分冲突的工艺参数控制，说明该问题具有真实的双目标权衡。

articles.title: Cascading Congestion Collapse and Proactive Admission Control in Quantum Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中的级联拥塞崩塌与主动准入控制
articles.abstract: Quantum repeater networks distribute entanglement using quantum memories with finite coherence time. Under load, a hop whose entangled pair must wait for sibling hops can decohere and time out, forcing regeneration at the very node that is already congested — a feedback loop we show produces a genuine cascading congestion collapse: a phase transition from stable operation to network-wide congestion above a critical arrival rate λc. We formalize this as a fold bifurcation in a mean-field loss-network model, derive an explicit stability criterion, and validate our core fidelity and decoherence formulas to floating-point precision against SeQUeNCe, an independent quantum network simulator. This decoherence-timeout-driven cascade mechanism has not, to our knowledge, been previously characterized. We propose DALSAC, a proactive admission-control policy that estimates per-node cascade risk from occupancy, trend, and timeout signals and sheds load before it can propagate. Across four topologies, three baselines, a four-parameter sensitivity analysis, and a scale-up to 100-node networks, DALSAC delays or avoids collapse, delivers 23–152% higher throughput and 19–125% higher success rate than baselines at high demand (significant in eleven of twelve comparisons), recovers about twice as fast from a transient demand shock, and does so without sacrificing fidelity — its advantage growing, not shrinking, with network scale. We further show that structural robustness to targeted attack depends on background congestion load, a dependency invisible to evaluations that test attacks on idle networks. All code, data, and figures are reproducible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，在量子中继网络中，由于量子存储器相干时间有限，某一跳的纠缠对若需等待兄弟链路而超时，会在已拥塞节点触发再生请求，从而形成拥塞—超时—再拥塞的反馈回路。作者将其形式化为平均场丢失网络模型中的折叠分岔，并给出稳定性判据，证明系统在临界到达率以上会发生真正的级联拥塞崩塌。为缓解该问题，作者提出DALSAC主动准入控制策略，可在多种拓扑中延缓或避免崩溃，并提升吞吐率与成功率。

articles.title: JURY: A Comprehensive Training-Free to Fully-Supervised Framework for Evaluating Chemical Language Models
articles.title_zh: JURY：用于评估化学语言模型的从无训练到全监督综合框架
articles.abstract: Language models have reshaped computational chemistry by learning from SMILES strings, a compact textual notation for a molecule's atoms and bonds. Trained on millions of such strings, these models compress each molecule into a fixed-length embedding usable for tasks like property prediction and de novo generation. To predict a property, researchers attach a prediction head and finetune the model, but a capable head can learn much of a property from labels alone, reaching strong results even on embeddings that carry little relevant chemistry. Since most models in the literature are evaluated only through such finetuned heads, reported performance conflates the model with the head, its training, and the labelled dataset's size and quality, leaving what the model itself contributes unclear. To close this gap, we present JURY, a stringent evaluation framework that probes chemical language models directly. Two probes require no training: the Neighbourhood Probe predicts from a molecule's nearest neighbours in embedding space, and the Cluster Probe groups molecules by that space alone and predicts from each group's labels. Two probes are trained: the Linear Probe fits a single linear map from embedding to property, and the Nonlinear Probe trains a small network on as few as two labelled molecules up to the full training set. Together the four span zero-shot to fully supervised prediction. We apply each probe to 10 chemical language models across 3 architecture families on 73 ADMET tasks, we find these models are far more alike than prior evaluation suggests: no model dominates across probes, and ECFP fingerprints, used as a baseline, sit comfortably among them. Scientific Contribution: A powerful prediction head recovers what a weak one cannot, and in doing so hides what the model failed to supply. JURY makes this distinction visible, replacing a single performance value with a profile across four probes, where agreement marks what a model encodes. Across ten chemical language models and ECFP, this profile shows an embedding space is defined by three properties, how much chemistry it holds, in what form, and how readily it can be recovered, none conveyed by a single prediction head.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对化学语言模型评估中“模型本身贡献不清”的问题，提出JURY框架，直接检验模型嵌入的有效性。该框架包含无需训练的邻域探针和聚类探针，以及需要训练的线性探针等方法，用以区分嵌入是否真正编码了化学信息。作者旨在将模型表示能力与下游分类头、训练过程及标注数据质量解耦，从而更严格地评价化学语言模型。
