Records carry lifecycle status, provenance, and supersession links, queryable via MOOSE, a proprietary neurosymbolic engine that treats the symbolic layer as the primary reasoning substrate. We compared MOOSEDev against a production vector-memory tool on a neutral public corpus of 835 typed records. MOOSEDev returned the expected answer set essentially in full (0.98-1.00) on supersession, set-completeness, and negation questions, whereas the baseline's top-k retrieval surfaced between 6% and 27%. Conversely, relevance recall and token cost were largely equivalent between the two systems. We also describe a temporal commit-history bootstrap of our own codebase, a pre-registered live trial, and lessons learned.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 MOOSEDev，用于给编程代理提供结构化、基于本体的项目记忆。系统把架构决策、经验教训、约束与设计动机存入知识图谱，并通过 Model Context Protocol 接口暴露给代理；记录还带有生命周期状态、来源和替代关系等元信息。与一个向量记忆工具在 835 条类型化记录上的对比表明，MOOSEDev 在替代关系、集合完备性和否定类问题上几乎可完整返回目标答案，同时在相关性召回和 token 成本上与基线大体相当。

articles.title: Can Language Models Understand mmWave Data? Benchmarking Large Language Models for mmWave Radar-Based Human Understanding
articles.title_zh: 能理解毫米波数据吗？面向毫米波雷达人体理解的大语言模型基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14179v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning and generative capabilities, motivating their use as universal reasoning engines for perception. While modern approaches such as vision-language models (VLMs) have attempted to incorporate reasoning capabilities into visual sensing, the integration of LLMs with the millimeter-wave (mmWave) modality-despite its unique advantages under low light and occlusion-remains largely unexplored. The principal bottlenecks stem from the scarcity of radar language pairs, severe cross-dataset heterogeneity, and the absence of a foundational mmWave encoder. We address this gap through a minimal textualization interface that serializes each mmWave point cloud into concise natural language, allowing off-the-shelf LLMs to operate in a question answering (QA) setting. Building on this, we present mmWave-QA, the first benchmark for language-conditioned mmWave human perception. mmWave-QA aggregates heterogeneous public mmWave datasets and harmonizes them via calibration-aware preprocessing and global taxonomy alignment, while providing natural language QA. Spanning six scenarios and five QA tasks, the benchmark enables standardized evaluation across diverse mmWave hardware and experimental conditions, establishing a foundation for scalable research on mmWave-LLM integration. We further evaluate and analyze LLMs on our mmWave-QA, highlighting their zero-shot reasoning potential for radar perception, as well as their robustness under visual degradation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨大语言模型能否直接处理毫米波（mmWave）雷达数据。作者提出一种最小文本化接口，将毫米波点云序列化为简洁自然语言，使通用LLM以问答形式参与感知推理，并据此构建首个面向语言条件毫米波人体感知的基准 mmWave-QA。该基准整合多个公开毫米波数据集，通过标定感知预处理与全局类别对齐缓解跨数据集异质性，覆盖六类场景与五项问答任务。
authors: Jeongwan Shin, Jaehyeon Kim, Donguk Ko, Jaeho Choi

articles.title: CFM-Bench: A Unified Multi-Domain, Multi-Task Benchmark for Channel Foundation Models
articles.title_zh: CFM-Bench：面向信道基础模型的统一多领域多任务基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14975v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Channel foundation models (CFMs) are commonly evaluated in model-specific pipelines that differ in data, radio configurations, partitions, adaptation procedures, task definitions, and metrics, preventing reproducible comparison across CFMs and against task-specific networks. We release CFM-Bench, a unified multi-domain, multi-task benchmark comprising 157,900 official single-frame examples from six domains spanning 3GPP statistical simulation, two ray-tracing pipelines, terrestrial and aerial measurements, and synchronized vehicular multimodal simulation. Source-specific interfaces preserve complex channel state information (CSI) and the physical metadata available in each domain while allowing documented model-specific preprocessing. To reduce spatio-temporal leakage, official partitions isolate complete trajectories, measurement sessions, flights, vehicle links, simulation realizations, or buffered spatial regions. CFM-Bench excludes all benchmark splits from foundation-model pretraining, reserves the official training split for downstream fine-tuning, and reports the data used during model development. Six task groups across PHY, RAN, and ISAC applications cover CSI feedback, frequency and temporal channel extrapolation, propagation-state classification, current- and future-beam prediction, and single-frame and temporal localization. Representative experiments on CSI feedback, channel extrapolation, current-beam prediction, and wireless positioning provide reproducible reference results for pretrained channel-prediction models and task-specific neural networks. These results show that relative model performance can vary across data domains, highlighting the importance of using common data partitions, task definitions, and evaluation metrics. CFM-Bench provides a common substrate for evaluating the transferability of channel representations across models, domains, and tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，现有信道基础模型（CFM）的评测流程在数据、无线配置、划分方式、适配方法、任务定义和指标上高度不一致，导致不同模型之间以及与专用网络之间难以公平可复现地比较。为此，作者发布 CFM-Bench，汇集六个领域的157,900个官方单帧样本，覆盖统计仿真、射线追踪、地面与空中测量以及车载多模态仿真。该基准保留各领域的复杂CSI与物理元数据，同时通过轨迹/会话/飞行/链路级划分降低时空泄漏，并用于下游微调与统一评测。
authors: Yuan Gao, Wenjun Yu, Jun Jiang, Yunfan Li, Xinyu Guo, Shugong Xu

articles.title: van der Waals Josephson junctions for quantum science and technology
articles.title_zh: 面向量子科学与技术的范德华Josephson结

This Review discusses progress in different device architectures and provides a roadmap outlining near-term and long-term opportunities for the field.

articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this Comment, exact diagonalization and quantitative analysis show that the reported signatures of loop currents in Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-026-03339-8] can instead be explained by crystalline mosaicity and pre-transitional CDW fluctuations. Specifically: (i) the NQR linewidth tracks a standard Curie-Weiss (CW) law with no anomalies; (ii) the Zp-NQR asymmetric lineshapes stem from an angular mosaic spread, reproducing the spin-transition-dependent skewness; and (iii) the reported emergent field (hₘ̊ ₗₒc) arises from particular fitting constraints and attributing the angular distribution to an internal field rather than mosaicity. Consequently, the data in Ref. [arXiv:2605.05101; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41567-026-03339-8] remain insufficient to establish TRSB due to loop currents or a phase transition at T^* sim 120 K.
articles.abstract_zh: 该评论通过精确对角化和定量分析指出，原文所称环电流信号可由晶体马赛克展宽和电荷密度波转变前涨落解释。作者认为，NQR 线宽符合常规 Curie-Weiss 行为，Zp-NQR 非对称线形来自角向马赛克分布，而所谓局域涌现磁场源于特定拟合约束和对角分布的误归因。因此，原数据不足以证明环电流导致的时间反演对称性破缺或约 120 K 处的相变。

articles.title: Far-from-equilibrium scaling of non-abelian Goldstone modes
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔 Goldstone 模的远离平衡标度行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a broad class of nonthermal phases generated by the interplay of continuous symmetry breaking and weak nonequilibrium driving. Extending Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) physics beyond the single SO(2) chronon associated with periodically broken time translations, we construct nonequilibrium nonlinear sigma models for SO(2)× O(N) symmetry, describing non-Abelian time crystals with coexisting temporal and internal order. This symmetry structure arises naturally in driven quantum materials, active matter, and optically induced periodic states. For rotating and oscillating phases, we derive the Goldstone theories and show that chronon-O(N) couplings remain finite deep in the ordered regime. One-loop renormalization group analysis reveals a KPZ-like dimensional structure: in d=1,2, arbitrarily weak nonequilibrium perturbations destabilize the equilibrium fixed point and generate strongly coupled nonthermal fixed points, realizing emergent equilibrium breaking. By contrast, for d > 2, weak perturbations are irrelevant and effective equilibrium is restored. A central result is unconventional weak dynamic scaling in the rotating phase: strongly coupled Goldstone sectors acquire distinct universal dynamical exponents despite belonging to the same order parameter. We characterize this scaling analytically and corroborate it through direct simulations in 1+1 dimensions. In the oscillating phase, we recover and extend weak-scaling regimes known from drifting polymers. Finally, compactness and topological defects ultimately destroy long-range order but leave experimentally accessible nonthermal scaling windows. Together, these results extend KPZ universality to non-Abelian symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文识别出一类由连续对称性破缺与弱非平衡驱动共同产生的非热相，并将 KPZ 物理推广到具有 SO(2)×O(N) 对称性的非阿贝尔时间晶体。作者构造非平衡非线性 sigma 模型，推导旋转相和振荡相的 Goldstone 理论，发现 chronon 与 O(N) 模的耦合在有序相深处仍保持有限。一圈重整化群分析表明，在一维和二维中任意弱非平衡扰动都会破坏平衡不动点并产生强耦合非热不动点，而在高于二维时弱扰动变为无关。
authors: Carl Philipp Zelle, Gustav John, Orla Supple, Romain Daviet, Sebastian Diehl

articles.title: Multiscale Correlation of Morphological, Chemical, and Optical Properties in p-Type Porous Silicon
articles.title_zh: p 型多孔硅中形貌、化学与光学性质的多尺度关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a systematic study of the correlations among electrochemical processing conditions and the morphological, chemical, and optical properties of porous silicon (pSi). Twenty pSi samples were fabricated from boron-doped (100) crystalline silicon by varying current density, etching time, and hydrofluoric-acid concentration. Scanning electron microscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, and photoluminescence were used to characterize the resulting structures. The two-dimensional porosity varied only moderately, whereas porous-layer thickness increased with etching time and current density. The silicon oxide to silicon hydride ratio showed comparatively small variations. Corrected photoluminescence spectra were fitted with a four-component quantum-wire/quantum-dot model including localized surface-state transitions. The extracted quantum-wire and quantum-dot dimensions decreased systematically with increasing current density, while the photoluminescence maximum under 375 nm excitation showed no clear monotonic dependence on processing conditions. The results demonstrate that no single descriptor adequately captures the multiscale behavior of porous silicon.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者系统研究电化学制备条件与 p 型多孔硅形貌、化学键合和光致发光性质之间的关联。通过改变电流密度、刻蚀时间和氢氟酸浓度制备 20 个样品，并结合扫描电镜、红外光谱和光致发光表征发现，孔隙率变化较温和，而多孔层厚度随刻蚀时间和电流密度增加。量子线/量子点及表面局域态模型表明，提取出的纳米结构尺寸随电流密度增大而减小，但发光峰位与工艺参数之间没有简单单调关系。

articles.title: Anomalous Orbital Reconstruction Controlled by Interorbital Correlations and Hund's Coupling
articles.title_zh: 由轨道间关联和 Hund 耦合控制的反常轨道重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic origin of anomalous orbital polarization in a class of low-dimensional correlated oxides remains unresolved due to the competition among crystal-field effects, electronic correlations, and orbital-dependent dimensionality. Using dynamical mean-field theory, we investigate a two orbital Hubbard model with orbital-dependent dimensionality and reveal the mechanism for anomalous orbital polarization through orbital reconstruction beyond the bare crystal-field picture. We identify interorbital Coulomb interaction-induced charge competition as a key microscopic mechanism responsible for the orbital redistribution, which leads first to an orbital-polarized correlated metal and subsequently to an orbital-polarized Mott insulator. We further find that Hund's coupling acts as a filling-dependent regulator of orbital reconstruction. It weakens the correlation-induced orbital redistribution at quarter filling by competing with interorbital charge fluctuations, while at half filling it completely suppresses the orbital-polarized state by stabilizing high-spin orbital-balanced configurations. These results provide a unified picture of correlation driven orbital reconstruction and highlight the relevance of interorbital interactions and Hund's coupling for understanding orbital phenomena in low-dimensional transition-metal oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用动力学平均场理论研究具有轨道依赖维度的双轨道 Hubbard 模型，以解释低维关联氧化物中的反常轨道极化。结果表明，轨道间库仑相互作用诱导的电荷竞争是超越裸晶场图像的轨道重分布机制，可先产生轨道极化关联金属，再进入轨道极化 Mott 绝缘体。Hund 耦合则以填充依赖方式调控该重构：在四分之一填充削弱关联诱导的轨道重分布，在半填充通过稳定高自旋、轨道平衡构型完全抑制轨道极化态。
authors: Yu Ni, Lvjin Wang, Jinfeng Wang, Yunkun Niu, Zhaoming Fu, Yun Song

articles.title: Single-impurity polarons in hard-core lattice bosons at low and intermediate fillings
articles.title_zh: 低至中等填充硬核晶格玻色子中的单杂质极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a single mobile impurity in a two-dimensional hard-core Bose--Hubbard bath at low and intermediate fillings and determine how polaronic dressing evolves with bath filling for impurity--bath couplings ranging from weak to strong and ultimately to the two-component hard-core limit. Using large-scale, sign-problem-free worm-algorithm quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we extract momentum-space quasiparticle properties from the impurity Green's function and resolve the accompanying real-space bath rearrangement from an imaginary-time-averaged impurity-centered correlator. We also vary the impurity hopping tₘ̊ ᵢₘₚ to assess how reduced mobility modifies dressing in the strong-coupling regime. For the fillings accessible at each coupling, the impurity remains a dressed quasiparticle whose ground-state energy, effective mass, and residue vary smoothly with filling nₘ̊ b. In real space, increasing nₘ̊ b strengthens the short-range depletion while shifting the dominant response toward the impurity. In the two-component hard-core limit Uₘ̊ ᵢb/tₘ̊ b!→!infty, the large-distance recovery of the cumulative density deformation exhibits only weak filling dependence over the range considered here, whereas short-range core indicators continue to evolve. Our results quantitatively characterize strongly dressed polarons in a correlated, compressible lattice bath and resolve how filling and impurity mobility modify the near-core response and spatial extent of the dressing cloud.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究二维硬核 Bose-Hubbard 背景中单个可动杂质在低至中等填充下的极化子包裹效应，并考察其随玻色子填充、杂质-背景耦合和杂质跃迁强度的演化。通过无符号问题的大规模 worm 算法量子蒙特卡洛模拟，从杂质 Green 函数提取动量空间准粒子性质，并用以杂质为中心的关联函数解析实空间密度重排。结果显示，在可及参数范围内杂质保持为被包裹的准粒子，其基态能量、有效质量和准粒子残重随填充平滑变化；填充升高增强短程耗尽并改变主导密度响应的位置。

articles.title: Superconductivity in strongly overdoped cuprates: beyond the single-band model
articles.title_zh: 强过掺杂铜氧化物中的超导：超越单带模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In order to explain the observation of an extended superconducting region in several overdoped cuprates, which contrasts the dome scenario, by means of neutron and synchrotron x-ray powder diffraction we study the crystal structure of YBa₂Cu₃Oy, where strong oxygen overdoping up to y = 7.4 is achieved under high-pressure. A bond valence sum analysis indicates that 1/5 of the extra holes created by the excess oxygen are transferred to the CuO₂ planes, thus increasing the hole density up to p=0.27 hole/Cu, where superconductivity is expected to vanish according to the dome scenario. Instead, our data confirm a previous observation [Okai, Ono and Mitsuhashi, Physica C: Superconductivity bf 366, 164 (2002)] that the superconducting critical temperature, T_c, remains constant with y. Our data analysis accounts for this discrepancy in terms of the much shorter bond between the apical oxygen and the planar Cu ion, which suggests that the extra holes occupy the a₁₋ₛymmetry states formed by d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ orbitals, instead of the usual b₁₋ₛymmetry Zhang-Rice singlet states formed by dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbitals. Suitable spectroscopic measurements on single crystals may support such a two-band scenario, which would require a totally different theoretical approach to explain superconductivity in cuprates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过中子和同步辐射 X 射线粉末衍射研究高压强氧过掺杂 YBa2Cu3Oy 的晶体结构，以解释若干过掺杂铜氧化物中超导区域超出传统穹顶图像的现象。键价和分析表明，过量氧引入的空穴约有五分之一转移至 CuO2 面，使平面空穴浓度升至传统模型预期超导应消失的范围，但实验上 Tc 仍基本保持不变。作者将这一差异归因于顶位氧与平面 Cu 之间更短的键长，提示额外空穴可能占据由 d3z2-r2 轨道形成的 a1 对称态，而非通常的 Zhang-Rice 单重态。
authors: Ruichao Chen, Linda Sederholm, Yannick Klein, Ludovic Delbes, Benoît Baptiste, Paraskevas Parisiades, Emmanuel Maisonhaute, Davide Delmonte, Edmondo Gilioli, Maarit Karppinen, Ronald I. Smith, David A. Keen, Yann Le Godec, Andrea Gauzzi

articles.title: Accurate and efficient calculation of atomic forces in solids with non-self-consistent hybrid functionals
articles.title_zh: 用非自洽杂化泛函准确高效计算固体中的原子力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14147v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid functionals are routinely employed self-consistently within the generalized Kohn-Sham framework. The evaluation of the nonlocal Fock exchange operator makes hybrid functional calculations computationally expensive, in particular with plane-wave basis sets. Here, we investigate the advantages of non-self-consistent hybrid functional calculations, focusing on the evaluation of atomic forces. The analytical force terms that arise due to non-self-consistency are computed using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT), as implemented within the Quantum ESPRESSO distribution. A non-self-consistent hybrid force calculation thus consists of self-consistent DFPT calculations with a local or semi-local functional and a single evaluation of the Fock exchange operator. The overall computational cost is, thereby, reduced in general, especially for solids that require a dense Brillouin-zone sampling. Moreover, results for structural parameters are barely affected by self-consistency, and vibrational frequencies are typically agreeing within 0.5%, thus making non-self-consistent calculations an interesting alternative.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文评估非自洽杂化泛函计算在固体原子力求解中的优势，目标是降低平面波基组下非局域 Fock 交换带来的高计算成本。作者利用密度泛函微扰理论计算非自洽性引入的解析力项，使一次非自洽杂化力计算只需局域或半局域泛函的自洽 DFPT 加一次 Fock 交换评估。结果显示，该策略通常显著降低计算量，尤其适用于需密集布里渊区采样的固体，同时结构参数几乎不受自洽性影响，振动频率通常在 0.5% 内一致。

articles.title: Topological phases and quantum criticality from SU(2) Chern-Simons-matter theories
articles.title_zh: 来自 SU(2) Chern-Simons-物质理论的拓扑相与量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent numerical studies where various SU(2) Chern-Simons-matter theories emerge, we analytically study topological phases and quantum criticality in two-dimensional systems described by such theories. First, we classify SU(2)ₖ topological orders in all lattice spin systems with a p4× SO(3) symmetry, where k is an arbitrary nonzero integer. We find that for each odd k, the topological order can emerge in systems with an arbitrary Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) anomaly, and the symmetry cannot permute anyons. If the system has a nontrivial (respectively, trivial) LSM anomaly, then there is exactly one (respectively, nine) symmetry-enriched topological (SET) phases. On the other hand, SU(2)ₖ topological order with any even k can only emerge in systems with a trivial LSM anomaly. If knotin6, 10, 14, ḑots, the symmetry cannot permute anyons, and there are 16 SET phases. If kin6, 10, 14, ḑots, there are 4 different ways how the symmetry can permute anyons, and there are 64 SET phases. Next, we analyze the SU(2)ₖ Chern-Simons theories coupled to N_f flavors of gapless matter fields that can be either bosonic or fermionic. For both types of theories, we consider a joint large-N_f and large-k limit with N_f/k fixed, and compute the scaling dimensions of the bilinear operators of the bosons or fermions to the order of 1/N_f. These results sharpen our understanding of these emergent exotic topological phases and quantum criticality, and provide useful guidance to explore them further.
articles.abstract_zh: 受近期数值研究启发，作者解析研究二维 SU(2) Chern-Simons-物质理论中的拓扑相和量子临界行为。文章首先在具有 p4×SO(3) 对称性的晶格自旋系统中分类 SU(2)k 拓扑序及其对 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis 异常和对称性富集拓扑相的约束，发现奇偶 k 情形具有不同的任意子置换和 SET 分类结构。随后讨论 SU(2)k Chern-Simons 理论耦合多味无能隙玻色或费米物质场时的临界性质，为相关数值相图提供场论解释。
authors: Yunchao Hao, Yingcheng Li, Kangle Li, Liujun Zou

articles.title: Orbital Hall Effect in Weyl Semimetals from quantum geometric band interference
articles.title_zh: 由量子几何能带干涉导致的 Weyl 半金属轨道霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) transport in solids, prominently manifested in the orbital Hall effect, has emerged as a fundamental phenomenon that can decisively exceed its spin-based counterparts. However, the microscopic mechanisms governing OAM dynamics remain only partially understood. In particular, the role of band geometry in orbital transport is still largely unresolved. Here we address this question in the TaAs family of Weyl semimetals, TaAs, TaP, NbAs, and NbP, whose well-established topology and associated OAM textures make them an ideal platform in this context. Using ab initio density functional theory, complemented by a minimal Weyl model based on adiabatic perturbation theory, we establish --- both numerically and analytically --- a direct link between OAM transport, band geometry, and topological electronic structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究固体中轨道角动量输运，特别是 Weyl 半金属 TaAs、TaP、NbAs 和 NbP 中的轨道霍尔效应。作者结合第一性原理密度泛函理论和基于绝热微扰理论的最小 Weyl 模型，从数值和解析两方面建立轨道角动量输运、能带量子几何与拓扑电子结构之间的直接联系。研究强调量子几何能带干涉是理解轨道霍尔响应微观机制的关键因素。
authors: Chiara Pacella, Maximilian Ünzelmann, Ahmed Osman, Tim Figgemeier, Friedrich Reinert, Angel Rubio, Domenico Di Sante

articles.title: Unraveling the Roles of Shallow, Deep and Auger Trapping in Charge Carrier Recombination in Triple-Cation Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 解析三阳离子钙钛矿中浅陷阱、深陷阱与俄歇俘获在载流子复合中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding charge-carrier recombination in metal halide perovskites is essential for accurately identifying the factors limiting solar cell efficiency, yet it remains challenging due to the interplay of multiple competing processes. Here, we combine time-resolved photoluminescence and excitation dependent photoluminescence quantum yield measurements over a wide range of fluences and repetition rates to investigate recombination dynamics in triple-cation perovskite thin films. By jointly analyzing these multidimensional datasets, we develop a unified model that quantitatively reproduces both photoluminescence decays and absolute quantum yields across all excitation conditions. Our results reveal the coexistence of deep and shallow traps, as well as a second-order nonradiative recombination pathway attributed to Auger-assisted trapping. Importantly, this mechanism dominates under one-sun illumination, making it a critical limiting factor for photovoltaic performance. These findings provide a comprehensive framework for understanding recombination in perovskites and highlight the importance of higher-order defect-mediated processes in determining their efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合时间分辨光致发光和激发依赖的光致发光量子产率，在宽注量与重复频率范围内分析三阳离子钙钛矿薄膜的复合动力学。作者建立统一模型，同时定量再现实验中的发光衰减与绝对量子产率。结果表明材料中深、浅陷阱共存，并存在归因于俄歇辅助俘获的二阶非辐射复合通道；该机制在一太阳光照条件下占主导，是限制光伏性能的重要因素。
authors: Jitendra Kumar, Thomas Kirchartz, Alexandr Marunchenko, Alexander Kiligaridis, Shraddha M. Rao, Shivam Singh, Ankur Yadav, Monojit Bag, Yana Vaynzof, Ivan G. Scheblykin

articles.title: Universal Signature of Hundness and Its Quantification
articles.title_zh: Hundness 的普适标志及其定量化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hund's coupling J induces fundamentally different correlation effects from Hubbard U. This leads to a violation of the Brinkman--Rice scenario and the emergence of a Janus-faced phase owing to its low-energy effectiveness, in which band renormalization is confined below a characteristic energy scale. We propose a quantitative framework to capture low-energy effectiveness through two correlation factors: z_L for low-energy quasiparticle renormalization and z_H for high-energy charge fluctuations, newly introduced in this study. The discrepancy between z_L and z_H reflects the Hund character of the correlation. By establishing a one-to-one correspondence between correlation factors and the spin and charge susceptibilities, we identify the spin-degree-of-freedom effectiveness as the microscopic origin of low-energy effectiveness. Our framework, validated across multiorbital models and real materials, provides a universal and quantitative measure of Hundness.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出定量描述洪特耦合相关性的框架，用低能准粒子重整化因子 z_L 与高能电荷涨落因子 z_H 区分洪特耦合 J 与 Hubbard U 诱导的不同关联效应。z_L 与 z_H 的偏离被用作“Hundness”的度量，并与自旋、电荷磁化率建立一一对应。研究指出自旋自由度的低能有效性是洪特金属中低能重整化受限的微观起源，并在多轨道模型和真实材料中验证了该度量的普适性。
authors: Dongwook Kim, Ina Park, Bo Gyu Jang, Ji Hoon Shim

articles.title: Skyrmion Fractional Chern Insulator: An Intrinsically Multiband Route to Fractionalization in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 斯格明子分数量子陈绝缘体：菱方石墨烯中通向分数量子化的本征多能带机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an unconventional microscopic origin for the fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) effect in rhombohedral graphene moiré superlattices: skyrmion fractionalization. We view the state at filling ν<1 as a metal of skyrmion vacancies, charge +e objects formed by removing layer-pseudospin skyrmions from the interaction-generated skyrmion lattice Chern insulator at ν=1. These vacancies are intrinsically multiband degrees of freedom, absent in single Chern band-projected studies. Building on a recently proposed ideal limit, we first develop an effective field theory showing that skyrmion vacancies can themselves fractionalize, thereby inducing charge fractionalization. Focusing on ν=frac23, we then construct explicit variational trial wavefunctions for the resulting skyrmion fractional Chern insulator and provide numerical evidence, together with general arguments, showing that this process is energetically favored. Our results establish a realistic route to the FQAH that does not rely on a partially filled Chern band, but instead arises from fractionalization of collective pseudospin textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出菱方石墨烯莫尔超晶格中分数量子反常霍尔效应的一种非常规微观起源：斯格明子分数量子化。在填充 ν<1 时，体系被视为由斯格明子空位构成的金属，这些带 +e 电荷的对象来自 ν=1 相互作用诱导的斯格明子晶格陈绝缘体。基于有效场论和 ν=2/3 的变分试探波函数，研究表明这些本征多能带的集体赝自旋纹理可进一步分数量子化，并在能量上具有竞争优势。
authors: Julian May-Mann, Tixuan Tan, Patrick J. Ledwith, Zhengyan Darius Shi, Trithep Devakul

articles.title: Lee-Yang paradigm of phase transition in eigenstate thermalized systems
articles.title_zh: 本征态热化系统中相变的 Lee-Yang 范式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13174v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As phase transitions in isolated quantum systems remain elusive, here we show how a thermodynamic-like phase transition, falling into the Lee-Yang paradigm, can arise in systems displaying eigenstate thermalization. Specifically, we show that in holographic conformal field theories, the eigenstate expectation of the auto-correlation function can be mapped to the partition function a̧l Zgₐᵤgₑ(z) of a virtual interacting instanton gas, with the conformal mapping of the imaginary time: z=1-e⁻τ and the central charge c mimicking the instanton fugacity and volume, respectively. We find that akin to the Lee-Yang paradigm, for c→infty a pair of complex conjugate zeros of a̧l Zgₐᵤgₑ(z) move to the real axis located at the famous forbidden singularity. Passing through the singularity the system transits from the low- to high-fugacity phase, accompanied by dramatic changes in scaling behaviors of the free energy and dominant microscopic configurations. Our findings indicate that physics of phase transitions from eigenstate thermalization is very rich.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论孤立量子系统中如何在本征态热化背景下出现类似热力学相变、并符合 Lee-Yang 范式的现象。作者在全息共形场论中将自相关函数的本征态期望映射为虚拟相互作用瞬子气的配分函数，其中虚时间的共形映射、中心荷等参数对应有效的复活动力学变量。结果显示，在大中心荷极限下，复共轭零点向实轴上的禁戒奇点移动，穿越该奇点时体系在低、高逸度相之间转变，并伴随自由能标度和主导微观构型的显著改变。
authors: Yongjiang Xu, Weixin Sun, Chushun Tian, Huajia Wang

articles.title: Heuristic Lookahead Distillation Protocol Search
articles.title_zh: 启发式前瞻蒸馏协议搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13644v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bipartite qubit entanglement distillation is the process of converting noisy ebits into pure ebits using only local operations and classical communication. This is a core operation for quantum repeaters, enabling such crucial tasks as long-distance quantum communication and distributed quantum computing. In this work, we introduce a method for searching for entanglement distillation protocols and, using this technique, distil qubit Werner states at a higher rate than could be achieved using previously discovered protocols. In particular, we demonstrate the advantage of our new distillation strategy by improving the best-known lower bound for the two-way-assisted quantum capacity of the qubit depolarising channel across a wide range of channel parameters, making progress in one of the long-standing problems of quantum information theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种搜索双量子比特纠缠蒸馏协议的方法，用于在仅允许局域操作和经典通信的条件下将噪声 ebits 转化为纯 ebits。借助该策略，作者对量子比特 Werner 态实现了高于既有协议的蒸馏速率。进一步地，该方法提高了量子比特退相干信道在宽参数范围内的双向辅助量子容量已知下界，推进了量子信息中的长期问题。

articles.title: Tracking real-space quantum state breathing through Floquet-projector geometry
articles.title_zh: 通过 Floquet 投影几何追踪实空间量子态呼吸
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Periodic driving of spatially periodic quantum systems generates band structures that are absent in static crystals. We present a quantum geometric theory to characterize the Floquet-Bloch states at stroboscopic times and during micromotion on equal footing. Our framework builds upon time-evolved Floquet projectors that connect static quantum geometry, micromotion-operator geometry, and Floquet topology. To illustrate the formalism, we introduce the Floquet-projector quantum metric, which we employ to characterize the real-space breathing of localized states in a driven chiral-symmetric integrable spin chain. The Floquet-projector quantum metric, integrated over the Brillouin zone, captures the oscillatory variance during micromotion and, at symmetry-selected times, is bounded below by Floquet topological invariants. We further describe how the Floquet projector geometry enables a systematic investigation of micromotion dynamics in periodically driven lattice systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了周期驱动空间周期量子系统中 Floquet-Bloch 态的量子几何理论，可统一描述频闪时刻与微运动过程。框架基于时间演化的 Floquet 投影算符，将静态量子几何、微运动算符几何和 Floquet 拓扑联系起来。作者引入 Floquet 投影量子度量，并在受驱动的手征对称可积自旋链中用其刻画局域态的实空间呼吸；其布里渊区积分可捕捉微运动中的方差振荡，并在特定对称时刻受拓扑不变量下界约束。
authors: Arpit Raj, Johannes Mitscherling, Björn Trauzettel

articles.title: Open system probes of renormalization group flow
articles.title_zh: 开放系统探针表征重整化群流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13664v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open system probes can provide an efficient means to characterize quantum many-body systems by employing them as engineered environments. The key idea is to map long-range spatial correlations of the environment onto dynamical correlations in the evolution of a simple quantum probe. Using the example of a qubit coupled to a transverse-field Ising model, we show how the non-Markovian rate or spectral flow can be used to identify stable and unstable fixed points, infer scaling dimensions of relevant fields, and deduce the renormalization group flow induced by deformations around any fixed point.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出利用简单开放量子探针表征量子多体系统的重整化群流，将环境的长程空间关联映射到探针演化中的动力学关联。以耦合到横场 Ising 模型的量子比特为例，作者展示非马尔可夫速率或谱流可用于识别稳定与不稳定不动点。该方法还可推断相关场的标度维数，并重构围绕任意不动点形变所诱导的重整化群流。
authors: Andrew Keefe, Brenden Bowen, Saptarshi Biswas, Albion Lawrence, Nishant Agarwal, Archana Kamal

articles.title: Nonorthogonal-state erasure as the resource behind apparent second-law violations
articles.title_zh: 非正交态擦除是表观第二定律违背背后的资源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13881v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Perfect deterministic distinguishing of nonorthogonal quantum states is forbidden by the linear and unitary structure of quantum mechanics. It has often been assumed that, if such distinguishing were available, it would be the resource enabling work extraction from a single heat bath. We show that this expectation identifies the wrong thermodynamic operation and prove such hypothetical operation increases, rather than decreases, the joint entropy of system and detector. The entropy-decreasing resource is instead the inverse operation, which we call nonorthogonal-state erasure. Reanalyzing a Peres-type Szilard engine, we show that the apparent extracted work Wₑₓₜ=0.2766kBT for an equal mixture of an atomic ensemble with spin state łeft|p̆arrowi̊ghtångle  and łeft|i̊ghtarrowi̊ghtångle . Thus the apparent second-law violation is supplied not by nonorthogonal-state distinguishing, but by a nonorthogonal quantum state erasure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究澄清了关于非正交量子态可区分性与单热浴做功之间关系的常见误解。作者证明，假想的完美确定性区分非正交态操作并不会降低系统与探测器的联合熵，反而会增加熵。真正提供熵降低资源的是其逆过程，即“非正交态擦除”；对 Peres 型 Szilard 引擎的再分析表明，表观的第二定律违背源自这种擦除操作，而非非正交态区分本身。
authors: Xinshu Xia, Hui Hui Qin, Yu-Han Ma, Chang-Pu Sun, Hui Dong

articles.title: Poly(1,4-anthraquinone) as an Organic Cathode Material: Simulation of Observable Bonding Properties to Li, Na, Mg, and Ca
articles.title_zh: 聚(1,4-蒽醌)作为有机正极材料：与 Li、Na、Mg、Ca 可观测成键性质的模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14185v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Poly(1,4-anthraquinone) (P14AQ) has emerged as a promising cathode material, offering high capacity and good cycling stability, yet the atomic-scale mechanisms governing metal-ion binding and electrochemical behavior remain poorly understood. To address this, we investigate the binding mechanisms of Li, Na, Mg, and Ca to P14AQ using quantum mechanical methods, particularly DFT and DFTB. A key challenge lies in the material's structural complexity: multiple conformers of P14AQ are energetically similar but kinetically isolated due to significant energy barriers. To account for this, we develop an automated method to generate all unique P14AQ conformers for a periodic polymer chain without rotational duplicates through an orientation labeling scheme. For each conformer, we systematically place a metal atom adjacent to every oxygen site, enabling a complete exploration of binding configurations. We observe two structural motifs: a single metal-oxygen bond and coordination to two opposite oxygen atoms. While Li and Na exhibit continuous energy distributions, Mg and Ca show an energy gap between the two motifs, with a strong preference for the two-oxygen binding configuration. Galvanostatic measurements support these findings by showing lower gravimetric capacities for Ca and Mg than for Li and Na. For Na, the different numbers of metal-oxygen bonds are reflected in the two voltage plateaus observed experimentally. Overall, the combined computational and experimental results explain the higher capacity of monovalent ions in P14AQ: divalent ions cannot bind efficiently to a single oxygen site due to unfavorable energetics, and the conformational distribution of the polymer chain prevents optimal coordination.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 DFT 与 DFTB 等量子力学方法研究 Li、Na、Mg、Ca 与聚(1,4-蒽醌)正极材料的结合机制，以理解其金属离子存储与电化学行为。针对聚合物存在多个能量相近但动力学隔离构象的问题，作者开发了自动生成周期链唯一构象的取向标记方法，并系统考察金属原子在各氧位点附近的结合构型。结果识别出单金属-氧键和与两个相对氧原子配位两类结构基元；Li、Na 的结合能分布较连续，而 Mg、Ca 在两类基元之间呈现能量间隙并表现出明显偏好。
authors: Laura Femmer, Lukas Köbbing, Juliane Heitkämper, Sibylle Riedel, Devran Cay, Florin Adler, Birgit Esser, Alexander J. C. Kuehne, Zhirong Zhao-Karger, Piotr de Silva, Juan Maria García-Lastra, Birger Horstmann

articles.title: Quantum Snapshots Reveal a Compact Conformal Boundary Mode
articles.title_zh: 量子快照揭示紧致共形边界模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14327v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A projective measurement of a many-body state produces a microscopic snapshot, usually viewed as random classical data. We show that partial occupation snapshots of the critical XX chain contain a universal angle with a precise conformal meaning. Dividing the ring into two measured and two unmeasured arcs, we assign geometry-dependent conformal side weights to the observed occupations and obtain a compact variable δ_L. At every finite size, δ_L is fixed by the measured sites alone; the particular complete-configuration lift X_L used in the proof additionally depends on unobserved particles. This angle is an exact microscopic compact coordinate whose scaling-limit law is that of the relative Dirichlet phase of the associated conformal quadrilateral---the boundary coordinate conjugate to charge in continuum post-measurement descriptions. Exact free-fermion determinants yield all of its Fourier moments. We prove that the lift becomes Gaussian with variance 2h(ζ), where h(ζ) is the rectangle modulus, and hence łangle eⁱⁱ qδ_Långle→ e⁻h⁽ζ⁾q^². Thus raw quantum snapshots realize the heat kernel on a circle and provide an outcome-level microscopic foundation for the compact zero-mode sector of Born averages over fluctuating conformal boundary conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，对临界 XX 链多体态进行投影测量得到的部分占据快照中，隐藏着具有明确共形意义的普适角变量。通过将环划分为已测量与未测量弧段，并为观测占据赋予几何依赖的共形边权，作者构造出紧致变量 δ_L。自由费米子行列式给出其所有傅里叶矩，并证明在标度极限下该变量服从与共形四边形相对 Dirichlet 相位相同的分布，即圆上的热核形式，从而在单次测量结果层面显现共形边界自由度。

articles.title: Non-Shattering at and Above the Dynamical Temperature in the Spherical Pure p-Spin Model
articles.title_zh: 球形纯 p-自旋模型在动力学温度及以上不存在破碎
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14369v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider the notion of shattering introduced by Ben Arous and Jagannath for spherical pure p-spin glasses with overlap q. For every p≥ 3 and 0<βłeqβₛₕ(p), we rule out shattering whenever qłeq2⁻¹/² or q>sqrt(p-2)/(p-1). The proof combines a deterministic N+1 bound for disjoint bands in the first range with a general-p sign law showing that their total marked weight has subdominant free energy in the second. A spherical-code bound and Hölder's inequality give an additional q-dependent obstruction; in particular, they rule out every fixed overlap for 0<βłeqsqrtłog2. For p=3, the first two ranges already exhaust every fixed qin(0,1), so the landscape is not shattered at any T≥ Tₛₕ. For p≥4, the cases not covered by our criteria are confined to 2⁻¹/² <βłeqβₛₕ(p). In particular, this paper partially resolves Conjecture 1 of the paper above and also suggests new methods to show non-shattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究 Ben Arous 与 Jagannath 为具有重叠 q 的球形纯 p-自旋玻璃提出的“破碎”概念。作者证明对 p≥3 且 0<β≤βₛₕ₍ₚ₎，在 q≤2⁻¹/² 或 q>√(p−2)/(p−1) 的范围内不存在破碎，并结合不相交带的确定性 N+1 上界与一般 p 的符号律实现证明。球面码界与 Hölder 不等式还给出额外的 q 依赖阻碍，特别是在 0<β≤√log2 时排除所有固定重叠；对 p=3，该结果覆盖所有固定 q∈(0,1)，说明 T≥Tₛₕ 时能量景观不破碎。

articles.title: Angular displacement readout of a mechanical oscillator with a guided mode resonance
articles.title_zh: 利用导模共振读出机械振子的角位移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14447v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Measuring the angular displacement of a mechanical oscillator is a ubiquitous task; however, the multimode nature of angular optomechanical coupling makes coherent signal enhancement challenging. Here we demonstrate coherently enhanced angular displacement readout with an integrated guided mode resonance (GMR) structure, applying it to precision readout of a nanomechanical oscillator. Specifically, we fabricate subwavelength gratings into 100-nm-thick Si₃N₄ membranes and record their vibration by direct transmission measurements. The narrow linewidth approx 2.5;mrad of the GMR enables a shot-noise-limited displacement imprecision of  10⁻⁹;rad/sqrtHz with nanowatts of optical power, sufficient to resolve the thermal motion of a Qapprox 10⁶ torsion mode with a signal-to-noise ratio of 47 dB. Control experiments based on polarization and wavelength detuning confirm that the measured signal arises from GMR-mediated transduction. These results establish guided-mode resonance as an on-chip approach to angular displacement readout in quantum optomechanical sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了基于集成导模共振结构的相干增强角位移读出，并将其用于纳米机械振子的精密测量。作者在 100 nm 厚 Si₃N₄ 膜中制备亚波长光栅，通过直接透射测量记录振动；导模共振的窄线宽使其在纳瓦级光功率下达到约 10⁻⁹ rad/√Hz 的散粒噪声限制位移不精确度。该灵敏度足以以 47 dB 信噪比分辨 Q≈10⁶ 的扭转模热运动，偏振和波长失谐对照实验证实信号来自导模共振介导的换能。
authors: Diego Torres-Barajas, Oscar Angulo, Aman R. Agrawal, Mohamed ElKabbash, Dalziel J. Wilson

articles.title: GPU implementation of mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics without momentum jump
articles.title_zh: 无动量跳跃的混合量子-经典刘维尔分子动力学的 GPU 实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14544v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We implemented on GPU a mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics simulation based on a momentum-jump-free theory. The trajectory spawning that was previously implemented on CPU for sampling enhancement was eliminated to avoid the overhead of thread divergence and dynamic memory allocation on the GPU. This achieved a speedup of an order of magnitude compared to the CPU computation with spawning, as well as a linear scaling with respect to the number of sampling trajectories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在 GPU 上实现了基于无动量跳跃理论的混合量子-经典刘维尔分子动力学模拟。为避免 GPU 中线程分歧和动态内存分配开销，作者去除了此前 CPU 版本用于增强采样的轨线生成机制。相较带轨线生成的 CPU 计算，该实现获得约一个数量级加速，并且随采样轨线数呈线性标度。

articles.title: What is the group of a quantum group? From SL_q(2) to MPO representations of SL(2)
articles.title_zh: 量子群的群是什么？从 SL_q(2) 到 SL(2) 的 MPO 表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2202.06937v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generalized symmetries realized by matrix product operators (MPOs) have so far been tied to discrete data leaving continuous symmetries outside the framework. Quantum groups fill this gap: starting from the RTT relations of SL_q(2) at an odd root of unity q^d=1, we construct a three-parameter family of periodic-boundary MPOs of bond dimension d² that multiply according to the group law of SL(2). This gives Lusztig's quantum Frobenius map a concrete operator form, and endows the XXZ chain on the ring at Δ=(q+q⁻¹)/2 with an intrinsically non-local SU(2) symmetry. Fusion of the local tensors is generically semisimple. On special loci it is non-semisimple, and yields reducible but indecomposable tensors with Jordan blocks. Differentiating D(g) at the identity produces the mathfraksl(2) generators as d-body operators: the MPO algebra supplies the exponential map for quantum group algebras.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将量子群用于扩展矩阵乘积算符（MPO）描述的广义对称性框架，使其能够容纳连续对称性。作者从奇数阶单位根处 SL_q(2) 的 RTT 关系出发，构造了键维数为 d²、按 SL(2) 群律相乘的三参数周期边界 MPO 族，并给出 Lusztig 量子 Frobenius 映射的具体算符形式。该结构赋予环形 XXZ 链一种内禀非局域的 SU(2) 对称性，并在特殊参数轨迹上产生带 Jordan 块的可约不可分解张量。
authors: Weronika Wiesiolek, Romain Couvreur, Dmitry Chernyak, Laurens Lootens, Frank Verstraete

articles.title: Quantum enhanced metrology based on flipping trajectory of cold Rydberg gases
articles.title_zh: 基于冷里德堡气体翻转轨迹的量子增强计量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.11035v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The dynamical trajectory of a dissipative Rydberg many-body system could be flipped under a microwave field driving, displaying an enhanced sensitivity. This is because the intersection of the folded hysteresis trajectories exhibits a sharp peak near the phase transition, amplifying the response to small changes in the microwave field. Here, we demonstrate an experiment of enhanced metrology through flipping the hysteresis trajectory in a cold atomic system, displaying an approach to improve sensitivity near the gap-closing points. By measuring the intersection points of hysteresis trajectories versus Rabi frequency of the microwave field, we quantify the equivalent sensitivity to be 1.6(5) nV cm-1 Hz-1/2. The measurement is also dependent on the interaction time, optical depth and principal quantum number since the long-range interaction between Rydberg atoms could dramatically change the shape of hysteresis trajectories. The reported results suggest that flipping trajectory features in cold Rydberg many-body systems could advance sensing and metrology applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验利用微波驱动下耗散里德堡多体系统滞回轨迹的翻转来增强场测量灵敏度。折叠滞回轨迹交点在相变附近形成尖锐峰值，从而放大小微波场变化的响应。通过测量交点随微波 Rabi 频率的变化，作者得到等效灵敏度 1.6(5) nV cm⁻¹ Hz⁻¹/²，并指出相互作用时间、光学深度和主量子数会显著影响滞回轨迹形状。
authors: Ya-Jun Wang, Jun Zhang, Zheng-Yuan Zhang, Shi-Yao Shao, Qing Li, Han-Chao Chen, Yu Ma, Tian-Yu Han, Qi-Feng Wang, Jia-Dou Nan, Yi-Ming Yin, Dong-Yang Zhu, Qiao-Qiao Fang, Chao Yu, Xin Liu, Guang-Can Guo, Bang Liu, Li-Hua Zhang, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi

articles.title: Dual-species alkali and alkaline-earth-like optical tweezer arrays via interferometrically aligned high-NA objectives
articles.title_zh: 基于干涉对准高数值孔径物镜的双物种碱金属与类碱土光镊阵列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have developed a dual-species optical tweezer array apparatus combining ⁸⁷Rb and ¹⁷⁴Yb atoms with a permanent hybrid Twyman-Green--Fizeau interferometer, which provides precision co-alignment of two opposing 0.6-numerical aperture (NA) objectives and the high NA beams that pass through the system. This technique is extensible to other tweezer platforms operating at high numerical aperture across widely-separated wavelengths. Here we present simultaneous trapping and single-site resolved imaging of both species in co-aligned tweezer arrays with ⁸⁷Rb confined at 840 m̊nm and ¹⁷⁴Yb at 532 m̊nm. The platform provides a foundation for hybrid quantum register operation, including mid-circuit measurements and asymmetric intra- and inter-species interactions, greatly expanding the capabilities of neutral atom arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者构建了同时操控 ⁸⁷Rb 与 ¹⁷⁴Yb 的双物种光镊阵列装置，采用永久混合 Twyman-Green--Fizeau 干涉仪精密共线对准两只相对的 0.6 NA 物镜及高 NA 光束。实验实现了共线光镊阵列中两种原子的同时俘获和单站点分辨成像，其中 ⁸⁷Rb 使用 840 nm、¹⁷⁴Yb 使用 532 nm 光镊。该平台为混合量子寄存器、中途测量以及非对称的同种/异种相互作用提供了实验基础。
authors: K. Weber, M. McMaster, M. Anderson, J. Tu, S. E. Eustice, N. A. Schine, I. B. Spielman, J. V. Porto, S. L. Rolston, S. Subhankar

articles.title: Enhanced Third-Harmonic Generation in a Bound State in the Continuum Assisted Multiband All-Dielectric Metasurface
articles.title_zh: 连续谱束缚态辅助的多带全介质超表面增强三次谐波产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiband Fano resonances are demonstrated in the near-infrared (near-IR) using an all-dielectric metasurface whose unit cell consists of four silicon nanoblocks on a glass substrate. An in-plane asymmetry triggers symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum (QBICs), producing multiple high-Q resonances. Their origin is identified through multipolar decomposition of the scattering cross section and field distributions at the resonances. The strong field localization at these resonances enables efficient multiband third-harmonic (TH) generation in the ultraviolet (UV), with a maximum simulated conversion efficiency of 8.5 × 10⁻³ at a peak pump intensity of 1.6,mathrmGW/cm². The metasurface is fabricated in symmetric and asymmetric configurations, and its linear and nonlinear responses are measured under normal incidence. A TH conversion efficiency of 1.2 × 10⁻⁶ is obtained at a peak pump intensity of 3.25,mathrmGW/cm². These results establish a route to multiband photonic devices, including multiwavelength lasers, multiband harmonic generation, and single-photon sources for quantum photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在近红外展示了由四个硅纳米块组成的全介质超表面中的多带 Fano 共振。面内不对称性激发对称性保护的准连续谱束缚态，产生多个高 Q 共振，其物理来源通过散射截面的多极分解和共振场分布加以识别。强场局域使紫外多带三次谐波产生得到增强，模拟最高转换效率为 8.5 × 10⁻³；实验在 3.25 GW/cm² 峰值泵浦强度下获得 1.2 × 10⁻⁶ 的三次谐波转换效率。
authors: Partha Mondal, Hadeel Alamoudi, Rodrigo P. Sanchez, Redha H. Al Ibrahim, Boon S. Ooi, Iman Roqan, Hakan Bagci

articles.title: Data-driven modeling of hypersonic flows in chemical non-equilibrium with catalytic surfaces
articles.title_zh: 含催化表面的化学非平衡高超声速流动的数据驱动建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.14445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hypersonic flows involve extreme thermochemical non-equilibrium, where strong energy dissipation leads to tightly coupled chemical reactions, radiation, and energy exchange. In this regime, surface chemistry, particularly catalytic wall reactions, can significantly affect boundary-layer composition and surface heat transfer. Accurate simulations of such flows may require repeated evaluations of detailed thermochemical libraries, which represent a major computational bottleneck in high-fidelity reactive-flow simulations. To mitigate this cost, we employ the data-driven reduced-order framework introduced by Scherding et al. (2023), which combines nonlinear dimensionality reduction, community clustering, and local surrogate models to efficiently approximate high-dimensional thermochemical mappings. In this work, this framework is extended for the first time to hypersonic reactive flows with localized catalytic surface discontinuities, introducing sharp variations in wall chemistry and heat transfer. To address the increased complexity of the thermochemical state space, the dimensionality reduction method is enhanced with a Sammon-type stress penalty that mitigates topological folding of the latent manifold and improves the robustness of the clustering and surrogate stages. The resulting model accurately captures the effects of discontinuous catalytic properties, including sharp gradients in wall species mass fractions, diffusion fluxes, and surface heat transfer, while reducing the overall simulation cost by 50% without compromising accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向具有强热化学非平衡的高超声速反应流，关注催化壁面反应对边界层组分和表面热传递的影响。为降低高保真反应流模拟中反复调用详细热化学库的计算成本，作者采用并扩展了结合非线性降维、社群聚类和局部代理模型的数据驱动降阶框架。该框架首次被用于含局域催化表面不连续性的高超声速反应流，并通过改进降维策略处理由壁面化学和热流突变带来的复杂状态空间。
authors: Konstantinos Sarras, Louis Walpot, Thierry Magin, Peter Schmid, Taraneh Sayadi

articles.title: Uncertainty quantification of reacting fluids interacting with porous media using a hybrid physics-based and data-driven approach
articles.title_zh: 基于物理模型与数据驱动混合方法的不确定性量化：反应流体与多孔介质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03649v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurately simulating coupled physical processes under uncertainty is essential for reliable modeling and design in performance-critical applications such as combustion systems. Ablative heat shield design, as a specific example of this class, involves modeling multi-physics interactions between reacting flows and a porous material. Repeatedly evaluating these models to quantify parametric uncertainties would be prohibitively computationally expensive. In this work, we combine physics-based modeling using a single-domain approach with data-driven reduced-order modeling to quantify uncertainty via the operator inference method. The detailed physics-based simulations reproduce the measured surface temperature of an object exposed to high-enthalpy flow in a plasma wind tunnel experiment within 5%. We further use the model to demonstrate the effect of complex flow situations on the dynamic interactions between the porous heat shield material and the surrounding gas. The parametric reduced-order model, built on physics-based simulation data, successfully captures variations in quantities of interest resulting from changes in the permeability and heat transfer coefficient of the porous material in two separate studies: solid fuel combustion and emission of buoyant reacting plumes in quiescent air and ablation in a wind tunnel.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对反应流与多孔材料耦合体系中的参数不确定性，提出结合单域物理建模与数据驱动降阶模型的混合不确定性量化方法。以烧蚀热防护材料为例，详细物理模拟能够在 5% 以内复现实验等离子体风洞中物体表面温度。作者进一步利用基于算子推断的参数化降阶模型，捕捉渗透率等参数变化引起的关键响应变化，从而降低重复高保真模拟的成本。

articles.title: Never the Number: Structural Abstention for AI Systems Whose Answers Are Consumed as Fact
articles.title_zh: 绝不直接给数：面向答案被当作事实使用的 AI 系统的结构性拒答机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have made natural language interfaces to databases (NLIDB) newly credible, but LLM text-to-SQL systems fail in a way that matters for deployment: a hallucinated column or a mis-aggregated total yields a fluent wrong answer, indistinguishable at the point of use from a right one. Where the consumer cannot inspect the generated query, as in enterprise AI deployments and operational dashboards, and increasingly where the consumer is a tool-using agent rather than a person, accuracy alone is insufficient: nothing marks which answers to distrust. This is a reliability problem before it is an accuracy problem. We propose an architectural pattern for such systems, a trusted kernel with a generative shell, resting on one invariant: a component that can fabricate may influence which question the system answers, never which value it returns. A generative shell interprets underspecified input and phrases replies; a deterministic kernel matches fully specified questions against a bounded set of answerable question shapes and compiles them to queries by deterministic execution. The two meet at a confirmation the user reads before any value is computed, and requests the kernel cannot express are declined rather than approximated. We call this structural abstention, and distinguish it from the statistical abstention of selective prediction and calibrated confidence: refusal here needs no confidence estimate, because unanswerable requests are unrepresentable. We specify the pattern implementation-independently, give a five-decision recipe and work it across three domains, extend the invariant from returned values to the actions of agentic systems, and report a two-year production case study alongside two generative alternatives, a fine-tuned parser and a tool-retrieval agent. We close against enterprise and reliability benchmarks published since.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论大语言模型驱动的自然语言数据库接口在企业问答和自动化仪表盘中的可靠性问题：错误列、错误聚合等幻觉会生成流畅但不可辨别的错误数值。作者提出“可信内核加生成式外壳”的架构原则，即可生成内容的组件只能影响系统回答哪个问题，不能决定返回的数值。生成式外壳负责解释模糊输入和组织表达，确定性内核仅对完全限定且落在可回答问题形状集合内的请求进行匹配和查询编译。

Devereaux Here, the authors use determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations to obtain high-resolution single-particle spectra of the doped Hubbard model, uncovering a pronounced electron-hole asymmetry. articles.abstract: Author(s): Gleb S. Seleznev and Yakov V. Fominov Dirty superconducting films with magnetic impurities can exhibit nontrivial behavior in a magnetic field that polarizes the impurity spins. As predicted by Kharitonov and Feigelman (KF) [ JETP Lett. 82 , 421 (2005) ], this polarization reduces the exchange scattering rate. Consequently, a parallel magn… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 074505] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究讨论含磁性杂质的脏超导薄膜在外磁场极化杂质自旋时的非平庸响应。根据Kharitonov–Feigelman机制，杂质自旋极化会降低交换散射率，从而可能在平行磁场下增强超导性。文章围绕这种场致增强效应及其适用条件展开分析。
authors: Gleb S. Seleznev and Yakov V. Fominov

articles.title: Topological superconductivity in a one-dimensional s+p-wave Kitaev chain: Particle current and localization of Majorana modes
articles.title_zh: 一维s+p波Kitaev链中的拓扑超导：粒子流与Majorana模局域化
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ali Ashtari and Ali Khademi We investigate the topological properties and phase diagrams of a one-dimensional Kitaev chain with spin-orbit coupling, subject to an external magnetic field, and hosting coexisting singlet s-wave and triplet p-wave pairings. To drive the system out of equilibrium, we introduce a phase in the h… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 084506] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究具有自旋–轨道耦合、外磁场以及共存单重态s波和三重态p波配对的一维Kitaev链的拓扑性质与相图。作者通过在哈密顿量中引入相位使体系偏离平衡，并考察由此产生的粒子流。研究重点包括拓扑相变、Majorana零模的出现及其空间局域化特征。

articles.title: Robust Ce³⁺ valence across the pressure-driven collapse of magnetism in the frustrated Shastry-Sutherland compound Ce₂Pd₂In
articles.title_zh: 受挫Shastry–Sutherland化合物Ce₂Pd₂In中压力驱动磁性坍塌过程的稳健Ce³⁺价态
articles.abstract: Author(s): P. Král, D. Staško, A. D. Rosa, E. Mijit, T. Irifune, J. Kaštil, L. Havela, and J. Prchal Ce-based intermetallics often display a delicate interplay between magnetism, electron correlations, and lattice geometry, making them highly sensitive to external pressure. We report the evolution of the Ce valence in the frustrated Shastry-Sutherland compound Ce₂Pd₂ma… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094417] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验研究考察Ce基受挫Shastry–Sutherland化合物Ce₂Pd₂In在压力作用下Ce价态的演化。Ce基金属间化合物中磁性、电子关联和晶格几何之间存在微妙耦合，因此对外压高度敏感。结果表明，在压力驱动磁性坍塌过程中Ce³⁺价态保持稳健，提示磁性抑制并非源于显著价态转变。
authors: P. Král, D. Staško, A. D. Rosa, E. Mijit, T. Irifune, J. Kaštil, L. Havela, and J. Prchal

articles.title: Atomic-scale structure of antiferromagnetic domain walls in NiO
articles.title_zh: NiO中反铁磁畴壁的原子尺度结构
articles.abstract: Author(s): Alban Simonnot, Frédéric Miserque, Jean-Baptiste Moussy, Jean-Yves Chauleau, Michel Viret, and Alain Chartier Atomistic spin simulations have been used to provide insights into the internal structures of twin (T) and spin (S) domain walls (DWs) in antiferromagnetic NiO. While S DWs imply simple continuous spin rotations, T DWs are composed of a combination of rotations and canting. The hybrid nature of thes… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094419] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用原子级自旋模拟研究反铁磁NiO中孪晶畴壁和自旋畴壁的内部结构。结果显示，自旋畴壁主要表现为连续的自旋旋转，而孪晶畴壁则包含旋转与自旋倾斜的组合。孪晶畴壁的混合特征揭示了晶体结构与反铁磁序参量在畴壁尺度上的耦合。
authors: Alban Simonnot, Frédéric Miserque, Jean-Baptiste Moussy, Jean-Yves Chauleau, Michel Viret, and Alain Chartier

articles.title: C₃ symmetry induced antisymmetric planar Hall effect and magnetoresistance in single-crystalline ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 单晶铁磁体中C₃对称性诱导的反对称平面霍尔效应与磁阻
articles.abstract: Author(s): Weijie Qin, Kaiyuan Wang, Dingwen Zhang, Bin Yang, Yuanzhe Tian, Bowen Zheng, Biying Huang, Yuben Yang, Wenqin Zou, Xiangang Wan, Di Wu, and Peng Wang The planar Hall effect (PHE) is typically symmetric under magnetic field reversal, as required by the Onsager reciprocity relations. Recent advances have identified the antisymmetric PHE as an intriguing extension in magnetic systems. While new mechanisms have been proposed, the role of conventional… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094420] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论单晶铁磁体中由C₃晶体对称性引起的反对称平面霍尔效应和相关磁阻。通常平面霍尔效应在磁场反演下应满足Onsager互易关系而呈对称性，但近年实验发现磁性体系中可出现反对称分量。文章强调常规晶体对称性和各向异性机制在该效应中的作用。
authors: Weijie Qin, Kaiyuan Wang, Dingwen Zhang, Bin Yang, Yuanzhe Tian, Bowen Zheng, Biying Huang, Yuben Yang, Wenqin Zou, Xiangang Wan, Di Wu, and Peng Wang

articles.title: In-plane magnetic response and Maki parameter of alternating-twist multilayers
articles.title_zh: 交替扭转多层体系的面内磁响应与Maki参数
articles.abstract: Author(s): Igor Vasilevskiy, Miguel Sánchez Sánchez, Khadija Challaouy, Dionisios Margetis, Guillermo Gómez-Santos, and Tobias Stauber We analytically study the orbital response of alternating-twist multilayer graphene to an in-plane magnetic field using the unitary transformation introduced by Khalaf et al. [ Phys. Rev. B 100 , 085109 (2019) ]. This transformation maps an alternating-twist N-layer system onto N/2 decoupled twiste… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 105121] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作解析研究交替扭转多层石墨烯对面内磁场的轨道响应。作者采用Khalaf等提出的幺正变换，将N层交替扭转体系映射为若干解耦的扭转双层子体系，从而简化磁响应分析。研究还讨论该类体系中的Maki参数，用于评估轨道破坏与顺磁限制在超导中的相对重要性。
authors: Igor Vasilevskiy, Miguel Sánchez Sánchez, Khadija Challaouy, Dionisios Margetis, Guillermo Gómez-Santos, and Tobias Stauber

articles.title: Random geometry of maximum-density dimer packings of the site-diluted kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: 位点稀释kagome晶格最大密度二聚体填充的随机几何
articles.abstract: Author(s): Ritesh Bhola and Kedar Damle Recent work [M. Z. Ansari and K. Damle, Phys. Rev. Lett. 132 , 226504 (2024) ] that analyzed the effect of vacancy disorder on a short-range resonating valence bond spin liquid state of kagome-lattice antiferromagnets argued that such spin liquids are stable to vacancy disorder. The argument relied cr… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 105125] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究位点稀释kagome晶格上最大密度二聚体覆盖的随机几何性质。其背景是近期关于空位无序对kagome反铁磁体短程共振价键自旋液体稳定性的理论分析。文章旨在为含空位体系中的二聚体构型统计与自旋液体稳定性提供更精确的几何理解。

articles.title: Evolution of low-temperature electron spin resonance in Yb(Rh₀.₇₃Co₀.₂₇)₂Si₂ upon entering ferromagnetic order
articles.title_zh: Yb(Rh₀.₇₃Co₀.₂₇)₂Si₂进入铁磁有序时低温电子自旋共振的演化
articles.abstract: Author(s): I. Fazlizhanov, Z. Y. Seidov, H.-A. Krug von Nidda, C. Krellner, C. Klingner, L. Pedrero, S. Lausberg, M. Brando, C. Geibel, F. Steglich, and J. Sichelschmidt We report electron spin resonance (ESR) experiments conducted on oriented powder of the heavy-fermion ferromagnet Yb(Rh₀.₇₃Co₀.₂₇)₂Si₂ in the temperature range 0.75 ≤T≤4phantomůle0.16em0exK, which includes the transition b… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 115117] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验报道了重费米子铁磁体Yb(Rh₀.₇₃Co₀.₂₇)₂Si₂取向粉末在0.75–4 K范围内的电子自旋共振测量，覆盖其进入铁磁有序的温区。研究跟踪ESR信号在相变附近的温度演化，以探测局域磁矩、重费米子关联和铁磁序之间的关系。具体共振线宽、g因子和临界行为需参阅原文。
authors: I. Fazlizhanov, Z. Y. Seidov, H.-A. Krug von Nidda, C. Krellner, C. Klingner, L. Pedrero, S. Lausberg, M. Brando, C. Geibel, F. Steglich, and J. Sichelschmidt

articles.title: Origin of anomalous size effects in ferroelectric hafnia thin films
articles.title_zh: 铁电氧化铪薄膜中反常尺寸效应的起源
articles.abstract: Author(s): Tianyuan Zhu, Jingxuan Li, Zuhuang Chen, and Shi Liu The persistence of ferroelectricity in ultrathin HfO₂ films challenges conventional theories, particularly given the paradoxical observation that the out-of-plane lattice spacing increases as the film thickness decreases, an anomalous size effect absent in perovskite ferroelectrics. … [Phys. Rev. B 114, 115408] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论超薄 HfO₂ 薄膜中铁电性得以保持的原因，重点关注随膜厚减小而面外晶格间距反而增大的反常尺寸效应。作者将这一行为与传统钙钛矿铁电体中的尺寸效应相区分，旨在阐明铁电氧化铪薄膜结构响应与铁电稳定性之间的内在联系。
authors: Tianyuan Zhu, Jingxuan Li, Zuhuang Chen, and Shi Liu

articles.title: Majorana modes in graphene strips: Polarization, wavefunctions, disorder, and Andreev states
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯条带中的马约拉纳模：极化、波函数、无序与安德烈夫态
articles.abstract: Author(s): Shubhanshu Karoliya, Sumanta Tewari, and Gargee Sharma Topologically protected Majorana zero modes (MZMs) have attracted intense interest due to their potential application in fault-tolerant quantum computation (TQC). Graphene nanoribbons, with tunable edge terminations and compatibility with planar device architectures, offer a promising alternative to… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 115409] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究石墨烯纳米带中拓扑保护马约拉纳零能模的性质，包括其极化特征、波函数分布、对无序的鲁棒性以及相关安德烈夫束缚态。石墨烯纳米带因边界构型可调且适合平面器件集成，被视为实现容错量子计算平台的潜在候选体系。
authors: Shubhanshu Karoliya, Sumanta Tewari, and Gargee Sharma

articles.title: Tunable collinear altermagnets induced by Floquet engineering in A-type sliding antiferromagnetic bilayers
articles.title_zh: Floquet 工程在 A 型滑移反铁磁双层中诱导的可调共线交替磁体
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zhe Li, Lijuan Li, Da-Shuai Ma, Mengxue Guan, Rui Wang, and Sheng Meng Arranging the stacking orders of A-type antiferromagnetic (A-AFM) bilayers offers a practical pathway to realizing two-dimensional altermagnets. Previous proposals, however, rely on stringent symmetry constraints, including layer groups and stacking registries. In this work, we demonstrate that … [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125111] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出通过调控 A 型反铁磁双层的堆垛与滑移结构来实现二维交替磁性，并进一步利用 Floquet 工程增强可调性。相比依赖严格层群和堆垛对称性的既有方案，该工作强调外场驱动可为共线交替磁体提供更灵活的实现路径。
authors: Zhe Li, Lijuan Li, Da-Shuai Ma, Mengxue Guan, Rui Wang, and Sheng Meng

articles.title: Periodic charge transfer in pure carbon-based two-dimensional heterojunctions of graphene and the quasihexagonal phase of C₆₀
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯与准六角 C₆₀ 相纯碳二维异质结中的周期性电荷转移
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yi Ren, Shan Dong, Zheng Vitto Han, Wen-Kai Lou, and Kai Chang The recently synthesized quasihexagonal-phase fullerene network (qHPC₆₀) offers opportunities for 2D electronics. Through first-principles calculations, we reveal that qHPC₆₀/graphene van der Waals heterostructures exhibit unique electronic properties, includ… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125415] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于第一性原理计算研究准六角相富勒烯网络 qHPC₆₀ 与石墨烯构成的范德华异质结构。结果显示，这类纯碳二维异质结具有独特电子性质，并出现与界面结构相关的周期性电荷转移行为，为二维碳基电子器件提供新的材料设计思路。
authors: Yi Ren, Shan Dong, Zheng Vitto Han, Wen-Kai Lou, and Kai Chang

articles.title: Generalizing the composite fermion theory for fractional Chern insulators
articles.title_zh: 分数量子陈绝缘体的广义复合费米子理论
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hao Jin and Junren Shi We propose a generalized composite fermion (CF) theory for fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) by adapting the quantum mechanics approach of CFs. The theoretical framework naturally produces an effective CF Hamiltonian and a wave-function ansatz, and the Bloch band characteristics of FCIs determine e… [Phys. Rev. B 114, L111106] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种面向分数量子陈绝缘体的广义复合费米子理论，将复合费米子的量子力学处理方式推广到陈能带体系。该框架自然给出有效复合费米子哈密顿量和波函数试探形式，并将分数量子陈绝缘体的布洛赫能带特征纳入理论描述。

articles.title: Coulomb Screening of Superconductivity in Magic-Angle Graphene
articles.title_zh: 魔角石墨烯中超导性的库仑屏蔽
articles.abstract: Author(s): Julien Barrier, Liangtao Peng, Shuigang Xu, Christophe De Beule, V. I. Fal’ko, K. Watanabe, T. Tanigushi, A. K. Geim, Shaffique Adam, and Alexey I. Berdyugin Metallic layers placed near magic-angle graphene suppress Coulomb interactions and reveal that its superconductivity is driven by electronic interactions rather than conventional atomic vibrations. [Phys. Rev. X 16, 031040] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验通过在魔角石墨烯附近引入金属层来屏蔽库仑相互作用，从而检验其超导机制。结果表明，屏蔽电子相互作用会抑制超导性，支持魔角石墨烯超导主要由电子关联驱动，而非传统原子振动机制主导。
authors: Julien Barrier, Liangtao Peng, Shuigang Xu, Christophe De Beule, V. I. Fal’ko, K. Watanabe, T. Tanigushi, A. K. Geim, Shaffique Adam, and Alexey I. Berdyugin

Canfield, and Hermann Suderow Vortex formation from surface superconductivity is observed in the topological semimetal γ -PtBi 2 , which confirms the robustness of the surface superconductivity at a higher T c than the bulk. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 086001] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在拓扑半金属 γ−PtBi₂ 中观测到由表面超导形成的涡旋结构。实验结果表明，其表面超导相较体相具有更高的临界温度并表现出稳健性，为理解拓扑半金属中的表面超导提供了直接证据。
authors: Jose Antonio Moreno, Pablo García Talavera, Edwin Herrera, Sara López Valle, Zhuoqi Li, Lin-Lin Wang, Sergey Bud’ko, Alexander I. Buzdin, Isabel Guillamón, Paul C. Canfield, and Hermann Suderow

articles.title: Fingerprinting fractons with pump-probe spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 用泵浦-探测光谱识别分形子相
articles.abstract: Author(s): Wei-En Tseng, Oliver Hart, and Rahul Nandkishore Here, the authors show that pump-probe spectroscopy provides distinctive signatures of fracton phases through lineon-planon braiding. The restricted mobility of excitations enables an emergent planon bound state and leads to strikingly different long-time responses upon swapping the pump and probe polarizations. These responses reveal braiding statistics, bound-state formation, and the subdimensional mobility of fractionalized excitations, thereby distinguishing fracton phases from conventional topologically ordered spin liquids. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 105124] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出泵浦-探测光谱可通过线子-面子编织过程识别分形子相的特征。受限运动的激发可导致涌现的面子束缚态，并使交换泵浦与探测偏振后出现显著不同的长时间响应。这些响应能够揭示编织统计、束缚态形成以及分数化激发的亚维运动性，从而区分分形子相与常规拓扑有序自旋液体。
authors: Wei-En Tseng, Oliver Hart, and Rahul Nandkishore

articles.title: Complex nonlinear sigma model
articles.title_zh: 复非线性 sigma 模型
articles.abstract: Author(s): Kazuki Yamamoto and Kohei Kawabata Motivated by the recent interest in the criticality of open quantum many-body systems, the authors investigate here nonlinear sigma models with complexified couplings as a general framework for nonunitary field theory. Applying the perturbative renormalization group analysis to the tenfold symmetric spaces, the authors demonstrate that fixed points with complex scaling dimensions and critical exponents arise generically, without counterparts in conventional nonlinear sigma models with real couplings. The results elucidate universal aspects of critical phenomena in complexified field theory. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 115112] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 受开放量子多体系统临界性研究的推动，作者将耦合常数复化的非线性 sigma 模型作为非幺正场论的通用框架。通过对十重对称空间进行微扰重整化群分析，研究发现具有复标度维数和复临界指数的不动点可普遍出现，这类现象在实耦合的传统非线性 sigma 模型中没有对应物。

articles.title: Nematic phase transitions in Bernal bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: Bernal 双层石墨烯中的向列相变
articles.abstract: Author(s): R. David Mayrhofer and Andrey V. Chubukov In experiments on Bernal bilayer graphene under perpendicular electric field, quantum oscillations have shown the presence of electronic nematic states in some ranges of hole density. Here, the authors perform a Hartree-Fock study to numerically determine where nematic states develop in the system as hole density and displacement field are varied. Nematic phases are found close to the boundary between fully and partially isospin polarized phases. An analytic criterion for the appearance of nematicity is also derived. It is in good agreement with the numerical results. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 115114] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究垂直电场下 Bernal 堆垛双层石墨烯中的电子向列相，背景是量子振荡实验在部分空穴密度区间发现了向列态迹象。作者采用 Hartree-Fock 方法数值确定向列态随空穴密度和位移场变化出现的区域，并发现其通常位于完全与部分同位旋极化相的边界附近。研究还推导了向列性出现的解析判据，且与数值结果符合良好。
authors: R. David Mayrhofer and Andrey V. Chubukov

articles.title: Distributions of noisy expectation values over sets of measurement operators
articles.title_zh: 测量算符集合上含噪期望值的分布
articles.abstract: Author(s): Matthew Duschenes, Roger G. Melko, Juan Carrasquilla, and Raymond Laflamme The authors extend analytical derivations for expectation value distributions to random mixed quantum states and general measurement operator sets, using a combinatorics framework to calculate their moments. Using simulated noisy brickwork circuits, they introduce an effective global depolarizing model that accounts for empirical peak behaviors and reveal that non-symmetric measurement sets yield distinct multimodal distributions. [Phys. Rev. A 114, 022434] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者将期望值分布的解析推导推广到随机混合量子态和一般测量算符集合，并利用组合学框架计算分布矩。通过模拟含噪 brickwork 量子线路，研究引入有效全局退极化模型来解释经验峰结构，并指出非对称测量集合会产生不同的多峰分布。
authors: Matthew Duschenes, Roger G. Melko, Juan Carrasquilla, and Raymond Laflamme

articles.title: Four-Loop Gluon Anomalous Dimension of General Lorentz Spin: Transcendental Part
articles.title_zh: 任意洛伦兹自旋的四圈胶子反常维数：超越性部分

Vogt We consider the anomalous dimension γgg⁽³⁾(N) of the twist-two gluon operator of arbitrary Lorentz spin N in the quark flavor singlet sector of a general gauge theory at four loops and construct its contribution proportional to ζ(3) in analytic form by applying the Lenstra-Lenstra-Lová… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 081901] Published Mon Aug 17, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究一般规范理论中夸克味单态扇区、任意洛伦兹自旋 N 的 twist-two 胶子算符四圈反常维数 γgg⁽³⁾(N)。作者构造了其中与 ζ(3) 成正比的贡献的解析表达式，工作聚焦于高阶微扰 QCD/规范理论中反常维数的超越性结构。
authors: B. A. Kniehl, S.-O. Moch, V. N. Velizhanin, and A. Vogt

articles.title: Anomalous Hydrodynamic Fluctuations in the Quantum XXZ Spin Chain
articles.title_zh: 量子XXZ自旋链中的反常流体力学涨落
articles.abstract: Author(s): Takato Yoshimura, Žiga Krajnik, Alvise Bastianello, and Enej Ilievski The quantum XXZ spin-1/2 chain features non-Gaussian spin current fluctuations in the regime of easy-axis anisotropy. articles.title: Deformation-driven modulation of chirality and spin polarization in L-cysteine intercalated MoS 2 nanosheets: A mechanistic approach to chirality-induced spin selectivity in two-dimensional material
articles.title_zh: L-半胱氨酸插层 MoS₂ 纳米片中由形变驱动的手性与自旋极化调控：二维材料中手性诱导自旋选择性的机理研究
articles.abstract: The electron spin represents an extra set of observables, and spin polarization has emerged as an important measurable for low-dimensional phenomena. Chirality-induced spin selectivity has emerged as a powerful strategy for generating spin-polarized currents without magnetic materials. Here, we demonstrate that controlled intercalation of chiral L-cysteine molecules into exfoliated MoS 2 nanosheets at two different concentrations enables deformation-driven tuning of chirality and spin polarization. Notably, circular dichroism measurements show inversion of chiroptical response with molecular loading, which directly correlates with the sign and magnitude of spin polarization measured by using scanning tunneling spectroscopy. Density functional theory calculations reveal the structural-deformation dependence of the bandgap width and of the spin–orbit coupling splitting. The results establish a clear structure–chirality–spin relationship, where stacking-induced symmetry breaking governs spin-selective transport. This work provides a mechanistic framework for engineering chiral two-dimensional materials with tunable spin functionality for next-generation spintronic applications.

articles.title: Simulating exciton transport with complex absorbing potentials

articles.abstract: We introduce a stochastic framework based on complex absorbing potentials (CAPs) to investigate exciton transport in large molecular aggregates. Within this framework, CAPs act as non-Hermitian reservoirs and sinks, enabling an effective assessment of transport efficiency. We apply this approach to cyanine dye aggregates to examine how vacancy defects and system size influence exciton transport in two-dimensional sheets and quasi-one-dimensional tubes. We further introduce a CAP-based classification scheme that links molecular packing in two-dimensional aggregates to their transport behavior. Our results demonstrate how aggregate topology and structural disorder govern exciton transport and provide design principles for developing materials with enhanced energy transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一种基于复吸收势（CAP）的随机框架，用于研究大尺寸分子聚集体中的激子输运。CAP 在这里作为非厄米储库与汇，能够有效评估输运效率，并被应用于考察氰染料聚集体中空位缺陷与体系尺寸的影响。研究还提出了一个基于 CAP 的分类方案，将二维聚集体中的分子堆积方式与其输运行为联系起来。

articles.title: Thermalization regimes in a chaotic Tavis-Cummings model
articles.title_zh: 混沌 Tavis–Cummings 模型中的热化机制
articles.abstract: This work investigates the emergent thermalization regimes in a chaotic Tavis–Cummings (TC) model and their implications in quantum spectroscopy. While the TC model is a cornerstone of cavity quantum electrodynamics, traditional treatments often overlook many-body effects that arise in the thermodynamic limit. We utilize the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis to demonstrate that a nonintegrable excitonic Hamiltonian within the material manifold drives local thermalization. By tuning the polariton splitting g , we observe two dynamical regimes: a thermalizing regime at low interactions driven by quantum chaos and ergodicity, and a nonthermalizing regime at high interactions where strong coupling suppresses ergodicity. We further show that these regimes have direct implications on output photon statistics, specifically influencing the correlation times τ c of the cavity population and the second-order correlation function g (2) ( t + τ ). We propose that entangled-biphoton spectroscopy serves as an ideal experimental platform to probe these effects and to allow the characterization of the underlying many-body exciton-coupling disorder σ through coincidence measurements of the output. Taken together, these results exploit a naturally occurring many-body phenomenon to bridge theoretical predictions with experimental observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了混沌 Tavis–Cummings 模型中涌现的热化行为，并讨论其对量子光谱学的意义。借助本征态热化假设，文中表明材料子空间中的非可积激子哈密顿量可驱动局域热化。通过调节极化激元劈裂，体系表现出两种动力学区间：低相互作用下由量子混沌和遍历性驱动的热化区，以及高相互作用下强耦合抑制遍历性的非热化区。

articles.title: Machine learning prediction of organic compound melting points informed by condensed-phase and electronic descriptors
articles.title_zh: 融合凝聚相与电子描述符的有机化合物熔点机器学习预测
articles.abstract: Melting point (MP) is an important thermophysical property for the chemical process industry, yet accurate prediction of MP for organic compounds in the absence of experimental data remains challenging due to the complex interplay between molecular packing, intermolecular interactions, and electronic structure. Traditional group contribution and quantitative structure–property relationship models, which rely primarily on static molecular descriptors, often fail to capture these critical condensed-phase effects. In this study, we present a hybrid machine learning framework that integrates cheminformatics descriptors with quantum chemical features and dynamic condensed-phase descriptors derived from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Using a curated subset of the DIPPR 801 database, multiple machine learning architectures, including light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) and graph convolutional networks, were evaluated with feature sets of increasing physical fidelity. The best-performing model, based on LightGBM trained on Dragon descriptors augmented with MD and quantum chemical features, achieves a mean absolute error of 22.5 K, outperforming descriptor-only models and structure-based deep learning baselines. Shapley additive explanations interpretability analysis reveals that melting behavior is governed primarily by molecular topology, surface-area-weighted electronic descriptors, and condensed-phase interaction properties. In contrast, many isolated functional group and single molecule electronic descriptors contribute negligibly once these effects are accounted for. These results demonstrate that incorporating physics-informed, multi-scale descriptors enables more accurate and physically interpretable MP predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种混合机器学习框架，将传统化学信息描述符、量子化学特征以及分子动力学模拟得到的凝聚相描述符结合起来，用于预测有机化合物熔点。基于 DIPPR 801 数据库子集的测试表明，加入凝聚相与电子结构信息后，模型性能明显优于仅依赖静态描述符的方法。性能最佳的 LightGBM 模型将 Dragon 描述符与 MD 和量子化学特征联合使用，平均绝对误差达到 22.5 K。
