authors: Zeping Chen, Ruda Jian, Sachin Sigdel, Guoping Xiong, Jian-Xun Wang, Tengfei Luo

articles.title: Implicit Machine Learning Force Fields Accelerate Molecular Dynamics Simulations
articles.title_zh: 隐式机器学习力场加速分子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29158v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce implicit machine learning force fields (I-MLFFs), which replace explicit stacks of neural network layers with self-consistent fixed-point equations. In molecular simulations, this formulation enables intermediate representations to be reused across successive timesteps, thereby warm-starting force evaluation. The resulting models effectively combine the computational footprint of a shallow, single-layer MLFF with the representational capacity and accuracy of a deep neural network. Our approach unlocks architecture-agnostic efficiency gains that are inaccessible when force prediction and trajectory integration are considered separately. We demonstrate this across three major classes of graph neural networks: invariant, equivariant Cartesian tensor, and SO(3)-equivariant spherical-tensor architectures. Each yields a two- to five-fold reduction in compute and memory footprint. Crucially, these gains are achieved while retaining full atomistic resolution and the original integration timestep, avoiding spatial or temporal coarse graining. Our contribution therefore advances the scaling frontier of quantum-mechanically faithful molecular simulation, enabling longer trajectories and larger atomistic systems within fixed GPU memory and compute budgets, and thereby opening access to new insights across biomolecular and material systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出隐式机器学习力场（I-MLFF），用自洽不动点方程替代显式堆叠的神经网络层。由于分子动力学相邻时间步的中间表示可被复用，力评估能够热启动，从而以接近浅层模型的计算开销获得深层网络的表达能力和精度。作者在不变、笛卡尔张量等变和 SO(3) 球张量等变三类图神经网络架构上展示了 2–5 倍的计算与内存开销降低，同时保持全原子分辨率和原始积分步长。
authors: Johannes Maeß, Leon Werner, J. Thorben Frank, Winfried Ripken, Martin Michajlow, Joshua Futterer, Klaus-Robert Müller, Stefan Chmiela

articles.title: UniPolymer: A Unified Framework for Property Prediction, Structure Recommendation, and Evaluation in Polyimide Design
articles.title_zh: UniPolymer：面向聚酰亚胺设计的性质预测、结构推荐与评估统一框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing polyimide structures with specific glass transition temperatures (Tg) is highly challenging. Existing methods primarily focus on target-conditioned generation, lacking an assessment of the consistency between the generated structure and the target properties. This leads to low-quality candidates deviating from the design objective entering subsequent processes, increasing invalid experiments and prolonging the development cycle. To address this issue, we propose UniPolymer, a unified framework for property prediction, target-conditioned generation, candidate evaluation, and structure recommendation in polyimide design and a dataset containing 10066 deduplicated polyimide repeating units with Tg tags (PITg-Curated) was constructed. To improve the consistency between generated candidate structures and the target Tg, UniPolymer first establishes a reliable structure-property relationship mapping through self-supervised chemical semantic learning, structural consistency enhancement, and multi-scale information fusion. Subsequently, the model employs a continuous-discrete joint Tg representation to guide the autoregressive generation of SELFIES. The generated candidate structures are further evaluated using a frozen property predictor and polyimide-specific structural constraints, and ranked according to their deviation from the target Tg, thereby preventing structures deviating from the target from entering the subsequent validation stage. Experimental results show that UniPolymer achieved a property prediction accuracy of R²⁼⁰.93 and a candidate structure evaluation pass rate of 73.79%, which are 2% and 1.21% higher than the best baseline, respectively. Meanwhile, the predicted Tg values of the recommended candidates are in high agreement with the results of molecular dynamics simulations, thereby reducing the number of candidates that enter the high-cost experimental stage.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对给定玻璃化转变温度（Tg）的聚酰亚胺结构设计，提出统一框架 UniPolymer，并构建包含 10066 个去重聚酰亚胺重复单元及 Tg 标签的数据集 PITg-Curated。框架整合性质预测、目标条件生成、候选评估和结构推荐，通过自监督化学语义学习、结构一致性增强和多尺度信息融合建立结构–性质映射。随后模型以连续–离散联合 Tg 表征引导自回归生成，以提高生成结构与目标 Tg 的一致性，减少偏离设计目标的候选进入后续实验。
authors: Junquan Hu, Zhihui Wang, Peng Xu, Xinru Guo, Xintong Li, Kun Lu, Ben Fei

articles.title: Assessing the Generalization of Graph Neural Networks for Fault Location Across Increasing Distributed Energy Resource Penetration Levels
articles.title_zh: 评估图神经网络在分布式能源渗透率升高条件下故障定位的泛化能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate fault location is critical for distribution network reliability. However, increasing distributed energy resource (DER) penetration complicates fault location due to intermittent generation and bidirectional power flows that reshape fault signatures. Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (STGNNs) have shown promise by jointly modeling spatial and temporal dependencies, but their behavior under increasing DER penetration has not been studied rigorously. In this paper, we (i) systematically benchmark spatio-temporal graph attention network (STGATv2) against purely temporal (gated recurrent unit, GRU), purely spatial (GATv2) and traditional machine learning baselines, and (ii) evaluate how well models generalize across increasing DER penetration levels (10%, 25%, 50%) on a reconfigured IEEE 123-bus feeder with multiple DER injection points and moderate-to-high impedance faults. Results show that STGATv2 consistently outperforms neural baselines, achieving 92-94% macro F1 in-distribution. Notably, generalization across penetration levels is asymmetric: training at 50% penetration retains near in-distribution F1 score at lower levels, whereas training at 10% degrades considerably at 50% - with STGATv2 retaining 81-84% F1 under these drastic shifts, substantially higher than GATv2 and GRU which drop to 69-74% F1 and 73-75% F1 respectively. Under realistic measurement noise, STGATv2 maintains > 85% F1, while GRU drops as low as 33.5% F1, highlighting the critical role of topological awareness for robust fault location in active distribution networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察配电网中分布式能源（DER）渗透率上升对故障定位模型的影响，特别是间歇发电和双向潮流对故障特征的重塑。作者在重构的 IEEE 123 节点馈线上，将时空图注意网络 STGATv2 与 GRU、GATv2 及传统机器学习基线进行系统比较，并测试模型在 10%、25%、50% DER 渗透率之间的跨分布泛化。结果显示 STGATv2 在同分布条件下宏 F1 达到约 92–94%，且跨渗透率泛化具有非对称性：在高渗透率训练的模型向低渗透率迁移更稳定。
authors: Burak Karabulut, Olayiwola Arowolo, Carlo Manna, Chris Develder, Jochen L. Cremer

articles.title: DreamQAS: Learning a Decision-Useful World Model for VQE-Efficient Quantum Architecture Search
articles.title_zh: DreamQAS：学习对决策有用的世界模型以实现 VQE 高效的量子架构搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement-learning-based quantum architecture search (RL-QAS) repeatedly optimizes a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) after extending a circuit, although circuit construction and action legality are deterministic and known. We introduce DreamQAS, a model-based RL framework that preserves these exact circuit dynamics and learns only the expensive post-VQE feedback. A recurrent randomized-prior ensemble predicts an oracle-free score relative to an empirical energy frontier and supports multi-step imagined policy learning over explicit legal circuits. Ranking-based activation, uncertainty-aware pessimism and truncation, and selective real-VQE verification form a reliability-controlled learning loop. Under a common 15,000-episode budget and frozen evaluation for the RL methods, DreamQAS has the lowest mean frozen-policy energy error on four of five molecular tasks and the second-lowest on one. At fine-error targets reached by all seeds of both methods, it uses 1.6x to 2.0x fewer real VQE calls on four tasks and 10.6x fewer on BeH2-8q. Counterfactual action-ranking utility increases across all five tasks, with a mean increase of 0.346 and a 95 percent confidence interval of [0.185, 0.507], while direct greedy and beam use of the same model does not recover the gains of imagined policy learning. Ensemble disagreement also improves risk-coverage over random rejection on all three probed tasks. These results establish a world-model design for QAS whose value lies in decision-useful feedback rather than exact energy prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: DreamQAS 是一种基于模型的强化学习量子架构搜索框架，保留已知且确定的量子线路构造与动作合法性，仅学习昂贵的 VQE 后反馈。该方法使用带随机先验的循环集成模型预测相对于经验能量前沿的无 oracle 评分，并在显式合法线路上进行多步想象式策略学习。通过排序激活、不确定性感知的悲观估计与截断，以及选择性真实 VQE 验证，DreamQAS 在多个分子任务中降低冻结策略能量误差，并显著减少真实 VQE 调用次数。
authors: Jiayang Niu, Yan Wang, Jie Li, Ke Deng, Azadeh Alavi, Muhammad Usman, Yongli Ren

articles.title: The Grokked Illusion: True Equilibrium Mitigates Catastrophic Forgetting
articles.title_zh: 被“顿悟”掩盖的幻象：真实平衡缓解灾难性遗忘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While neural networks are typically evaluated by their training and test performance, these metrics do not reveal how robust a learned representation is. Recent studies have shown that solutions occupying larger volumes in parameter space, as quantified by Boltzmann entropy, often exhibit superior generalizability compared to those reached by conventional optimization, a phenomenon known as the high entropy advantage. Here we ask whether this advantage persists beyond generalization. Specifically, we investigate models' robustness, the ability to retain the learned knowledge when the model is subsequently trained to acquire new information. Using grokking in modular arithmetic as a controlled setting, we design a noise injection experiment to evaluate the robustness difference between AdamW-trained transformers and high-entropy model sampled from Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics with identical saturated performance. By forcing both models to fully remember new data with random labels, we find that AdamW-trained models suffer from catastrophic forgetting, with original task test accuracy dropping from 100% to below 75%, whereas the high-entropy models maintain approximately 95% test accuracy. We term this hidden fragility behind apparent generalization the "grokked illusion." Through singular value decomposition of the neural network weights, we discover that high-entropy neural networks possess significantly higher effective rank in attention and MLP layers both before and after noise injection, indicating richer feature representations can serve as a buffer against catastrophic forgetting. Our findings demonstrate that perfect generalization does not imply equal robustness, offering a new perspective on what makes a trained model robust to interference.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注高熵参数空间解除泛化优势外是否也更具鲁棒性，即在后续学习新信息时保持原有知识的能力。作者以模运算 grokking 为受控场景，比较 AdamW 训练的 Transformer 与通过 Wang–Landau 分子动力学采样得到的高熵模型，两者初始任务性能均已饱和。噪声注入实验表明，在强制记忆随机标签新数据后，AdamW 模型出现灾难性遗忘，而高熵模型对原任务的保持能力更强。
authors: Xiaotian Zhang, Lai Shun Chan, Yue Shang, Entao Yang, Ge Zhang

articles.title: ThinkReset: Learnable Intermediate Interface Construction for Bounded-Context Long-Horizon Reasoning
articles.title_zh: ThinkReset：面向有界上下文长程推理的可学习中间接口构建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28642v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves performance on complex problems, but it also introduces redundancy accumulation, context overflow, and error anchoring. We argue that under bounded context windows, the core bottleneck is not trajectory compression or test-time control, but the absence of a reusable intermediate interface that can replace discarded history and support continued solving. We further identify a key failure mode of outcome-reward-driven long-chain reinforcement learning: when the model has not solved the task before the window is nearly exhausted, the final-answer reward encourages premature guessing rather than continued careful reasoning. We propose ThinkReset, a text-space instantiation of this view. ThinkReset explicitly constructs reusable intermediate interfaces through interface writeback and reset, and directly optimizes post-reset continuation success. Across multiple long-horizon reasoning benchmarks, this perspective consistently improves success rates under fixed context windows.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，在固定上下文窗口下，长链式思维推理的关键瓶颈不是轨迹压缩或测试时控制，而是缺少可替代被丢弃历史、支持继续求解的可复用中间接口。作者还指出，基于最终答案奖励的长链强化学习在上下文即将耗尽且尚未解题时，容易鼓励过早猜测。ThinkReset 通过接口写回与重置显式构建文本空间中的中间接口，并直接优化重置后的继续求解成功率，在多个长程推理基准上提升固定上下文条件下的成功率。
authors: Fei Ding, Yongkang Zhang, Runhao Liu, Yuhao Liao, Zijian Zeng

articles.title: Conditioning Tree-Based Diffusions and Flows for Probabilistic Tabular Regression
articles.title_zh: 用于概率表格回归的树模型扩散与流条件化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28864v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tree-based diffusion models fit flexible conditional predictive distributions for tabular regression without a neural density estimator, but they inherit their design defaults---noising path, parameterization, training distribution, features, sampler---from the neural setting. We show these defaults are the binding constraint: what a gradient-boosted ensemble actually solves is a supervised regression problem whose conditioning they determine. We present DiffGBM, which makes them explicit along two axes. First, a Gaussian-path flow-matching trainer for p(y mid x) that learns a velocity field directly and recovers the score algebraically, admitting few-step deterministic ODE sampling. Second, we expose the score-side recipe---residualization, EDM-style preconditioning, log-sigma time sampling, noise-level features, loss weighting, and histogram resolution---as jointly tunable axes over a shared LightGBM surface rather than one frozen bundle. This emphscore-flex space represents the published recipe as a special case; across eleven tabular benchmarks under fold-0 tuning, folds-1--5 evaluation, and a matched 40-trial budget and sampler, the selected configurations beat that baseline on emphevery dataset (paired Wilcoxon 11/0, p<10⁻³), with the best aggregate CRPS skill (0.725 vs. 0.699) of any row. The two rows are complementary: score-flex buys accuracy with a stochastic sampler and is the slowest row, while flow matching is the cheapest sampler (5.2× faster than the published baseline) and the best-calibrated DiffGBM row. Tuned non-diffusion baselines still win individual datasets, and stochastic (ǎrepsilon>0) flow samplers do not Pareto-dominate the deterministic corner.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作分析树基扩散模型在表格回归中继承自神经网络扩散设定的默认设计，包括加噪路径、参数化、训练分布、特征和采样器，并指出这些默认项限制了梯度提升模型实际求解的监督回归问题。作者提出 DiffGBM：一方面用 Gaussian 路径流匹配直接学习条件分布 p(y|x) 的速度场，并可通过少步确定性 ODE 采样；另一方面将残差化、EDM 式预条件、log-sigma 时间采样、噪声层级特征、损失加权和直方图分辨率等 score 侧设计作为可调维度。该框架在共享 LightGBM 表面上统一并扩展已有方法，原有配方成为其特例。

articles.title: Transpiler Autotuning with Predictive Models for Quantum Circuit Optimization
articles.title_zh: 基于预测模型的量子线路优化转译器自动调参
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29145v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum software engineering is an emerging research field focusing on efficiently embedding the quantum programming paradigm into existing software ecosystems. A key aspect of this field is the realization of quantum algorithms using gate-based programming and the subsequent low-level optimization of the resulting quantum circuits, a process that is commonly performed by so-called transpilation pipelines. One significant challenge in these pipelines is determining which optimizations to apply to a given circuit. This decision is usually based on fixed default configurations that are uniformly applied to all circuits, frequently resulting in missed opportunities for more aggressive circuit optimization. In this work, we tackle this challenge by applying autotuning with supervised machine learning to develop an automated method for selection of transpiler passes. To train our machine-learning models, we employ feature-model based sampling to generate a representative dataset that examines how different combinations of Qiskit transpiler passes perform across thousands of circuits drawn from the state-of-the-art benchmarking suite MQT Bench. Using these data, we build a predictive model extension for the Qiskit transpilation pipeline that uses a machine learning model to automatically select combinations of transpiler passes aiming to achieve a maximum reduction in two-qubit gates. Our empirical evaluation shows that the combinations selected by our model are never outperformed by Qiskit's optimization levels, achieve on average an additional 19.1% - 32.4% reduction in two-qubit gates, and for some circuits finds reductions of up to 95.8% in cases where Qiskit achieves no reduction at all.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向量子软件工程中的量子线路转译优化问题，关注如何为给定线路自动选择合适的 Qiskit transpiler pass，而不是使用统一默认配置。作者采用监督式机器学习进行自动调参，并通过基于特征模型的采样生成训练数据，覆盖大量基准量子线路上不同 pass 组合的优化效果。该方法旨在预测并选择更合适的转译流程，以挖掘默认配置可能错失的线路优化机会。
authors: Piotr Malkowski, Domenik Eichhorn, Joshua Ammermann, Rinor Kelmendi, Nick Poser, Patrick Hopf, Ina Schaefer

articles.title: RTLCurator: Label-Efficient Data Curation for RTL Generation
articles.title_zh: RTLCurator：面向 RTL 生成的标签高效数据筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29283v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) to write register-transfer level (RTL) requires large corpora of paired specifications and code, and such data is scarce enough that most public corpora are now synthesized. Synthesis provides scale but not correctness, and in two widely used RTL datasets only 24.4% and 53.5% of pairs pass generated functional tests. This raises the question of how much of such a corpus to keep and which part of it. Correctness alone is a poor answer. A pair that misbehaves in one corner case still shows valid syntax and interface conventions, and complex sequential designs are both harder to generate and harder to validate, so filtering by correctness leaves a corpus of short and simple modules. Correctness is also hard to obtain, since behavior leaves little trace on the surface in RTL, and validating an entire corpus only sorts pairs into passed and failed. We present RTLCurator, which learns a behavior-aware compatibility prior by contrasting each specification with implementations that fail simulation, and calibrates it to a new corpus using a small number of validated pairs. It then constructs the retained subset by balancing alignment, representation coverage, and RTL structural richness. On CodeV and RTLCoder, keeping 80% of the corpus this way improves on training with the full corpus across all reported metrics while validating only 10% of the pool, whereas ranking by the score alone falls below random selection and filtering the whole pool by simulation does no better.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究大语言模型生成寄存器传输级（RTL）代码所需的规格–代码配对语料筛选问题，指出合成数据规模大但正确性不足，且仅按功能测试通过与否过滤会偏向短小简单模块。RTLCurator 通过对比规格与仿真失败实现，学习行为感知的兼容性先验，并用少量已验证样本将其校准到新语料。该方法旨在以标签高效方式构建保留数据集，在避免保留大量错误样本的同时，不简单丢弃包含有用语法、接口和复杂设计信息的样本。
authors: Siyang Cai, Cangyuan Li, Wenjing Chang, Kun Wang, Haoyu Gao, Yinhe Han, Ying Wang

articles.title: Reinforced sequential Monte Carlo for amortised sampling
articles.title_zh: 用于摊销采样的强化序贯蒙特卡罗方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.11711v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper proposes a synergy of amortised and particle-based methods for sampling from distributions defined by unnormalised density functions. We state a connection between sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) and neural sequential samplers trained by maximum-entropy reinforcement learning (MaxEnt RL), wherein learnt sampling policies and value functions define proposal kernels and twist functions. Exploiting this connection, we introduce an off-policy RL training procedure for the sampler that uses samples from SMC -- using the learnt sampler as a proposal -- as a behaviour policy that better explores the target distribution. We describe techniques for stable joint training of proposals and twist functions and an adaptive weight tempering scheme to reduce training signal variance. Furthermore, building upon past attempts to use experience replay to guide the training of neural samplers, we derive a way to combine historical samples with annealed importance sampling weights within a replay buffer. On synthetic multi-modal targets (in both continuous and discrete spaces) and the Boltzmann distribution of alanine dipeptide conformations, we demonstrate improvements in approximating the true distribution as well as training stability compared to both amortised and Monte Carlo methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种结合摊销神经采样器与粒子方法的框架，用于从未归一化密度定义的目标分布中采样。作者建立了序贯蒙特卡罗（SMC）与最大熵强化学习训练的神经序贯采样器之间的联系，其中学习到的策略和值函数分别对应提议核与twist函数。在此基础上，文章设计了利用SMC样本进行离策略训练、联合稳定训练提议与twist函数、自适应权重退火以及带退火重要性权重的经验回放机制，并在多模态合成目标和丙氨酸二肽玻尔兹曼构象分布上进行验证。
authors: Sanghyeok Choi, Sarthak Mittal, Víctor Elvira, Jinkyoo Park, Esmeralda S. Whitammer

articles.title: A Novel XAI-Enhanced Quantum Adversarial Networks for Velocity Dispersion Modeling in MaNGA Galaxies
articles.title_zh: 用于MaNGA星系速度弥散建模的可解释AI增强量子对抗网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.24598v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Current quantum machine learning approaches often face challenges balancing predictive accuracy, robustness, and interpretability. To address this, we propose a novel quantum adversarial framework that integrates a hybrid quantum neural network (QNN) with classical deep learning layers, guided by an evaluator model with LIME-based interpretability, and extended through quantum GAN and self-supervised variants. In the proposed model, an adversarial evaluator concurrently guides the QNN by computing feedback loss, thereby optimizing both prediction accuracy and model explainability. Empirical evaluations show that the Vanilla model achieves RMSE = 0.27, MSE = 0.071, MAE = 0.21, and R² = 0.59, delivering the most consistent performance across regression metrics compared to adversarial counterparts. These results demonstrate the potential of combining quantum-inspired methods with classical architectures to develop lightweight, high-performance, and interpretable predictive models, advancing the applicability of QML beyond current limitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种量子对抗学习框架，将混合量子神经网络与经典深度学习层结合，并引入基于LIME解释性的评估器模型，同时扩展到量子GAN和自监督变体。对抗评估器通过反馈损失同步引导QNN训练，以同时提升预测性能和可解释性。在MaNGA星系速度弥散回归任务中，Vanilla模型取得RMSE=0.27、MSE=0.071、MAE=0.21、R²=0.59，表现较对抗变体更稳定，表明量子启发模型与经典架构结合可用于轻量、可解释的预测建模。
authors: Sathwik Narkedimilli, N V Saran Kumar, Aswath Babu H, Manjunath K Vanahalli, Manish M, Aik Beng Ng, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha

articles.title: From Physics to Surrogate Intelligence: A Unified Electro-Thermo-Optimization Framework for TSV Networks
articles.title_zh: 从物理建模到代理智能：面向TSV网络的统一电-热-优化框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.29268v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-density through-substrate vias (TSVs) enable 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration but introduce significant signal-integrity and thermal-reliability challenges due to electrical coupling, insertion loss, and self-heating. Conventional full-wave finite-element method (FEM) simulations provide high accuracy but become computationally prohibitive for large design-space exploration. This work presents a scalable electro--thermal modeling and optimization framework that combines physics-informed analytical modeling, graph neural network (GNN) surrogates, and full-wave sign-off validation. A multi-conductor analytical model computes broadband S-parameters and effective anisotropic thermal conductivities of TSV arrays, achieving 5%--10% relative Frobenius error (RFE) across array sizes up to 15×15. A physics-informed GNN surrogate (TSV-PhGNN), trained on analytical data and fine-tuned with HFSS simulations, generalizes to larger arrays with mean RFE below 5% in-distribution. The surrogate is integrated into a multi-objective Pareto optimization framework targeting reflection coefficient, insertion loss, worst-case crosstalk (NEXT/FEXT), and effective thermal conductivity. Millions of TSV configurations can be explored within minutes, enabling exhaustive layout and geometric optimization that would be infeasible using FEM alone. Final designs are validated with Ansys HFSS and Mechanical, showing strong agreement. The proposed framework enables rapid electro--thermal co-design of TSV arrays while reducing per-design evaluation time by more than six orders of magnitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向高密度穿衬底通孔（TSV）阵列的信号完整性与热可靠性问题，提出结合物理启发解析模型、图神经网络代理模型和全波仿真签核验证的可扩展电-热建模优化框架。多导体解析模型可计算宽带S参数和等效各向异性热导率，在最高15×15阵列上达到约5%–10%的相对Frobenius误差。物理启发GNN代理模型TSV-PhGNN经解析数据训练并用HFSS微调后，在分布内平均误差低于5%，并被嵌入多目标Pareto优化以权衡反射、插入损耗和串扰等指标。
authors: Mohamed Gharib, Leonid Popryho, Inna Partin-Vaisband

articles.title: A Fully Convolutional Approach to Denoising 2D Correlation Spectra
articles.title_zh: 二维相关谱去噪的全卷积方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29975v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a fully convolutional denoising autoencoder (FC-DAE) tailored for two-dimensional representations of dynamic correlations that is applicable to many experimental techniques. Here, we demonstrate its performance on two-time intensity correlation functions (C₂₎ from X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS). Unlike conventional denoising autoencoders that are typically restricted to fixed input sizes, the FC-DAE accepts inputs of arbitrary dimensions while preserving correlation structures across diverse dynamical regimes. The model is trained using experimentally derived C₂ data collected at NSLS-II beamlines, with data augmentation applied to expand the diversity of the dataset and reduce overfitting. The FC-DAE successfully recovers intricate dynamical features in low signal-to-noise conditions while maintaining structural fidelity. To assess reconstruction reliability, we employ quantitative metrics to evaluate structural fidelity and identify potential model-induced bias. Our results demonstrate that the FC-DAE provides robust denoising performance with high computational efficiency, enabling recovery of XPCS dynamics under photon-limited and low-dose measurement conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向二维动态相关表示的全卷积去噪自编码器（FC-DAE），并以X射线光子相关谱（XPCS）的双时间强度相关函数C₂为示例展示其性能。与固定输入尺寸的传统去噪自编码器不同，FC-DAE可处理任意尺寸输入，并在不同动力学区域中保持相关结构。模型基于NSLS-II实验数据训练并通过数据增强降低过拟合，能够在低信噪比条件下恢复精细动力学特征，同时通过定量指标评估结构保真度和潜在模型偏差。
authors: Nisar Nellikunnummel, Andi M Barbour, Lutz Wiegart, Tatiana Konstantinova, Anthony M DeGennaro

articles.title: Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network for Polymer Classification Using Terahertz Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 基于太赫兹光谱的聚合物分类多尺度特征注意力网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06554v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable polymer identification is essential for ensuring the quality and safety of recycled plastics, yet conventional sorting and spectroscopic techniques often struggle to deliver robust discrimination. Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy offers a promising alternative, providing high-resolution and non-destructive measurements. In this work, we leverage THz signals to classify 12 types of polymers, including pure polymers, multilayer films, commercial blends, and biopolymers. To handle the complexity of these spectral signals, we propose the Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network (MSFAN), a novel deep learning architecture tailored for THz data. The framework integrates feature gating for signal recalibration and multi-scale parallel convolutions to capture diverse frequency patterns. These features are further refined through cross-feature attention and attention pooling, enabling the model to intrinsically highlight the most informative THz regions. MSFAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, reaching a classification accuracy of 85.2%. This study demonstrates the potential of combining THz spectroscopy with deep learning techniques for effective, scalable, and interpretable polymer classification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用太赫兹光谱对12类聚合物进行分类，涵盖纯聚合物、多层薄膜、商业共混物和生物聚合物，目标是提升回收塑料质量与安全检测中的材料识别可靠性。作者提出多尺度特征注意力网络（MSFAN），通过特征门控、多尺度并行卷积、跨特征注意力和注意力池化来捕获并突出关键信号频段。实验显示MSFAN优于已有模型，分类准确率达到85.2%，说明太赫兹光谱结合深度学习具有用于复杂聚合物无损识别的潜力。
authors: Roshni Mahtani, Ilán Carretero, Daniel Moreno-Paris, Aldo Moreno-Oyervides, Laura Monroy, Oscar Elías Bonilla-Manrique, Rocío del Amor

articles.title: Multi-Agent Planning with Spatio-Temporal and Topological Constraints using STL-GO
articles.title_zh: 使用STL-GO处理时空与拓扑约束的多智能体规划
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent planning problems arise in a variety of engineering applications, such as multi-robot wildfire fighting and unmanned aerial inspection in factories. A particular challenge is the existence of spatio-temporal (i.e., when and/or where an agent should do what) and topological constraints (i.e., how agents should interact), as typically formalized via the notion of graphs. Over the last years, various frameworks have been proposed that can capture such constraints via spatio-temporal logics. We focus here on spatio-temporal logic with graph operators (STL-GO), a recent formalism that supports reasoning about multiple agents and their topologies, such as sensing, communication, and task topologies. In this paper, we consider the problem of planning multi-agent paths that satisfy constraints written in STL-GO. This problem is particularly challenging due to the need of encoding multiple, potentially time-varying graphs via the graph operators inherent to STL-GO. We present two encodings of this problem, one based on mixed-integer programming (MIP) and another based on satisfiability modulo theory (SMT), with soundness guarantees. We provide a unified interface for specifying agent constraints, their graph topologies, and the STL-GO specification, enabling seamless use of both methods and facilitating direct comparison between them. We evaluate both encodings on a multi-UAV search-and-rescue benchmark, ablating over team size and graph complexity, highlighting the expressiveness of the proposed encodings under dynamic multi- graph interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究满足时空逻辑与图算子（STL-GO）约束的多智能体路径规划问题，适用于多机器人灭火、无人机巡检等场景。STL-GO能够同时表达智能体何时何地执行任务以及感知、通信、任务等拓扑关系，但也带来对多个可能随时间变化图结构进行编码的困难。作者提出两种规划问题编码方式：一种基于混合整数规划（MIP），另一种基于可满足性模理论（SMT），并给出可靠性保证。
authors: Sheryl Paul, Vidisha Kudalkar, Anand Balakrishnan, Lars Lindemann, Alberto Speranzon, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh

articles.title: A user's guide to PINNs in geometric analysis: lessons from the asymptotic Plateau problem
articles.title_zh: 几何分析中PINN使用指南：来自渐近Plateau问题的经验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28733v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This proceedings contribution elaborates on the findings of arXiv:2605.26234v2: a joint work with Marco Usula, where we introduced a machine learning framework based on physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), aimed at constructing near-minimal discs in hyperbolic space asymptotic to a prescribed knot at infinity. We used this method to provide numerical evidence for a conjecture of Joel Fine relating minimal surfaces in H⁴ to the coefficients of the HOMFLY polynomial. This is a methodological companion to that paper, based on a presentation given at the 2026 edition of the workshop "DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry". Rather than reviewing the results, which are presented extensively in the preprint above, we discuss the two aspects of the framework which, in our experience, determined whether the method worked at all. First, the geometry of the problem must be encoded in the architecture of the model, so that the boundary condition and asymptotics at infinity hold exactly for every value of the learnable parameters - leaving us with a single-component loss function; second, the evaluation of the PDE residual must be engineered with care to ensure that complete trainings can be performed in a reasonable time. On the latter point, we describe two implementation techniques which are not spelled out in detail in the original paper: replacing nested reverse-mode automatic differentiation with the forward propagation of second-order jets, and compiling the computational graph of the residual once instead of rebuilding it at every optimisation step. Together, on identical hardware, these two changes reduce the cost of a training step by a factor of roughly forty to fifty. We hope these methodological discussions can be useful for researchers in differential geometry and geometric analysis who wish to deploy PINNs on problems of their own.
articles.abstract_zh: 该会议论文是对作者与Marco Usula关于物理信息神经网络（PINN）构造双曲空间中以无穷远给定纽结为渐近边界的近极小圆盘工作的补充说明。文章不侧重复述数值结果，而总结决定方法是否有效的两个关键技术因素：必须将问题几何直接编码进网络结构，使边界条件和无穷远渐近性质对所有可训练参数精确成立；同时，PDE残差的计算需要专门工程化设计。该工作为PINN在几何分析和渐近Plateau问题中的可靠使用提供方法论经验。

articles.title: InferQ: A Database-Oriented Benchmark for Quantum Circuits Simulation
articles.title_zh: InferQ：面向数据库的量子线路模拟基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29134v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work suggests that relational database management systems (RDBMSs) can execute quantum circuit simulation by compiling the simulation into SQL workloads (primarily join-and-aggregate tensor contractions). While early results are promising, they largely focus on a narrow set of highly structured circuits and offer limited support for systematic database research, such as query optimization, physical design, and engine-level evaluation across a broad range of circuits. We present InferQ, a database-oriented benchmark for quantum circuit simulation. InferQ generates general, compositional circuits by assembling subcircuits from a set of circuit templates, emits each simulation task as an RDBMS-ready SQL workload, and extracts circuit and query features (static, graph, SQL, and dynamic) for workload characterization. InferQ also releases a large dataset of 202,975 circuits online, with a web-based viewer to support searching, filtering, and downloading circuits and feature records. In experiments across RDBMS engines (PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, and Umbra) and the widely used Qiskit Aer simulator, we find that RDBMSs achieve better peak memory usage than Qiskit Aer on more than 50% of the circuits generated by InferQ. Moreover, using InferQ features, lightweight machine learning models (linear and tree-based models) can accurately predict when SQL execution is preferable (with accuracy up to 95.3% for runtime and 97.4% for memory), enabling data-centric simulator selection and opening the door to principled optimization of SQL-based quantum circuit simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出InferQ，一个用于研究关系数据库管理系统执行量子线路模拟的基准框架。InferQ通过组合线路模板生成一般性可组合量子线路，将模拟任务转换为可直接在RDBMS中运行的SQL工作负载，并提取静态、图、SQL和动态等多类特征用于工作负载表征。作者发布了包含202,975条线路的大规模数据集及网页查看工具，并在PostgreSQL、SQLite、DuckDB、Umbra和Qiskit Aer上进行实验，以支持数据库优化、物理设计和引擎级评估。
authors: Andrei Ilinescu, Aadi Patwardhan, Rihan Hai

articles.title: A Multi-Agent System for Motor Design Optimization via an FEA-AI Hybrid Approach
articles.title_zh: 基于FEA-AI混合方法的电机设计优化多智能体系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09037v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This study presents a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) design optimization that mitigates limitations of conventional workflows: expertise-dependent problem setup and data preparation, the prohibitive computational cost of finite element analysis (FEA), and the unreliability of AI surrogates in unexplored regions. To this end, we first introduce a Design agent that formulates the optimization problem in natural language, leveraging retrieval-augmented generation to improve answer accuracy on motor design problems from below 50% to 67-80%. Furthermore, a Training agent autonomously repairs improperly defined design spaces by reasoning over solver failure history, raising the success ratio of the geometry sampling from 28% to 84% for AI training. Additionally, to resolve cost and reliability simultaneously, an Optimization agent employs an uncertainty-aware FEA-AI hybrid model: the AI surrogate is the primary evaluator, and FEA is selectively invoked where predictive uncertainty is high. Under the same FEA budget, this hybrid model achieves up to 44% lower iron loss in single-objective and 22.5% higher hypervolume in multi-objective optimization than conventional FEA-only search. Under the same evaluation budget, it reduces computation time by 52-55% while retaining 90-92% of FEA-only hypervolume. Conversely, AI-only search converges to false optima, leaving half its Pareto designs infeasible. Notably, a controller agent adaptively updates the uncertainty threshold that triggers FEA each round, eliminating manual tuning and achieving 5.8% lower single objective iron loss than with a fixed threshold. These results establish domain specialized LLM agents with uncertainty-aware hybrid evaluation as a reliable, scalable paradigm for simulation-driven design automation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，用于内置式永磁同步电机（IPMSM）设计优化，以缓解传统流程中过度依赖专家、有限元分析成本高和AI代理模型在未知区域不可靠的问题。Design智能体通过检索增强生成以自然语言构建设计优化问题，使电机设计问答准确率从低于50%提升至67%–80%；Training智能体根据求解器失败历史自主修复设计空间，将几何采样成功率从28%提高到84%。Optimization智能体采用不确定性感知的FEA-AI混合模型，以AI代理为主评估器，并在预测不确定性高时选择性调用FEA，在相同FEA预算下取得更优优化效果。
authors: Jinseong Han, Sunwoong Yang, Namwoo Kang

articles.title: Pay for The Second-Best Service: A Game-Theoretic Approach Against Dishonest LLM Providers
articles.title_zh: 为次优服务付费：应对不诚实LLM服务商的博弈论方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.00847v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) through Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) induces a critical vulnerability: the potential for dishonest manipulation by service providers. This manipulation can manifest in various forms, such as secretly substituting a proclaimed high-performance model with a low-cost alternative, or inflating responses with meaningless tokens to increase billing. This work tackles the issue through the lens of algorithmic game theory and mechanism design. We are the first to propose a formal economic model for a realistic user-provider ecosystem, where a user can iteratively delegate T queries to multiple model providers, and providers can engage in a range of strategic behaviors. As our central contribution, we prove that for a continuous strategy space and any ϵin(0,frac12), there exists an approximate incentive-compatible mechanism with an additive approximation ratio of O(T¹⁻ϵłog T), and a guaranteed quasi-linear second-best user utility. We also prove an impossibility result, stating that no mechanism can guarantee an expected user utility that is asymptotically better than our mechanism. Furthermore, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our mechanism in simulation experiments with real-world API settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从算法博弈论和机制设计角度研究通过API使用大语言模型时的服务商不诚实行为，例如暗中用低成本模型替代高性能模型或注入无意义token以增加收费。作者建立了用户可在T次查询中迭代委托多个模型服务商、且服务商可采取策略性行为的形式化经济模型。核心结果表明，在连续策略空间下，对任意ϵ∈(0,1/2)，存在近似激励相容机制，具有O(T¹⁻ϵlog T)的加性近似比，并保证用户获得准线性的次优效用；同时给出不可能性结果，说明不存在可渐近保证显著更高期望用户效用的机制。
authors: Yuhan Cao, Yu Wang, Sitong Liu, Miao Li, Yixin Tao, Tianxing He

articles.title: Knowledge Restoration-driven Prompt Optimization: Unlocking LLM Potential for Open-Domain Relational Triplet Extraction
articles.title_zh: 知识恢复驱动的提示优化：释放大语言模型在开放域关系三元组抽取中的潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.15037v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Open-domain Relational Triplet Extraction (ORTE) aims to mine structured knowledge without predefined relation schemas. Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced ORTE toward a prompt-driven paradigm through powerful in-context learning. However, adapting their extraction behavior to varying open-domain contexts remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on manually crafted prompts that remain fixed across inputs, despite substantial variation in linguistic expressions and contextual structures. This mismatch may lead to unsupported triplets, while the absence of ground-truth annotations makes such deficiencies difficult to identify and correct. Moreover, free-form relation generation produces non-canonical relation surface forms, undermining knowledge graph consistency. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge Restoration-driven Prompt Optimization (KRPO), a framework for label-free target-corpus adaptation. KRPO restores extracted triplets into textual statements and evaluates their semantic consistency with the source inputs, deriving intrinsic feedback without gold annotations. This feedback is transformed into natural-language optimization guidance for batch-wise prompt optimization and adaptation. KRPO further introduces a Memory-augmented Relation Canonicalizer that aligns free-form relations with a dynamically updated schema memory, improving relation consistency. Experiments on three ORTE benchmarks with multiple LLM backbones demonstrate strong overall performance, with KRPO achieving the best average F1 score across the evaluated settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向开放域关系三元组抽取（ORTE），研究如何在没有预定义关系模式和标注数据的条件下，使大语言模型更好适配目标语料。作者指出固定人工提示难以适应不同输入的语言表达和上下文结构，可能产生文本不支持的三元组；同时自由形式关系生成会造成关系表面形式不规范，影响知识图谱一致性。为此提出知识恢复驱动的提示优化（KRPO）框架，将抽取出的三元组还原为文本陈述并与源输入进行语义一致性评估，从而在无金标注条件下生成内在反馈以优化提示。
authors: Xiaonan Jing, Gongqing Wu, Xingrui Zhuo, Lang Sun, Jiapu Wang

articles.title: Nutritional Yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) Spent Powder as a Clean-Label Emulsion Stabilizer: Linking pH-Dependent Interfacial Behavior, Bulk Rheology, and Emulsion Stability
articles.title_zh: 营养酵母废粉作为清洁标签乳液稳定剂：关联pH依赖的界面行为、体相流变与乳液稳定性
articles.abstract: Nutritional yeast spent powder (NYSP), a by-product of Saccharomyces cerevisiae processing, is rich in proteins, (:β:)-glucans, and mannoproteins, making it a promising clean-label stabilizer for food emulsions. This study evaluates NYSP as a stabilizer for oil-in-water emulsions and clarifies how pH controls interfacial and bulk stabilization. Emulsions (25% corn oil, 16.67% NYSP, and 58.33% water w/w) were prepared at pH 3.0, 5.7, 7.0, and 9.0. As pH increased, the zeta potential shifted from positive to negative values ((:+6.11±:0.26) to (:-26.23±:0.53:mV)), while the particle size was reduced from (:881.80±:31.03) to (:343.73±:23.27:nm). The surface tension peaked at pH 5.7 ((:γ:LV=38.43:mN/m)) and minimized at pH 9.0 ((:31.29:mN/m)). Bulk rheology shifted from shear-thinning behavior: (:K) decreased from (:0.0541) to (:0.0194:Paḑot:s^{}), and (:η:₅₀) decreased from (:0.034) to (:0.022:Paḑot:s) (pH 3 to 9). Frequency sweeps revealed weak-gel behavior ((:Gprime:prime:>Gprime:)) across all pH levels, alongside markedly reduced viscoelasticity at pH 9.0. Similarly, interfacial rheology indicated predominantly viscous interfaces ((:Gᵢprime:<Gᵢprime:prime:)) under strongly acidic and alkaline conditions, whereas elastic interfacial behavior ((:Gᵢprime:>Gᵢprime:prime:)) was observed at pH 5.7. Furthermore, maximum interface elasticity (lowest (:η:ᵢ*)) was achieved at pH 5.7. Long-term emulsion stability was maximal at acidic pH, where NYSP formed a weak, space-spanning gel network that increased bulk viscoelasticity and effectively suppressed coalescence, despite the higher interfacial tension. At pH 7.0–9.0, phase separation occurred due to diminished continuous-phase structuring, regardless of the higher surface charge. Overall, NYSP stands out as a promising, upcycled stabilizer that synergizes interfacial adsorption with continuous-phase structuring to yield pH-tunable (pH 3.0–6.0) emulsions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察富含蛋白质、β-葡聚糖和甘露蛋白的酿酒酵母营养酵母废粉作为水包油乳液清洁标签稳定剂的潜力，并解析pH对界面和体相稳定机制的调控。随着pH由3.0升至9.0，ζ电位由正转负，粒径显著降低，表面张力在pH 9.0最低，体相黏度和黏弹性也减弱。结果表明，pH改变了颗粒分散、界面吸附和弱凝胶特征，从而影响乳液稳定性。

articles.title: Full-Field State Estimation from Sparse Point Sensors via Adaptive Data-Driven Modeling and Sequential Data Assimilation for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
articles.title_zh: 面向非线性动力系统的稀疏点传感器全场状态估计：自适应数据驱动建模与序贯数据同化
articles.abstract: Modern engineering and scientific systems are increasingly instrumented with point sensors that deliver rich, time-resolved measurements — yet dense spatial coverage remains physically and economically infeasible in most deployments. Recovering full-field system states from sparse point observations is therefore a fundamental challenge, compounded by the continued reliance on physics-based models that are hamstrung by simplifying assumptions, incomplete process representation, and uncertain parameter identification. This study presents a fully data-driven framework that bypasses first-principles modeling entirely, learning system dynamics directly from sparse, noisy point-sensor data. Compressed sensing reconstructs full-field system snapshots from sparse observations, which are then used to identify a reduced-order Dynamic Mode Decomposition with control (DMDc) model — with no governing equations assumed or required. The model is adaptive: as the underlying process evolves, DMDc is continuously recalibrated and process uncertainty updated via DCC-GARCH, preventing model drift. Sequential data assimilation via reduced-order Kalman filtering then fuses incoming sparse sensor observations with the adaptive model to deliver accurate full-field state estimates online. The framework is evaluated on three highdimensional datasets: a nonlinear heat equation, a forced Burgers equation, and the NOAA SST dataset. Using only 0.5% fixed spatial sensors during online assimilation, the method maintains stable full-field estimation even under highly noisy measurements at 5 dB SNR, with RMSEs of 3.08, 0.058, and 2.46 for the heat, Burgers, and NOAA SST cases, respectively. As measurement quality improves to 20 dB, the corresponding RMSEs decrease to 1.48, 0.032, and 0.66. In all cases, the total relative error remains below 5% over the unseen estimation horizon, demonstrating that the proposed adaptive data-driven assimilation framework can provide accurate full-field state estimates from very sparse and noisy measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种完全数据驱动的框架，用于从稀疏且含噪的点传感器观测恢复非线性动力系统的全场状态，避免依赖一阶原理方程。方法先用压缩感知重构全场快照，再识别降阶DMDc模型，并通过DCC-GARCH更新过程不确定性以抑制模型漂移。随后采用降阶卡尔曼滤波进行序贯数据同化，将持续到来的稀疏观测与模型预测融合。

articles.title: Spatially honest validation of machine-learning prospectivity maps for karst bauxite in Kazakhstan
articles.title_zh: 哈萨克斯坦岩溶铝土矿机器学习成矿远景图的空间诚实验证
articles.abstract: Machine-learning prospectivity maps often report near-perfect apparent discrimination, but such estimates may not survive validation designs that reflect deployment in spatially clustered mineral systems. We map karst-bauxite prospectivity across covered terrain in Kazakhstan using freely available Sentinel-2 surface reflectance, nine spectral indices and three terrain derivatives, while withholding absolute coordinates for sensitive inventory protection. Instead of reporting a single cross-validation score, we evaluate the model through a graded validation ladder: random k-fold cross-validation, spatial-block cross-validation, k-fold nearest-neighbour distance matching and leave-one-deposit-cluster-out validation. For the operational random-forest model, random cross-validation gives ROC-AUC = 0.984, whereas spatial-block validation lowers performance to approximately 0.84 and the stricter prediction-oriented schemes converge to ROC-AUC approx 0.77--0.78, with performance stabilising near this honest level as block size approaches the residual autocorrelation range. Deposit-level bootstrapping gives mean held-out deposit-cluster skill of ROC-AUC = 0.72 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.64--0.80. Conformal prediction shows asymmetric uncertainty: background-like terrain is rejected reliably, whereas bauxite-like terrain remains heterogeneous across unseen deposit clusters, and an area-of-applicability mask flags 20 of 69 delineated high-score targets as extrapolative. The resulting map should therefore be interpreted as a calibrated, uncertainty-aware and applicability-screened exploration triage product, not as a probability-of-discovery surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对空间聚集矿床中机器学习成矿远景图容易出现过高表观精度的问题，利用Sentinel-2地表反射率、9个光谱指数和3个地形因子绘制哈萨克斯坦覆盖区岩溶铝土矿远景图。作者构建从随机k折、空间分块、近邻距离匹配到留一矿床簇的分级验证体系，而非仅报告单一交叉验证分数。随机森林模型在随机交叉验证中ROC-AUC达0.984，但空间分块降至约0.84，更严格的预测导向方案稳定在约0.77–0.78，矿床簇自助法平均ROC-AUC约0.72，显示空间诚实验证对实际部署评估至关重要。

articles.title: RubriQ: Rubric-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization for Constraint-Aware Quantum Circuit Synthesis
articles.title_zh: RubriQ：面向约束感知量子线路综合的评分规约引导组相对策略优化
articles.abstract: Designing circuits that are algorithmically correct, low cost under a target fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) architecture, and executable on near-term hardware remains a major bottleneck in the transition to scalable quantum computing. We introduce RubriQ, a scalable framework that formulates circuit synthesis as a large language model (LLM) code-generation task, optimized via group relative policy optimization (GRPO). Unlike conventional black-box neural critics, RubriQ employs a domain-grounded programmatic rubric as the reinforcement learning reward function, separating surface-code Clifford+T cost metrics from near-term hardware validation and unitary fidelity. To support high-throughput training, RubriQ integrates GPU-accelerated CUDA-Q simulation directly into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop and is deployed on NERSC Perlmutter using DeepSpeed ZeRO2 across multinode NVIDIA A100 clusters. On benchmark tasks, RubriQ attains a per-dataset correctness pass rate of at least 96% and a mean T-gate compression of 3.31× over correct-only circuits , significantly outperforming sparse-reward RL baselines (2.05×), converging 2–3× faster, and maintaining less than 1% near-term hardware-constraint violations. Validated on IBM and IonQ quantum processors, RubriQ establishes an automated, high-performance computing (HPC)-driven pipeline for generating surface-code-cost-aware circuits with separate near-term hardware validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出RubriQ框架，将量子线路综合表述为大语言模型代码生成任务，并用组相对策略优化进行强化学习训练。不同于黑箱神经奖励器，RubriQ采用领域化程序评分规约，将表面码Clifford+T成本、近端硬件可验证性和酉保真度分开评估。框架将CUDA-Q GPU仿真嵌入训练循环，并在NERSC Perlmutter多节点A100集群上部署；基准结果显示其正确性通过率至少96%，平均T门压缩3.31倍，优于稀疏奖励基线且收敛更快。

articles.title: Current-dependent Nutrient Removal and Microbial- Electrochemical Synergy in an Iron-carbon Enhanced Vertical Flow Constructed Wetland
articles.title_zh: 铁碳强化垂直流人工湿地中电流依赖的营养盐去除与微生物-电化学协同
articles.abstract: Constructed wetlands (CWs) frequently exhibit suboptimal nitrogen and phosphorus removal under low carbon-to-nitrogen conditions due to electron donor limitations and insufficient phosphorus retention. This study investigates a vertical flow constructed wetland (VFCW) hybridized with iron-carbon micro-electrolysis (ICME) and external electrochemical intensification (EI) to overcome these constraints. The system was operated under simulated nutrient-rich influent (COD: 250 mg/L, NH₃-N: 30 mg/L, TN: 130 mg/L, TP: 5 mg/L) across four direct current intensities (0, 10, 20, and 40 mA). Results revealed a distinct current-dependent performance threshold: moderate electrochemical stimulation (20 mA; 0.016 mA/cm²) maximized nutrient attenuation, achieving 90% COD, 92% NH₃-N, 85% TN, and 37% TP removal. Oxidation-reduction potential (ORP) decreased linearly with current, stabilizing within the optimal denitrification window (− 110 to − 150 mV) at 20 mA. However, excessive current (40 mA) depressed ORP below − 250 mV, triggering microbial stress and collapsing TN removal to 62%. High-throughput 16S rRNA sequencing demonstrated that moderate EI enriched key denitrifying phyla (Proteobacteria, Firmicutes, and Bacteroidota) and increased alpha diversity, whereas over-polarization induced community simplification and functional loss. Phosphorus removal was primarily driven by Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺ precipitation and hydrolytic adsorption. This work identifies a critical electrochemical operating window that balances redox manipulation, microbial ecology, and energy efficiency, offering a scalable pathway for advanced nutrient polishing in decentralized and tertiary treatment systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将铁碳微电解与外加电化学强化耦合到垂直流人工湿地，以改善低碳氮比条件下氮、磷去除受电子供体和磷保持限制的问题。系统在0、10、20和40 mA直流电下运行，20 mA时去除效果最佳，COD、NH₃-N、TN和TP去除率分别达到90%、92%、85%和37%。中等电流将ORP稳定在适宜反硝化区间，而40 mA导致ORP过低、微生物受胁迫并使TN去除率降至62%；16S rRNA测序显示适度电化学刺激富集反硝化相关菌群。

articles.title: Optimising nitrification inhibitors safe application to reduce nitrous oxide emissions in urine patches
articles.title_zh: 优化硝化抑制剂安全施用以降低尿斑氧化亚氮排放
articles.abstract: Reducing nitrogen (N) losses from intensively managed grazed pastures where livestock urine patches are the primary source of nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions is important for lowering environmental impacts while maintaining farm productivity. This study aimed to optimise the use of nitrification inhibitors (NI) to reduce N2O emissions from urine patches while minimising inhibitor residues in pasture and soil. Two field experiments were conducted on contrasting dairy pasture soils in New Zealand: a well-drained site at Ruakura and a poorly drained site at Massey. Simulated urine patches (2 L; 12 g N) were treated with DCD (0.8 g) or DMPP (0.3 or 0.6 g) applied in 100, 150, or 200 mL. Urine-only emissions were 19.8 ± 2.0 mg N2O-N patch− 1 at Ruakura and 162.9 ± 8.2 mg N2O-N patch− 1 at Massey. Heavy rainfall after urine application at Ruakura likely leached urine-N into the well-drained soil, resulting in very low emissions. Both inhibitors significantly reduced emissions by 33–47% at Ruakura and 36–43% at Massey. At Massey, DMPP concentration and application volume significantly influenced mitigation, whereas no clear treatment effects were detected at Ruakura due to low emissions and high variability. DCD residues in pasture at grazing were relatively high at both sites, indicating a need to reduce application rates, although this may compromise efficacy. By contrast, DMPP at 0.6 g per urine patch reduced N2O emissions by about 42.5% and left much lower residues, indicating strong potential as a safe targeted N2O mitigation option in livestock grazed pastures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在新西兰两个排水条件不同的奶牛牧场土壤上开展田间试验，评估DCD和DMPP在尿斑中的减排效果及其在牧草和土壤中的残留风险。尿液单独处理在Ruakura排放较低，而在排水较差的Massey排放显著更高；两类抑制剂均显著降低N₂O排放，Ruakura减排33%–47%，Massey减排36%–43%。在Massey，DMPP浓度和施用体积显著影响减排效果，而Ruakura因排放基线较低、降雨淋洗可能较强，处理差异不明显。

articles.title: Effect of Cutting Parameters on Machining Performance and Surface Damage Behavior of Ultrasonic Rolling-Strengthened 7075 Aluminum Alloy
articles.title_zh: 切削参数对超声滚压强化7075铝合金加工性能与表面损伤行为的影响
articles.abstract: To clarify the effects of cutting parameters on the machining performance and surface damage behavior of ultrasonic rolling-strengthened 7075-T6 aluminum alloy, cutting experiments were conducted under different ultrasonic frequencies and cutting speeds. By combining a three-component dynamometer, confocal microscopy, and finite element simulation, the cutting force response, residual stress distribution, surface roughness, and surface morphology evolution of 7075-T6 aluminum alloy during cutting were systematically investigated. The results show that, as the cutting speed increased from 800 to 1200 mm/s, the three-directional cutting forces generally increased under ultrasonic frequencies of 0, 20, and 40 kHz. At the same cutting speed, the cutting forces followed the order of 0 kHz > 20 kHz > 40 kHz. Residual stress analysis indicates that obvious compressive residual stress was formed in the surface layer of all specimens. The compressive residual stress first increased and then decreased with increasing depth, and finally tended to stabilize. The maximum compressive residual stress was mainly distributed within approximately 5–13 µm below the surface. With increasing cutting speed, the maximum compressive residual stress generally decreased, whereas the specimens treated at ultrasonic frequencies of 20 and 40 kHz exhibited higher compressive residual stress levels than those treated at 0 kHz. Surface quality analysis shows that the machined surface roughness generally decreased with increasing ultrasonic frequency, with the lowest roughness obtained at 40 kHz. When the cutting speed was 1200 mm/s, the surface roughness decreased to 0.411 µm. Moreover, under the coupled effect of high-frequency ultrasonic rolling and higher cutting speed, surface defects such as grooves, material accumulation, and local tearing were significantly reduced, and the machined surface texture became finer and more uniform.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过不同超声频率和切削速度下的切削实验，结合三向测力、共聚焦显微和有限元模拟，分析超声滚压强化7075-T6铝合金的切削力、残余应力、粗糙度和表面形貌演化。切削速度由800增至1200 mm/s时，在0、20和40 kHz下三向切削力总体增加；同一速度下切削力大小为0 kHz > 20 kHz > 40 kHz。所有试样表层均形成明显压缩残余应力，且随深度先增后降并趋于稳定，最大压应力主要位于表面下约5–13 µm。

articles.title: YOLOv11-AHFE:Adaptive High-Frequency Signal Enhancement Mechanism for Surface detection
articles.title_zh: YOLOv11-AHFE：用于表面检测的自适应高频信号增强机制
articles.abstract: Metal surface defect detection faces significant hurdles in modern intelligent manufacturing. Traditional image processing algorithms often struggle to identify complex and irregular defects, while relying solely on artificial intelligence algorithms face difficulties in achieving effective image preprocessing. This paper aims to explore an algorithm that integrates wavelet transform into deep vision to enhance detail features. Through the frequency domain decomposition of wavelet transform and attention mechanisms, high-frequency details are explicitly preserved and enhanced, making this approach particularly suitable for tasks requiring fine boundaries, such as object detection and image segmentation. The Haar wavelet achieves low computational complexity by using only integer addition and subtraction and can effectively improve model accuracy without sacrificing efficiency. The “dual-stream wavelet” is an important extension of the aforementioned Haar wavelet module, primarily reflected in two aspects: network architecture design and frequency-spatial feature fusion. While traditional wavelet modules only use Discrete Wavelet Transform Module (DWT) as a fixed preprocessing or down-sampling tool, the dual-stream wavelet significantly enhances feature representation capability through parallel architecture and learnable fusion. The Wavelet-Conv path effectively preserves details such as edges and textures by explicitly decomposing the image into LL, LH, HL, and HH sub-bands and using learnable weights to boost high-frequency components. Moreover, the standard down-sampling path learns abstract semantic features and fuses them with the former via concatenation, enabling complementary information exchange. In the dual-stream framework, the transformation from fixed wavelet bases and simple learnable weights to end-to-end adaptive fusion of two streams results in a frequency-aware, multi-receptive-field down-sampling module. Particularly, the High-Freq-Enhance module enhances high-frequency details in feature maps through residual learning. The residual connection ensures the fidelity of the original information, while the attention mechanism determines, based on global information, which channels require high-frequency enhancement. Placed in the deeper layers of the backbone, it compensates for high-frequency details attenuated by repeated down-sampling. The core insight of this architecture is that down-sampling in traditional CNNs is "discard-based", whereas wavelet-enabled down-sampling is "encoding-based" and "recoverable". Compared to standard YOLO, this approach proposes three key improvements: (1) High‑frequency information retention: Conventional down-sampling discards high‑frequency details, whereas the dual‑stream wavelet transform encodes and preserves them.(2) Multi‑path feature fusion: Standard CNNs rely solely on single‑path spatial features, while the dual‑stream design achieves effective multi‑path information integration.(3) Small‑target enhancement: After repeated down-sampling, small‑target signals are prone to being overwhelmed by noise; the proposed high‑frequency enhancement module selectively restores detailed responses to mitigate this issue.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向金属表面缺陷检测，将小波变换引入深度视觉模型，以增强复杂、不规则缺陷的细节和边界特征。方法利用Haar小波的低计算复杂度进行频域分解，并结合注意力机制显式保留和强化高频信息。提出的“双流小波”结构进一步融合频域与空间特征，旨在兼顾检测精度与推理效率，适用于目标检测和图像分割等细边界任务。

articles.title: Numerical Modelling of High-Temperature Methane Pyrolysis Under Plasma-Inspired Thermal Gradients
articles.title_zh: 等离子体启发热梯度下高温甲烷热解的数值建模
articles.abstract: Methane conversion in an atmospheric-pressure reactor environment has been numerically modelled using a thermal pyrolysis kinetic framework under extreme temperature profiles representative of microwave plasma cores and exit jet. Concentration profiles along the reactor's central axis were simulated using an expanded detailed reaction mechanism. Rather than capturing explicit electron kinetics, this work focuses on the neutral radical network and chemical mechanism reduction under aggressive thermal quenching. The model predicts a net methane conversion of 98.7%, primarily yielding hydrogen, acetylene, ethylene, and butadiene. Using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), the chemical scheme was systematically reduced to 102 irreversible steps involving 26 species. The reduced model predicts critical species concentrations within 0.1% of the complete mechanism while accelerating computation time by a factor of 61, offering a computationally efficient framework for future multi-dimensional fluid dynamics coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在大气压反应器条件下，采用热解动力学框架模拟类似微波等离子体核心及出口射流的极端温度分布中甲烷转化过程。模型重点描述中性自由基网络和强热淬火下的化学机理约简，而不显式处理电子动力学。完整模型预测甲烷净转化率为98.7%，主要产物为氢气、乙炔、乙烯和丁二烯；经PCA约简后得到含26个物种、102个不可逆反应的模型，关键物种浓度误差低于0.1%，计算加速约61倍。

articles.title: Design of An Energy Efficient Toggled MRAM Bit-Cell
articles.title_zh: 一种能效优化的翻转式MRAM位单元设计
articles.abstract: Spin-based, non-volatile memory bit-cells have been proposed for applications ranging from logic-in-memory computing to quantum computing. This paper deals with the toggle spin torque magnetic random-access memory (TST-MRAM) bit-cells by micromagnetic simulations. The concept of voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) is utilized to model and simulate the designed cells. In this paper, the TST magnetization precession is studied in a nanopillar spin-valve. The magnetization switching is considered under an external magnetic field, and it is simulated with the micromagnetic simulation (MMS) toolkit to evaluate the designed toggled MRAM bit-cell parameters. The present work utilizes different material interfaces (i.e., HM-CoFeB-NM-MgO) to minimize the switching error rates during the MRAM design process. The interfacial perpendicular magnetic anisotropy-based toggled MRAM bit-cell obtains less polarization factor, more anisotropic constant, and less saturated magnetization than classical magnetic RAM models. The factors related to the designed bit cell are explained theoretically and graphically in this work. Finally, the parameters have been evaluated for the proposed toggled MRAM bit-cell and will take part in the design process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于微磁模拟设计并评估翻转自旋转矩磁随机存储器位单元，面向逻辑存内计算和量子计算等自旋非易失存储应用。作者利用电压控制磁各向异性概念，在纳米柱自旋阀中研究TST磁化进动和外加磁场下的磁化翻转。通过采用HM-CoFeB-NM-MgO等不同材料界面，设计旨在降低开关错误率；相比传统MRAM模型，该界面垂直磁各向异性翻转式位单元表现出较低极化因子、较高各向异性常数和较低饱和磁化强度。

articles.title: An SO(3)-equivariant reciprocal space neural potential for long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 用于长程相互作用的 SO(3) 等变倒空间神经势
articles.abstract: Long-range electrostatic and polarization interactions play an essential role in molecular and condensed-phase systems but remain challenging for machine-learning interatomic potentials based on local atomic environments. Although SO(3)-equivariant neural potentials can learn rich representations of local geometry, atoms or molecular fragments separated by more than the real-space cutoff do not communicate directly. We introduce EquiEwald, a neural interatomic potential that extends Ewald summation to operate directly on SO(3)-equivariant tensor features rather than scalar, charge-like information. This allows reciprocal-space communication to preserve orientation-dependent information across arbitrary distances while maintaining rotational symmetry. Across periodic and aperiodic benchmarks, EquiEwald captures long-range electrostatic behavior consistent with ab initio reference data and consistently improves energy and force accuracy, data efficiency, and long-range extrapolation. These results establish EquiEwald as a physically motivated framework for incorporating long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 长程静电与极化相互作用对分子和凝聚相体系至关重要，但基于局域原子环境的机器学习原子间势难以处理截断半径之外的信息传递。作者提出 EquiEwald，将 Ewald 求和扩展到 SO(3) 等变张量特征而非标量电荷信息，使倒空间通信在任意距离上保留取向相关信息并满足旋转对称性。在周期与非周期基准测试中，该方法提升了能量和力的精度、数据效率及长程外推能力。

articles.title: AI-Driven Nanostructured Electrocatalysts for Efficient Green Hydrogen Production and Sustainable Fuel Generation
articles.title_zh: 面向高效绿色制氢与可持续燃料生成的 AI 驱动纳米结构电催化剂
articles.abstract: Green hydrogen is gaining importance as one of the most potential clean energy carriers in achieving carbon neutrality, and this will help reduce dependence on fossil fuels. Unfortunately, most of the state-of-art electrocatalysts for water splitting exhibit relatively low electrochemical activity and high cost, which restricts their commercial application. We propose an AI-Driven Nanostructured Electrocatalyst Optimization Framework (AINEOF) for efficient green hydrogen production and sustainable fuel generation. The proposed framework combines artificial intelligence and nanoscale material design to optimize the composition, morphology, electronic structure, and kinetic reaction parameters for HER and OER catalysts. We employ Bayesian optimization with a hybrid deep neural network to predict the optimal nanostructure parameters by minimizing computational and experimental resources. Designed transition-metal-based nanostructures with built-in defect sites and heterostructure interfaces are the most effective catalysts that greatly facilitate catalytic reaction activity and charge transfer efficiency. The simulation results show that the HER overpotential of the proposed framework is merely 41 mV when current density increases to 10 mA cm0(2)(-1), which is much lower than that of conventional catalysts(78 mV); and meanwhile, it leads to a reduction of OER overpotential to 236 mV (32.8% relative improvement). AI optimization illustrated a 67.4% reduction in catalyst discovery time and an enhancement of hydrogen production activity from 86.1% to 96.8%, while its Faradaic efficiency improved from 92.82% to over 99.2%. In addition, this nanostructured electrocatalyst shows good long-term durability with 95.6% of activity retention after continuous electrolysis for 100 h. The total water-splitting system can reach an energy conversion efficiency of 84.9%, a current density of 1.62 A cm⁻² and a hydrogen production rate of 8.84 mmol h⁻¹ cm⁻², surpassing all state-of-art methods available to date. Results show that the combination of artificial intelligence and nanostructured catalyst engineering is a powerful and sustainable route toward next-generation green hydrogen and renewable fuel technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 AI 驱动纳米结构电催化剂优化框架 AINEOF，用于水分解中析氢反应和析氧反应催化剂的设计。框架结合贝叶斯优化与混合深度神经网络，以较少计算和实验资源预测纳米结构的组成、形貌、电子结构和动力学参数。作者强调含缺陷位点和异质结构界面的过渡金属基纳米结构可增强反应活性与电荷转移效率；摘要中关于具体过电位结果的信息不完整。
authors: Challaraj Emmanuel E S E S

articles.title: Rigorous Validation of a Trigger Based Variable Fidelity Co Simulation Scheduler for Reinforcement Learning Controlled Power Electronic Systems
articles.title_zh: 面向强化学习控制电力电子系统的触发式变保真协同仿真调度器的严格验证
articles.abstract: Reinforcement-learning (RL) controllers for power-electronic systems are typically trained against simulators whose fidelity is fixed throughout the study. We present a trigger-based scheduler that switches a power-distribution co-simulation between three fidelity levels using an online, provably bounded estimate of divergence from the high-fidelity trajectory. Developing this scheduler surfaced three issues whose correction is as much the contribution as the scheduler itself. First, the conventional low-fidelity power-flow approximation ignores the voltage response to reactive power — exactly what our capacitor banks act on — carrying a 0.09 p.u. mean error; we replace it with a warm-started fast-decoupled power flow, cutting error by over 4×. Second, profiling the medium-fidelity solve showed its cost comes from rebuilding the Jacobian every iteration; a cached-Jacobian variant cuts cost roughly 3× at negligible accuracy loss. Third, validating the error bound against ground truth — rather than the scheduler's own bookkeeping — revealed violations on most low-fidelity steps, traced to a model-gap constant under-calibrated by roughly 450×; correcting it brings violations near zero. Evaluated over 10 seeds with confidence intervals against periodic switching, two independent baseline schedulers, and a trigger-signal ablation, the corrected scheduler achieves 1.3–1.5× speedups over always-high fidelity at a 6–12% accuracy cost relative to periodic switching, cutting training time roughly 30%; it does not dominate periodic switching on both axes despite an extensive search. We report this, and the bound-validation finding, as central results.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种触发式调度器，基于在线且有界的高保真轨迹偏差估计，在三种保真度的配电协同仿真之间切换，用于强化学习控制器训练。作者同时修正了低保真潮流模型忽略无功功率电压响应、中保真求解反复重建雅可比矩阵以及误差界校准不足等问题。改进后的快速解耦潮流、缓存雅可比策略和重新校准的模型间隙常数显著降低误差、计算成本与误差界违例。

articles.title: Quantum scaling advantage using reduced search in an NP-complete problem
articles.title_zh: 在 NP 完全问题中通过缩减搜索实现量子缩放优势
articles.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 03 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01033-6 An empirical scaling advantage for solving representative NP-complete problems is demonstrated by integrating a restricting space reduction algorithm with quantum solvers. Consequently, quantum resources are shown to grow more slowly than classical counterparts.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道将搜索空间缩减算法与量子求解器结合，用于求解代表性 NP 完全问题，并展示经验性的缩放优势。结果表明，在该框架下所需量子资源随问题规模增长得比相应经典方法更慢。摘要信息较简略，具体问题类型、算法实现和基准细节需查阅原文。

Halimeh Quantum many-body scarring (QMBS) has emerged as an intriguing paradigm of weak ergodicity breaking in nonintegrable quantum many-body models, particularly lattice gauge theories (LGTs) in 1+1 spacetime dimensions. However, an open question is whether QMBS has a true high-energy physics origin, an… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033130] Published Mon Aug 03, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕非可积量子多体模型中的弱遍历性破缺现象——量子多体疤痕展开，重点考察其在含动力学物质的 2+1 维晶格规范理论中的表现。既有研究主要集中于 1+1 维晶格规范理论，因此该工作旨在探索量子多体疤痕是否具有更接近高能物理规范理论的起源。摘要片段未给出具体模型参数和结论细节，需查阅原文。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Tim Aßbrock, Jan Sperling, and Laura Ares Nonclassical dynamical speedups in polarization and spin systems are characterized by comparing unrestricted quantum speed limits with maximum rates of change obtained from coherence-free reference dynamics. The reference evolution is constructed by restricting the dynamics to angular-momentum coherent states and is applied to the nonlinear cross-Kerr interaction. [Phys. Rev. Research 8, L032018] Published Mon Aug 03, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究偏振与自旋系统中由非经典性引起的动力学加速。作者将一般量子速度极限与无相干参考动力学允许的最大变化率进行比较，其中参考演化限制在角动量相干态上，并将该框架应用于非线性交叉 Kerr 相互作用。研究给出刻画非经典偏振如何带来速度提升的方法。
